articleTitle: Detection and Recognition of Traditional Chinese Medicine Slice Based on YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) herbal pieces are a type of TCM preparation with complex production processes and a wide variety of species. It is a challenging task for ordinary people to identify TCM herbal pieces. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an object detection method for TCM herbal slice based on YOLOv8. The YOLOv8 model is trained on a Chinese herbal slice (CHS) dataset that is collected and labeled from the internet, and with the Mosaic data augmentation, the average precision of YOLOv8 model on all categories can reach 95.8%, with a model size of 5.94MB, and can achieve <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$30\sim 45$</tex> FPS on the MX150 graphics card environment. Compared with image classification mode, the object detection mode of YOLOv8 can better perform efficient and accurate detection and classification of CHS, which can effectively improve the recognition rate and popularization of CHS, and enable more people to benefit from the culture of TCM.

articleTitle: HDLHC: Hybrid Face Anti-Spoofing Method Concatenating Deep Learning and Hand-Crafted Features
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Despite significant attention given to face spoofing, there is still a need for more generalizable face anti-spoofing methods that would perform robustly in practical face recognition systems. Face spoofing attacks can be done by presenting a photo, video or a mask of the target person to the camera. This paper introduces a feature level fusion method, called HDLHC, that concatenates features extracted automatically by deep learning with hand-crafted image quality features derived from original images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HDLHC outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on the Oulu-NPU and SiW datasets. It demonstrates its generalization ability under different face spoof attack conditions.

articleTitle: Developing Massive Open Online Course Style Assessments using Generative AI Tools
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Since 2022, there are plenty of discussion on generative AI tools such as OpenAI's GPT (Generative Pretrained Transformer), large language models (LLMs), and Google's Bard. These tools rapidly have gained worldwide attention, and several users have attracted by the power of these tools. In this paper, the generative AI used to develop types of assessments which are widely used in Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) is discussed. The main focus of this paper is to test the power of Generative AI tools used to generate assessments which can be used by MOOC developers. The prompts mentioned in this paper can be used by any educators while developing assessments, and not just limited to MOOC developers. Moreover, learners can use the same methods to generate various types of assessments to self-evaluate the progress in their study. As a case study, to test the power of these tools, we have considered how the assessments can be generated while teaching a foreign language course.

articleTitle: The Vivaldi Antenna Design for Ultra-Wideband Biomedical Breast Imaging
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The paper introduces a large cavity Vivaldi antenna with diverters for breast tumor detection. The antenna size is 45×40×1.2 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, A 2.5-10 GHz bandwidth was achieved by adjusting parameters such as index lines and cavity radius. Simulation results confirm that the antenna satisfies ultra-wideband features. Subsequently, we designed a microwave imaging experiment, and the antenna correctly located the tumor, demonstrating the antenna's excellent performance.

articleTitle: Design of High-Speed and High-Reliability Communication Network Based on FC-AE-1553 Optical Fiber Bus Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a high-speed and high-reliability communication network based on the FC-AE-1553 optical fiber bus. It adopts a high-reliability dual-redundant switching network topology, designs the active and standby NC nodes, and formulates a time-triggered communication mechanism. The communication network also implements scheduling cycle time division measures for multi-NC communication to realize multi-NC collision-free reliable communication. Through engineering practice and application, the FC-AE-1553 optical fiber bus high-speed and high-reliability communication network proposed in this paper has achieved good application results.

articleTitle: Research on Real-Time Human Fall Detection Method Based on YOLOv5-Lite
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Fall detection is an important application with various applications in fields such as healthcare and safety monitoring. This paper presents a fall detection method based on the lightweight object detection model YOLOv5-Lite. The proposed method uses a custom dataset for training and optimizing the model to achieve precise detection of human fall states in real-time scenarios. Accuracy, recall rate, mAP, and FPS are used to evaluate the model's performance. Experimental results show that when the IoU is 0.5, the accuracy of the model is 92.1%, with a detection accuracy of 94.0% and a recall rate of 85.6% for fall states. Regarding the running speed, the model runs at 3.12ms FPS when using a camera with a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$640\times 480$</tex> size as input on an RTX3060 (12G) graphics card. This study has practical and promotional value and provides technical support and reference for human fall detection in practical scenarios such as elderly care facilities and public areas.

articleTitle: Dual-Control Reconfigurable Intelligent Metasurface: Design and Realization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A dual-control reconfigurable intelligent metasurface (DC-RIMS) composed of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$24\times 22$</tex> symmetric cells in the 5G mid-band is proposed. The DC-RIMS of non-artificial-magnetic-conductor type provides a smaller phase resolution of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$60^{\mathrm{o}}$</tex> with 2 bits under normal incidence. Angular sensitivities of the RIMS under oblique incidence are investigated. Our results show that the reflection responses at elevation angles are more sensitive than the azimuth angles, whereas the maximum phase differences are differed from each polarization. The horizontal one increases to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$220^{\mathrm{o}}$</tex> whereas the vertical one reduces to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$150^\mathrm{o}$</tex> as compared with overlapped <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$180^{\mathrm{o}}$</tex> under normal incidence.

articleTitle: An Omnidirectional Antenna with Dual-Gain and High-Gain for WiFi-6 Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This letter proposes a high-gain omnidirectional antenna with dual-band for WiFi-5/WiFi -6 applications. The antenna is basically comprised of several slotted semi-circular radiation patches, L-shaped branch structure patches and coaxial feed sources. Here, symmetrical rectangular slots are used to increase impedance matching. The planar size of antenna is 12×35 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, which is much smaller than other dual-band WIFI antennas. The simulated results tell that the antenna can be used at 2.4~2.485 GHz and 5.15~5.85 GHz (|S11|<-10 dB), and the average gains for lower and upper frequencies are 2.1 dBi and 5.8 dBi, respectively. At the same time, good omnidirectional radiation characteristics in the horizontal plane is achieved.

articleTitle: Improving Seagull Algorithm for Optimal Scheduling of Energy Microgrid Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Microgrids, as self-contained energy systems, possess great potential in facilitating renewable energy consumption and optimizing energy structures. This paper introduces a model for energy dispatch in microgrids that incorporates demand-side response, utilizing a sigmoid continuum and the chaotic seagull optimization algorithm (SCCSOA). The objective is to tackle the multi-constrained and non-linear operational characteristics of microgrids. The enhanced algorithm leverages a chaotic sequence to initialize the seagull population, while employing the sigmoid function to guide the seagull search process. This approach significantly improves the algorithm's global search capability. Furthermore, a golden sine mechanism is introduced to enhance the local search efficiency in the later stages of the algorithm. The effectiveness of the improved algorithm in microgrid systems is verified through arithmetic simulations that analyze optimization results for different scheduling strategies, thus demonstrating its adaptability.

articleTitle: Self-Attention and Transformers: Driving the Evolution of Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Transformers, originally introduced for machine translation, and built upon the Self-Attention mechanism, have undergone a remarkable evolution, establishing themselves as the bedrock of large language models (LLMs). Their unparalleled capacity to model intricate relationships and capture extensive dependencies within sequences has propelled their prominence. This article, presented in a popular science format, serves as an introduction to the transformer architecture, elucidating its innovative structure that enables efficient processing of long sequences and capturing dependencies over extended distances. We believe that this resource will prove valuable to college students or youth researchers aspiring to delve into the study and research of modern Artificial Intelligence (AI) domains.

articleTitle: Circular Monoblock Dielectric Resonator Filter Based On 60-Degree Sectorial Resonators
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A circular monoblock dielectric resonator filter based on 60-degree sectorial resonators is proposed in this study. This filter is formed of six 60-defree sectorial resonator. A blind hole is drilled on the top of each 60-degree sectorial resonator to modulate the resonant frequency. Magnetic coupling between each resonator is implemented by using metalized through holes instead of traditional partitioning walls, which can be simple in structure. Electrical coupling is realized by a metalized blind hole to realize dispersive coupling, which fulfils the function of diagonal cross coupling to generate two transmission zeros. A partitioning through hole is set at the center of the whole cavity to suppress the unnecessary cross coupling. The structure of the proposed filter is discussed and simulated. The simulated results show that the designed filter has a fractional bandwidth of 7.8<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> at 3.6GHz with two out-of-band transmission zeros at 3.38 and 3.74 GHz, and the insertion loss and return loss agree well with the theoretical results.

articleTitle: A Dualband Wide Beamwidth Directional Antenna for 2G/3G/LTE Indoor System Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A dualband and wide-beamwidth directional antenna for 2G/3G/LTE indoor distributed systems is proposed in this paper. The antenna is composed of a dipole patch with rotation-symmetric curved branches, two reflecting plates and four parasitic metal walls. The Simulation results show that a dualband impedance bandwidth of 0.65-1.16 GHz (56.3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) and 1.59-2.79 GHz (54.8<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) can be achieved for <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\vert \mathrm{S}_{11}\vert < -10$</tex>, which can be applied to 2G/3G/LTE bands. In addition, the peak gains range from 4 to 6.5 dBi in the lower band and from 4.8 to 9.7 dBi in the upper band. Notably, it also has good directionality and wide beamwidth.

articleTitle: RIS-Assisted Cooperative Transmission System with Adaptive Reflection Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) is one of the most promising technologies for future wireless communications. To solve the multiplicative fading effect of traditional passive RIS (PRIS), a hybrid active-passive RIS (HRIS) collaborative transmission system is proposed in this paper. The hybrid RIS can change its reflection mode adaptively according to the channel transmission environment, not only adjusting the phase of the incident signal, but also amplifying the incident signal. For the proposed system model, an approximate closed expression for the outage probability (OP) of the system is obtained using the compound Simpson formula, as well as the correctness of the derived theoretical equation is verified by Monte Carlo simulation. Simulation results show that HRIS can effectively reduce the outage probability of the system compared to PRIS and active RIS (ARIS) which uses the decode-and-forward (DF) protocol.

articleTitle: Embedding Algorithms and Programs in QR Codes for Improving Teaching and Learning through Mobile Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In the recent years, QR (Quick Response) codes have become ubiquitous which are used for various applications in domains such as governments, museums, airlines, shopping malls, retail markets, manufacturing, logistics, hospitals, and education institutions. QR codes can embed various types of data such as image, text, URL, e-mail, SMS, Wi-Fi credentials, passwords, payment information, and business cards. In this paper, we propose how QR codes can be used in courses related algorithms and data structures, and programming languages. The main purpose of using QR codes is that, while teaching these courses, students need to focus on information such as program codes which is hard to visualize from far. For example, a typical program includes hundreds of lines of code, and if they are presented in a power-point presentation, it is not easy for students to see variables, operators, letters, and programming constructs. Algorithms also generally include several lines along with symbols, variables, and operators. To make it more visible in their mobile phones, programs and algorithms are embedded in QR codes for students to see them in their mobile devices. Irrespective of some of the limitations, the use of QR codes in programming languages, algorithms, and data structures courses are found to be interactive, highly engaging, and significantly beneficial to positive learning experience.

articleTitle: Behavior Modeling Network with Inter-layer Attention for Human Mobility Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With the increasing popularity of mobile smart devices and advancements in positioning technology, the prediction of human mobility has emerged as a popular research area. The objective of predicting human mobility is to forecast users' next place choices. This research has wide-ranging applications in various domains, including tourism recommendation, urban planning, and traffic prediction. In recent years, researchers have approached mobility prediction as a sequential prediction task, aiming to predict users' next place by modeling their movement patterns. Furthermore, some researchers have incorporated personalized information and employed attention layers to capture individual preferences. However, these methods often overlook the potential interactions among visit records and fail to fully leverage semantic information from historical trajectories, leading to incomplete modeling of user. To tackle these issues, we propose a Behavior Modeling Network with Inter-layer Attention (BMIA) for comprehensive modeling of user behavior. Specifically, we employ bi-directional GRU and self-attention layer to capture the potential interactions between visit records. We design a user-based fusion layer to leverage three types of semantic information effectively. We model user behaviors using two parallel modules. Additionally, we introduce a filtering mechanism to emphasize significant places, ultimately enabling accurate prediction of the user's next place. We evaluate our method using HR and MRR metrics, and conduct comparative experiments and ablation studies on two public real-world datasets collected from the Foursquare platform in New York and Tokyo. The experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms four existing baseline methods.

articleTitle: Multi-state FMCW Radar Real-time Vital Signs Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Aiming at the variety of states non-contact real-time vital signs monitoring system for 77GHz Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) radar, the hardware, software construction and experimental analysis of the real-time monitoring system are studied based on IWR1642 chip. The system workflow is as follows: radar transmitting antenna transmits the signal, the signal bounces off the object, then receiving antenna receives the echo, and the echo is mixed with the transmitted signal through the filter to obtain the intermediate frequency signal. The intermediate frequency signal is sampled by Analog to Digital Converter (ADC), and the target range-bin is obtained by performing Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) on the sampled signal; the target range-bin is phase extraction and the extracted phase is unwrapping and difference; the respiration and heartbeat waveforms are separated from the difference signal with band-pass filter; respiratory rate and heart rate are obtained by FFT and peak counting of respiratory and heartbeat waveforms. Finally, we compare the designed system with the mature equipment. Experimental results show that the system can effectively extract and display human respiratory rate and heartbeat rate for different experimental states and distances. And heart rate accuracy is about 96 %, respiratory rate accuracy is about 91 %. This paper provides a small, low power consumption, high accuracy, and high sensitivity reference scheme for non-contact real-time measurements.

articleTitle: Uniform Serpentine Spring Design of THz MEMS Switch for a Low Driving Voltage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With the development of satellite communications, military radar and other fields, the demand for terahertz (0.1-10THz) tunable devices is growing, of which the switches are the most basic component, and Radio Frequency MEMS switches have a wider application in the high-frequency band due to their excellent RF performance of shorter transmission wavelength, higher operating frequency of the THz signal, and greater signal transmission loss. The electromagnetic waveguide must also be physically smaller as a result, which results in a high driving voltage. Therefore, to overcome the contradiction between RF loss and high driving voltage, a series contact RF MEMS switch structure with an operating frequency of 100-200GHz is reported in this study to realize the switching of the signal on/off state. The design achieves a low driving voltage of 23.17V with no collapse of the movable upper pole plate and automatic on/off switching by using a uniform serpentine to optimize the equivalent spring constant of the switch and COMSOL Multiphysics finite element simulation software to analyze the mechanical performance of the switch. The main indicators of the switch and the influence of S-parameters are analyzed and optimized using HFSS electromagnetic simulation software, resulting in a MEMS switch with insertion loss better than 0.83dB and isolation better than 19.88 dB.

articleTitle: Behavior of Avalanche-Induced Current Filament of High Voltage IGBTs at Over-voltage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: When the avalanche effect occurs at the over-voltage of IGBTs, the behavior that the devices represent dominate the device robustness against the avalanche. With the increase of avalanche effect, current crowding (current filament) can arise, which is a root reason leading to the device destruction. In this paper, the avalanche breakdown characteristics of high voltage IGBTs are studied, and then the relations between the avalanche breakdown curves and the avalanche-generated current filaments are reveled. The results show the higher <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{a}_{\mathrm{p}\mathrm{n}\mathrm{p}}$</tex> can cause a stronger negative differential resistance effect in avalanche breakdown curve, leading to the formation of a stronger filament with a slower moving speed, consequently weakening the device robustness against the avalanche.

articleTitle: Vertical Charge Loss Induced by Defect Coupling at SiO2/Si3N4 Interface in 3D NAND Flash Memory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to provide an underlying mechanism for vertical charge loss in scalable 3D NAND flash memory, the defect coupling is investigated systematically based on ab initio calculations. We found that the trap energy levels of V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">N</inf>-H defects in Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>CT layer are close to the Vo-H defects in Si02 layers, which leads to defects coupling directly for vertical charge loss, but the Vo defect in SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> seemed so far away. However, the Vo defects still cause the vertical charge loss during Program/Erase cycling, due to the defect coupling with the electric field at SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Si3N4 interface. It is concluded that the defects coupling could result in vertical charge loss. Hence, more attention should be paid to interface defect processing for robust reliability 3D NAND Flash Memory.

articleTitle: A Band-pass FSS with Wide Angular Stability and High Polarization Stability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A mimic multi-layer polarization-independent FSS with accessible angular-stability is reported using a three-layer structure, where the top layer and the bottom layer are realized based the metal rings that are same, and the middle is constructed by a slotted metal structure. The mentioned three layers are aimed to separate the used two dielectric substrates. For a well illustration, the constructed dimensions of the installed FSS are <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{5\times 5}\mathbf{mm}^{2}$</tex>. As a case of the FSS cell design, here the dimension is limited as <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{0.15}\lambda\times \boldsymbol{0.15}\lambda$</tex>. Since two different structure is used, the FSS has double resonace, making a wide operation. From the numerical evaluations, the FSS can reject the signal from C-and X-band.

articleTitle: A Novel Snapback-Free BRT with A N-Type Buried Carrier Storage Layer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A new Base Resistance controlled Thyristor with a buried n-type carrier storage layer (BN-CS-BRT) is proposed in this paper. The N-type Buried Layer (NBL) can introduce an IE effect in the device similar to IGBT, which can reduce the on-state voltage drop (VT) and completely suppress the snapback phenomenon generated in the traditional BRT. The V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</inf> of BN-CS-BRT is 3.84 V, which is about 26% lower than the counterpart of the conventional BRT.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm-Based Iterative Channel Parameter Estimation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Due to the limitations of the Global Positioning System (GPS) itself, such as the tendency to cause large positioning errors in adverse weather conditions, it is important to explore other positioning methods. Among these positioning methods, range-based positioning by estimating the time of arrival (ToA) of the line-of-sight (LoS) path has gained a great deal of attention. In this paper, a genetic algorithm-based iterative channel parameter estimation method is proposed, and simulation experiments demonstrate that the algorithm improves the accuracy of delay estimation compared with the space-alternating generalized expectation-maximization (SAGE) algorithm.

articleTitle: A Union MEC-UAV Computation Offloading System Applied to Wireless Sensor Network for Marine Renewable Energy Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Currently, the research integrating smart grid with mobile edge computing (MEC) is focused on the terrestrial renewable energy scenario, and very little research has been done on marine, where the communication environment is far more complex than on land. Firstly, we use the Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) to build a union MEC-UAV computation offloading system to assist marine smart grids (MSG) in sensor data processing, where UAV only acted as the relay for collecting sensor data in previous studies. Next, we propose an optimization algorithm for offloading UAV-assisted maritime MEC tasks based on an Enhanced Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (E-DDPG) algorithm. It adapts the MEC-UAV system to the complex marine environment by optimizing the task offload rate and UAV position to ensure the service quality of the smart grid, reducing the processing latency significantly. Experimental results prove that the E-DDPG is more outstanding than the DDPG.

articleTitle: A Four-Port MIMO Circularly Polarized Antenna for UWB Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A four-port MIMO circularly polarized antenna for UWB applications is proposed in this paper. For better impedance matching, coplanar waveguide feeds are used, which is convenient to be integrated in other applications. This proposed circularly polarized antenna uses MIMO technology, which provides diversity performance. The decoupling structure is added to reduce the total size, enhance the isolation and improve the axial ratio loss due to MIMO technology. The antenna is printed on substrate FR-4 with dimensions of 64×62×1 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, The relative impedance bandwidth reaches 75.8% (3.7-8.23 GHz), and the relative axial ratio bandwidth is 41.3% (5.28-8.03 GHz). RHCP is radiated in the +z direction, and LHCP in the -z direction by the proposed antenna. Moreover, a high isolation of more than 15 dB, stable gain between 2–6 dB, low ECC, and high DG throughout the entire working band are demonstrated. The antenna has good prospects, which is suitable for UWB applications.

articleTitle: A Small Target Detection Algorithm of Complex Traffic Road Based on SDC-YOLO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of high error detection rate and missing rate of small targets in complex traffic scenes, a small target detection algorithm based on Space-Depth-Conv YOLO (SDC-YOLO) is proposed. The improved method uses the Space-Depth layer and the Conv layer to replace the original step structure of the YOLO algorithm and reduce the loss of fine-grained information. At the same time, the BIoU loss function is improved to strengthen further the relationship between the scale relationship between the target and the prediction boundary box and improve the detection accuracy of small targets as a whole. The simulation results show that compared with the prototype YOLOv5 algorithm, the recall rate and average precision of the proposed algorithm are improved by 2.71% and 2.13%, which effectively improves the detection performance of small and medium-sized targets on complex traffic roads and can better meet the target detection requirements in automatic driving scenarios.

articleTitle: An Asymmetric Millimeter Wave MIMO Antenna Array for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: An asymmetric millimeter wave MIMO antenna array is proposed in this paper for the 5G applications. Four microstrip grid array antennas are working as transmitting antennas and one differential-fed patch antenna serves as receiving antenna. The numbers of the transmitting antennas and the receiving antennas are asymmetric, which is different from the conventional reciprocal MIMO systems. Based on weak-field self-decoupling technology, a simulated isolation of 35.8 dB is achieved at 28 GHz. The simulated input impedance bandwidths are 3.9 GHz and 1.9 GHz for the transmitting antennas and the receiving antenna, respectively. The simulated maximal peak realized gains are 18.8 dBi and 8.8 dBi for the transmitting antennas and the receiving antenna, respectively.

articleTitle: A Dual-Band Filtering Impedance Transformer with Real-to-Complex Impedance Loads
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This letter presents a novel dual-band impedance transformer with real-to-complex impedance loads, which can achieve a filtering response with excellent stopband rejection. The proposed topology comprises two transmission lines, one short-circuited stub, a pair of open-circuited stubs and one stepped impedance branch. The existence of stubs and stepped impedance branch allows the impedance transformer to exhibit dual-passband filtering response. The return loss, represented by <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\vert S_{11}\vert$</tex>, is adjusted to approximately − 15 dB within the passband while the transmission loss of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\vert S21\vert$</tex> is adjusted to approximately − 20 dB within the stopband. For demonstration, we conducted simulations, fabrication, and measurements on a proposed circuit that incorporates real-to-complex impedance loads. The measured results have validated the proposed design theory.

articleTitle: Recognition of Working Mode for Multifunctional Phased Array Radar Under Small Sample Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Multifunctional phased array radar has been widely applied and its working mode recognition is important. However, the intra-pulse parameters of the multifunctional phased array radar are extremely close between different operating modes, making it difficult to distinguish. And it has the characteristics of fast beam scanning, complex waveform, and power control, which leads to a small sample size in working mode recognition. This paper proposes to utilize a generative adversarial network (GAN) to amplify datasets with extremely small samples and characterize the inter-pulse characteristics. Experimental results show that the proposed method can achieve a 10% improvement in accuracy under a small sample size of 25%.

articleTitle: Small Objects Detection Method for UAVs Aerial Image Based on YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) aerial images have the characteristics of high resolution and many small objects. The current detector model used to detect aerial images of small objects does not work well. To improve the detection result, the UAV-YOLO network is designed in this paper. Based on the YOLOv5s model, a magnifier method datasets augment method is proposed, which can enhance the feature learning ability of small objects in pictures; meanwhile, Reconstruction Detection Branch is introduced to increase the capture of small objects with a side length of 12∼24 pixels, reduce missed detection, thereby increasing the detection precision of small objects. The experimental results show that, compared with the baseline YOLOv5s, the overall detection precision is 6.4% higher, the recall is 2.4% higher, and the small objects people are 5.1% higher.

articleTitle: A Method to Verify Internal Parameters of Camera Calibration in World Coordinate System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that reprojection error (RE) cannot reflect the camera calibration accuracy intuitively, this paper proposes a method to verify the camera calibration results in world coordinate system. Firstly, the checkerboard calibration target is photographed with the camera under test, and the internal parameters and distortion parameters of the camera are calculated by using the pinhole model and the Kannala-Brandt (KB) fisheye model, respectively. Then, the same camera is used to shoot two targets in the field of view (FOV), and the pixel coordinates of the two target points are detected from the image. Thirdly, the inverse projection model is used to calculate the distance between the two objects and the angle between the camera and the two objects, and the real distance and angle are compared. The experimental results show that the average distance errors of the pinhole model and the KB fisheye model are 0.34% and 0.35%, respectively, and the angle errors are 0.40% and 0.12%, respectively, which proves that the verification method can effectively characterize the calibration accuracy of the camera.

articleTitle: Cooperative Encirclement Strategy for Multiple Drones Based on ATT-MADDPG
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Aiming to address the challenges related to robustness, adaptability, and cooperative performance in the context of multi-drone cooperative encirclement of airborne evasive targets. We propose a cooperative encirclement strategy based on multi-agent reinforcement learning. Firstly, the environment and kinematic model for the encirclement problem are established, taking the context of drone cooperative attack as the background. The criteria for successful encirclement are provided. Secondly, this paper proposes a Markov Decision Process framework based on the Attention-based Multi-Agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (ATT-MADDPG) algorithm. The state space, action space for encirclement distance, and a reward function combining capture and step rewards are designed according to the requirements of the encirclement task. Finally, the encirclement strategy is trained using a centralized training and distributed execution architecture, where the drone swarm shares the same policy and independently executes actions. Simulation experiments demonstrate the superior performance of this approach in achieving successful encirclement compared to the MADDPG algorithm. Furthermore, the proposed algorithm effectively navigates obstacles while efficiently capturing the target, thus highlighting its adaptability in complex environments.

articleTitle: Adaptive Dynamic Programming for Finite-Horizon Networked Control System with Packet Loss and Delay
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to adaptive optimal control of networked control systems with packet loss and delay using adaptive dynamic programming. The impact of stochastic packet loss and delay is first considered. The relationship between the stochastic Riccati equation and the deterministic Riccati equations is established via simulations that result from sampling the original system. It enables the implementation of stochastic approximate optimal control by means of an off-policy iterative strategy. The effectiveness of proposed procedures is finally demonstrated through an example.

articleTitle: A Parallel Ladder Structure for Mutual Coupling Reduction to Ultra-Wideband Antenna in E-Plane
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A novel ultra-wideband decoupling structure for Vivaldi antenna array in E-plane is proposed and discussed in this paper. The decoupling structure is composed of 5 parallel staggered ladders with steps in bow-tie shape. The isolation between the two ports of the adjacent antenna is reduced more than 30 dB at 1.72 GHz and 3.58 GHz. And the proposed structure exhibits good decoupling performance between 0.5-2.4 GHz and 2.7-5.7 GHz. The pattern and realized gain are almost the same between the decoupled and the original antenna array.

articleTitle: A Compact UHF-RFID Tag Antenna Based on PIFA Structure for Two-Side Anti-Metal Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Based on the Planar Inverted F-shaped Antenna structure, we propose a two-side anti-metal tag antenna for ultra-high frequency radio frequency identification. The chip of the proposed tag antenna is housed within a square slot of FR4 material. Three gaps can be observed on the surface of the proposed tag antenna. As a result of these gaps, the resonant frequency can be adjusted with flexibility in order to ensure an optimal power transmission coefficient and impedance matching. The proposed tag antenna maintains a compact size of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{{40}\times 28\times 3.2 \ \text{mm}^{3}}$</tex>. The proposed tag antenna is measured by placing it on a metal plate, resulting in 5.2 m and 5 m read distances, respectively. The proposed tag antenna is compact, and exhibits good performance, particularly with its two-side anti-metal characteristics.

articleTitle: On the Outage Probability of Multi-RIS Assisted Two-Way Communication System with RIS Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) is considered as a potential key technology for the next generation with reliable application prospects. We consider a multi- RIS-assisted two-way wireless communication system. Based on the multiple RISs selection, the uplink and downlink of RIS-assisted communication are considered, and the RIS whose link has the largest SINR is selected for communication. In addition, the closed-form expression for the outage probability (OP) under the RIS selection is derived and the correctness of the theoretical value is verified using Monte Carlo. Furthermore, the effects of phase error and loop interference (LI) on the system are also analyzed.

articleTitle: A Feature-Enhanced Service Function Vector Generation Method for Web API Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The brevity of service function descriptions often results in feature sparsity and incompleteness of service function vectors generated by topic models. To improve the quality of service function vectors generated by topic modes, this paper proposes an enhanced service function vector generation method suitable for Web API clustering. We design a context-based feature word extraction method for service description text and construct a topic probability correction factor. The topic features of service function vectors are enhanced by applying feature word extraction and probability correction. Experiment results show that the service function vector with the enhanced topic can significantly improve the service clustering quality.

articleTitle: Rapid Response Humidity Sensor Based on GO/CaCo3@Ag Nanocomposite for Real-Time Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Breath-monitoring sensors hold immense potential for real-time healthcare data collection. Furthermore, humidity-sensing devices continue to play a pivotal role in a all-around of industries, such as manufacturing, food processing, agriculture, and meteorology. Here, we have introduced a rapid-response nanocomposite film based on GO/CaCO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>@Ag coated on the interdigitated capacitor electrode (IDC). The GO/CaCO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>@Ag composite-based sensor demonstrates a sensitivity of 56.5 pF/% and a hysteresis of 6.9% within the 25-95% RH range. The developed sensor also has a rapid 7.2 s response time and 1.8 s recovery time. This sensing platform proves to be a promising choice for various humidity sensing applications, especially real-time breath monitoring, due to its exceptional sensitivity and rapid response.

articleTitle: Ultra-High Amplification Properties of PT-Symmetric Photonic Crystals
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper introduces PT-symmetric systems into periodic one-dimensional photonic crystals with specific structures through logical combination methods. By designing and optimizing the structure, a new photonic crystal model is constructed, effectively suppressing optical loss and scattering, thus achieving an ultra-high amplification of the transmission rate up to the order of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$10^{308}$</tex>. The eigenmodes and eigenfrequencies in the photonic crystal are calculated by the scattering matrix method, determining the working state of the photonic crystal and discussing the physical mechanism.

articleTitle: A Filtering Quasi-Yagi Antenna with High Selectivity and Wide Stopband
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A filtering quasi-Yagi antenna with high selectivity and wide stopband is proposed. To realize filtering function, a parallel absorptive branch, which composed by a bandstop filter and a resistor, is employed at the feed line to obtain absorptive type radiation nulls on the both stopbands to improve the out-of-band suppression level and the width of stopband. Directors are employed symmetrically to improve the gain. According to the simulation results, the bandwidth of proposed antenna is 9% (2.52 to 2.75 GHz), and the realized gain is from 8.6 to 9.3 dBi. High out-of-band suppression and low sidelobes level are achieved with 15 and -14 dB.

articleTitle: A Novel FPGA-Based Moving Object Detection and Tracking Using Image Processing Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a FPGA-based moving object detection and tracking using image processing technique is proposed. The hardware system is composed of DE2-115 platform and TRDB-D5M camera, and the real-time visual object detection technique adopted the inter-frame difference algorithm and morphological image processing. The proposed technique avoids high computational cost, which only needs convert the captured images to RGB format and detect the moving object using the morphological processing and interframe difference method. The object tracking is realized by the centroid tracking algorithm, and object detection and tracking result is displayed in the image with the format of 640*480@60Hz under the VGA mode. This system can achieve real-time tracking of moving object, and the processing speed of image information is fast.

articleTitle: A Study of Parallel Ant Colony Optimization with CUDA-Based Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper introduces Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) algorithms implemented using CUDA technology for parallelization, inspired by the intelligent behavior of ants in nature. The goal is to demonstrate their efficiency in real-world applications, particularly in improving vehicle routing and scheduling in transportation and logistics. The ACO algorithm has proven to enhance operational efficiency and increase customer satisfaction. By integrating ACO principles with CUDA parallel computing, their performance has been extended to include domains like electromagnetic scattering computations and microwave antenna designs.

articleTitle: LSTM-Based Detection of OT Cyber-Attacks for an Offshore HVAC-Cooling Process
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This work explored the possibility to use a deep machine learning method for cost-effective development of an Intrusion Detection System (IDS) for an offshore Operational Technology (OT) cooling process driven by a HVAC system. Two types of cyber-attacks, namely Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attack and Deny-of-Service (DoS), are considered at different intruding locations within a Modbus-based Supervisory-Control-And-Data-Acquisition (SCADA) and Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) network. By using the Long Short-Term Memory Neural Network (LSTM-NN) as a middle layer, the IDS is developed as a multi-layer feature classifier, which consists of sequential input, LSTM, dense, softmax and classifier layers. Training and testing data are produced from a corresponding simulation system. The IDS system uses the measurements from the ongoing system (i.e., compressor status) and the relevant process (i.e., ambient and room temperatures) along with the network information to monitor potential abnormal behaviors induced by dedicated cyber-attacks in an real-time manner. All considered attack scenarios can be successfully detected by the developed IDS within 2 min after the attack occurs. There is only one situation in which the IDS cannot identify the abnormal phenomenon is caused by a MitM(2) or DoS attack due to lack of extra signals to distinguish them. In general, this study showed a clear benefit for cost-effective development of OT IDS system using the machine learning method, subject to good availability of sufficient and high-quality data.

articleTitle: A Novel Low Common-Mode Voltage DAC Switching Strategy for SAR ADCs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a 10-bit successive approximation analog-to-digital converter (ADC) with a conversion rate of 50 MS/s and proposes a low common-mode voltage fully differential switch switching scheme. The ADC employs a non-binary weighted non-split Sub-DAC capacitor structure and incorporates redundant bits to improve switch conversion speed and accuracy. During the switching process, only the reference voltage Vcm is utilized, with a variation range between 0 and Vcm. A comparison with traditional switching schemes demonstrates a 93% reduction in switch energy and an 83% decrease in area.In the SMIC 180nm CMOS process, utilizing an initial signal frequency of 24.26MHz, the ADC achieved a SNDR of 57.98dB and ENOB of 9.34 bits. Furthermore, the FOM for this ADC was measured to be 179.95 fJ/conversion-step.

articleTitle: Low-Light Image Enhancement Based on Retinex Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Low-light images will likely suffer from multiple issues, such as color distortion, excessive enhancement, halo artifacts, and noise amplification when their brightness is increased. The existing low-light image enhancement methods are challenging to solve the above problems simultaneously, especially with poor performance in dealing with halo artifacts and noise. In this paper, we propose a comprehensive method that can simultaneously solve multiple challenging problems by combining the characteristics of image information distribution, the advantages of various image processing technologies, and Retinex theory. Furthermore, this method can effectively suppress halo artifacts and reduce image noise. Firstly, we decompose the input image into a base layer and a detail layer. Next, we convert the base layer image to Hue Saturation Value (HSV) color space and propose an improved Retinex model to handle the Value channel separately. Moreover, we propose an image gradient denoising method based on fast guided filtering for noise reduction and detail enhancement on the detail layer image. Finally, two-layer processing results are fused in RGB space to obtain the final enhanced image. The experiment shows that our proposed method comprehensively addresses various challenging issues in existing low-light enhanced images and performs well in suppressing halo artifacts and noise.

articleTitle: Research on Clinical Pathway Resource Scheduling Optimization Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The widespread application of clinical pathways has improved the quality of medical care in hospitals in China, enabling patients to better medical services. However, due to the large population base in China, the therapeutic resources are relatively few, and the medical resources of the hospital are also limited. The resource scheduling problem of the clinical pathway is gradually highlighted. In this paper, the clinical pathway resource scheduling problem is abstracted as a multi-project scheduling problem under resource constraints, and the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is utilized to complete the resource scheduling optimization experiment on the clinical pathway of type2 diabetes. At the same time, aiming at the problem that particle swarm optimization is easy to fall into local optimum, the grey wolf algorithm is combined with particle swarm optimization. Finally, the particle swarm optimization algorithm and the grey wolf algorithm are compared with the improved algorithm. The experimental results show that when the number of patients treated increases, the results obtained by the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm are better than the particle swarm optimization algorithm and the grey wolf algorithm, effectively avoiding the problem of a local optimal solution.

articleTitle: The Co-simulation of PMSM Control System Based on the Equivalent Circuit Extraction Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: For improving the simulation accuracy of the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) control system, a collaborative simulation method with high simulation accuracy and low requirements on computer performance is proposed. A 3kW PMSM is researched. Firstly, the 2D finite element model of the PMSM is established using ANSYS Maxwell. Secondly, the equivalent circuit extraction (ECE) model is established based on the 2D finite element model. Meanwhile, the motor control algorithm model and inverter circuit model are built using MATLAB Simulink and ANSYS Simpler, respectively. Finally, the ECE model, the control model, and the inverter model are used for collaborative simulation. The co-simulation results and the Simulink simulation results are compared with the experiment. The experiment results show that the co-simulation accuracy of total harmonics distortion (THD) of phase current and the high-frequency current harmonics can be improved by 36.8% and 23.5%, respectively.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Cerebral Alterations Induced by High-Definition Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation Over the Right Ventrolateral Prefrontal Cortex in the Three-Dimensional Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Currently, three-dimensional (3D) virtual reality (VR) exists technical limitations, which always induces mind-wandering and impedes VR's more widespread applications. In the previous study, we have confirmed that high-definition direct current stimulation in the right ventrolateral prefrontal cortex could significantly enhance this regional neural arousal and effectively ameliorate the sustained attentional capacity of participants in the 3D VR. However, the after-effects of electrical modulation on the holistic neural connectivity are still not clarified. In this study, we further analysed the electroencephalography recordings during the 3D attentional paradigm using graph theory to explore the HD-tDCS-induced overall cerebral topological alterations.

articleTitle: Pattern Reconfigurable Antenna Based on Graphene-Metal Composite Ring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a pattern reconfigurable antenna based on graphene-metal composite ring is proposed. By changing the resistances of the graphene, the operating modes of the antenna can be switched between omnidirectional mode and directional mode. Firstly, an Alford loop antenna with omnidirectional radiation characteristic is designed. Then a graphene-metal composite reconfigurable parasitic ring is designed and placed around the antenna. The resistance of the graphene nanosheets adopted in the design can be tuned from <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$10\Omega$</tex> to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1000\Omega$</tex> by changing the DC bias voltage applied on both sides of the graphene. The simulation results show that the antenna operates at 5.5 GHz, and the radiation modes of the antenna can be arbitrarily switched between omnidirectional mode and directional mode. When the antenna is operating in directional mode, the radiation pattern of the antenna can be reconfigured throughout the horizontal plane, and the beamwidth can be tuned in the range of 67° to 150°.

articleTitle: Channel Estimation for Intelligent Reflecting Surface
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With the popularity of 5G technology, more and more scholars have invested in the research of 6G technology with the advantages of higher speed, high precision and low delay. However, 6G technology has the disadvantages of high power consumption and high hardware cost, and the intelligent reflecting surface is a plane composed of a large number of low-cost passive components with low energy consumption, so IRS has a very broad application prospect in the future auxiliary wireless communication. So we can use intelligent reflecting surface technology in information transmission to reduce power consumption. In this paper, we introduce a random number seed to imitate the noise in real life, an intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) to assist the communication between the transmitter and single antenna users, and optimize the power by optimizing the distance and angle. The final results show that under the condition of the same bit error rate, the power consumption is the lowest with the assistance of an intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) at a long distance.

articleTitle: Investigation of Miniaturized Differential Transformer Coupled Configuration Circuit Using IPD Technology in Advanced Package Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: System-in-package (SiP) is an advanced packaging technology that integrates multiple chips and components into a single package, creating a highly integrated system. Integrated Passive Devices (IPD) technology is commonly used to design resistors, inductors, capacitors, and other passive circuits, enabling the development of new products and solutions that was not possible with traditional board solutions. In recent years, IPD technology has become an important way to achieve SiP. This paper presents a practical implementation of the Differential Transformer Coupled Configuration Circuit using IPD techniques in a RF signal processing SiP, which minimizes the system board area and improves system performance. The paper demonstrates a typical ADC differential input and DAC differential output differential transformer coupled circuit IPD design. The Balun chip and related discrete RLC components are designed as one IPD chip, which can be integrated with the ADC and DAC through a silicon interposer or plastic substrate using Flip chip mode or wire bond in Advanced Package. The dual-channel ADC signal input coupled circuit IPD design meets the application requirements of bandwidth ranging from 1.8 GHz to 5 GHz and return loss and amplitude balance less than 2.5 dB and 3 dB, respectively. The double-input channel coupled circuit chip using fanout integration process can be implemented using RDLs in Advanced Packaging. The results offer a new way for coupled circuit design that significantly reduces the design complexity and area of the system PCB board.

articleTitle: Stepped Windmill Broadband Crossed Dipole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A broadband circularly polarized crossed dipole antenna with a square slot of stepped border is proposed in this paper. The antenna includes two pairs of orthogonal wide rectangular dipoles and a metal ground, with stepped borders and a square slot embedded in each arm entering the crossed dipole to widen the AR bandwidth. Simulation results show an impedance bandwidth of 57.31% (1.83 GHz-3.3 GHz) and a 3dB axial ratio (AR) bandwidth of 50.24% (2.0143 GHz-3.3659 GHz).

articleTitle: Backscatter Enhancement Using a Programmable Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Planar metasurfaces have been widely used in backscatter enhancement due to its low profile, mature manufacture procedure and unprecedented potential in modifying electromagnetic (EM) wave. In this paper, flexible backscatter enhancement of a programmable metasurface is investigated. The methodology for backscatter enhancement is analysed and a binary basic element of programmable metesurface is designed to facilitate flexible backscatter enhancement. Simulation results validate the ability of the proposed programmable metasurface to enhance backscatter at different situations and to generate diverse scatter patterns by modifying the metasurface pattern. This paper is expected to provide a new paradigm for flexible backscatter enhancement.

articleTitle: Analysis of Feasibility of a New Vertically Polarized EMP Radiating-Wave Simulator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A new vertically polarized electromagnetic pulse (EMP) radiating-wave simulator (called “new simulator”) with upper cone, lower cone and an infinite PEC pad is firstly designed for the convenience of construction of the simulator. Then, the radiating fields of new simulator are calculated by finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method. And the comparisons of waveforms, the peak-values, rise-times and full width at half maximum (FWHM) of the vertical components of radiating electric fields in time domain at testing points of new simulator with those of the Normal simulator are given and analyzed in this paper. The analysis of feasibility about new simulator is offered finally. The results show that, there's difference between the peak-values of radiated fields of New simulator and those of Normal simulator; Both rise-times and FWHM of electric field at some testing points (such as near the PEC pad) of New simulator will meet technical requirements of MIL-STD-461E standard, if its voltage source's FWHM increased; New simulator may not afford enough continuous space where the electric fields' rise-time and FWHM meeting technical requirements of MIL-STD-461E standard, and it is not recommended to be used in practice.

articleTitle: The PSO and the Taylor Expansion Based LSSVM Algorithm for EEG Fatigue Multi-Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To solve problems of poor convergence speed and large calculation burden of the traditional least squares support vector machine (LS-SVM) algorithm in EEG classification, this paper investigates a particle swarm optimization and a Taylor expansion RBF Kernel Function based LSSVM (PSO-TKF-LSSVM) algorithm. Fisrtly, the PSO algorithm is used to automatically optimize the hyperparameters σ (kernel function width) and γ (the regularization parameter) in the LSSVM algorithm to improve classification accuracy. Secondly, the first three terms of RBF's Taylor expansion are adopted as a kernel function to decrease the computational burden. Finally, the SEED-VIG fatigue data with 17 channels 5 frequency bands and 4 features are taken as classification signals to conduct simulation experiments. Results show that the PSO-TKF-LSSVM algorithm can increase its convergence speed with little impact on the classification accuracy.

articleTitle: IoT Security Performance Intelligent Prediction Based on Lightweight M-SqueezeNet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence and big data are driving the progression of pluralistic Intelligent Internet of Things (IoT) applications. However, due to the openness and diversity of IoT channels, secrecy information is vulnerable to illegal theft, resulting in IoT communication network interruptions and serious information security problems, which limits the use of IoT in the field of transmitting sensitive data. To handle complex IoT security incidents in real time, accurate secrecy performance predictions are critical to support mobile IoT networks. In this paper, a model of multi-antenna secure communication system based on Decoding Forwarding (DF) relay is proposed. Combining the characteristics of SquezeNet and MobileNet networks, an improved lightweight M-SqueezeNet model is designed which consists of depth separable convolution blocks and fire modules in parallel. This method is suitable for the nonlinear of IoT secrecy data. Experiments have proved that the proposed algorithm has better IoT secrecy performance than others.

articleTitle: An Inpainting Based Infrared Small Target Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Infrared small target detection technology has an essential role in various target detection field. Nonetheless, it is a challenging task to detect small targets due to the lack of shape, texture, and other information. Recently, many traditional algorithms (e.g., Top-Hat transformation) detect numerous false alarms focusing on local regions of infrared images, which leads they are not sufficient to fulfill the requirements. To address this problem, in this paper, an infrared detection framework is proposed to detect small targets. The framework is composed of Top-Hat transformation and image inpainting. Foremost, Top-Hat with mean filtering detect suspicious target areas. Then, to further refine the targets, a local background estimation is designed into the framework. Moreover, inpainting with diffusion model is employed to obtain the background by the global semantic. Eventually, experimental results on several infrared sequences indicate the proposed framework has an effective detection capability and robustness to different environments.

articleTitle: Real Time Monitoring of Weak Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This study describes a possibility of using magnetoelectric coupling effect to measure ultra-low-frequency weak AC magnetic fields. The research uses a composite structure composed of a PZT piezoelectric body with a size of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{25} \mathbf{mm} \times \mathbf{2}\ \mathbf{mm} \times \mathbf{0.5}\ \mathbf{mm}$</tex> and an appropriate size of magnetostrictive material Metglas as a sensitive element. A Metglas/PZT-5B magnetoelectric coupled sensor with a mechanical resonance frequency <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{f}_{\boldsymbol{r}}$</tex> of 58 kHz was prepared. And a test system was set up to measure the weak AC magnetic field and display it in real time. This system uses the frequency up-conversion technique (FUCT) of ultra-low-frequency magnetic field, combined with hardware devices and software programs, for the magnetoelectric coupled sensor made by this test system, it can test the ultra-low-frequency weak AC magnetic field with a frequency as low as 0.1 nT @ 1 Hz.

articleTitle: A Complex Time Management Method Driven by Composite Event in Cloud Simulation Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: At present, cloud computing related technologies have developed rapidly. Among them, cloud simulation platforms play a vital role in complex military projects. The complex time management under the cloud simulation platform can ensure the normal operation of the relevant test system, thereby promoting the development and progress of defense-related research. In actual engineering projects, each subsystem in the system adopts different time advancing mechanisms. Based on this, this paper studies the complex time management method driven by compound events under the cloud simulation platform. The research content and results are as follows: Based on the characteristics of physical subsystem and logical subsystem, two advancing mechanisms, real-time advancing and logical time advancing are designed; A complex event-driven complex time management method under the cloud simulation platform is designed; Verify the effectiveness of the compound event-driven complex time management method proposed in this paper under the cloud simulation platform.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Skin Disease Recognition System Based on YOLOv5 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Skin diseases are common and frequently morbidities in medicine. This paper focuses on common skin diseases such as acne and dermatitis, and selects deep learning target detection algorithms such as You Only Look Once (YOLOv5), EfficientDet, M2det and single shot multi-box detector (SSD) using cloud and edge end. A skin disease recognition system for rapid identification of skin diseases has been developed for popular science dermatology. In practice, the system quickly recognizes twenty common skin diseases, and the system deployed based on the YOLOv5 algorithm achieves a mean average precision (mAP) of higher than mAP@.5:.95 compared with the algorithm EfficientDet, M2det and SSD. The average mAP value of YOLOv5 is about 8.3 and 3.1% points higher than that of SSD and M2det algorithms, respectively, and more in line with system requirement.

articleTitle: A Direct-solution Method Based on Decoupling Leading Terms Elimination in GNSS Positioning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) has been widely used in many fields, such as positioning, navigation and timing applications. Aiming at the case of four satellites in GNSS positioning, a direct-solution method based on the decoupling leading terms elimination (DLTE) has been developed for positioning calculation in this paper. This method reduces the single-point positioning problem to a simple mathematical problem of finding solutions to a set of equations. In comparison with the traditional Least-squares (LS) method, the method proposed in this paper does not require initial position or iterations. Experiments verify the effectivenss of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Dual-Frequency High-Power Rectifying Metasurface for Microwave Power Transfer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a design for a dual-frequency high-power rectifying metasurface. It comprises a dual-frequency receiving metasurface and a rectifier. The metasurface utilizes an ELC structure and achieves nearly 90% power absorption at both 2.4GHz and 3.5GHz, while consuming minimal energy in the medium and on the surface. The rectifying circuit incorporates GaN HEMT transistors and is designed based on a power amplifier. At an input power of approximately 40dBm, the rectifier demonstrates a high rectification efficiency, reaching 70% at 2.4GHz and 60% at 3.5GHz.

articleTitle: RF Cancellation System Based on Inverse QRD_RLS Weight Extraction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The co-site self-interference is a serious problem on the space-limited and radio system highly integrated combat platforms, presenting urgent needs for the adaptive interference cancellation technology to solve its in-band interference. However, the convergence speed of the traditional method based on ALMS algorithm is greatly affected by the characteristic value of self-interference signal, and it is difficult to meet the demand of microsecond cancellation speed for frequency hopping system. In this paper, a digital-controlled RF self interference cancellation system based on the least squares principle is proposed. Simulink simulation results show that under the same condition, the cancellation speed is increased by one order of magnitude, and the cancellation ratio upper bound is higher when compared with the traditional ALMS algorithm, which proves the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Automatic Report Generation on A Large-Scale Stroke MRI Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Ischemic stroke is a serious disease that endangers human health. Automatic and intelligent report generation from stroke MRI images plays an important role for both patients and doctors. However, there is insufficient data for this task and current report generation methods mainly focusing on chest CT images can hardly apply to stroke diagnosis. To solve these problems, we establish a large-scale ischemic stroke MRI dataset named StrokeQD and propose an automatic stroke MRI report generation method based on a multi-attribute identification and fusion (MAIF) network. This is, as far as we know, the first stroke MRI dataset that includes both professional lesion labeling and clinical physician reports. MAIF uses VarifocalNet to detect lesions on the basis of multiple image input and deformable convolution mechanism to merge global and local features for more detailed attributes. Based on doctors' experience about ischemic stroke, we build a prior knowledge graph, containing two subgraphs, respectively the subordination and rejection relationship between lesion attributes and the priority map of shape and signal attributes. The report is generated by multi-attribute fusion module with natural language logical relevance modeling. The construction procedure of our dataset is elaborated, and the experimental results of automatic report generation proved the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Broadband High Gain Composite VHF Monopole Antenna Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A novel wideband miniaturized composite monopole antenna is proposed, analysed and investigated in detail, where the antenna consists of a conical monopole structure with a loaded capacitive disc. The antenna is composed of multiple nested section, aiming to reduce the profile of the antenna. The loading disc at its top is equivalent to a capacitive structure to improve the antenna matching and the stability of the pattern. According to the simulation results, the impedance bandwidth <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{11}} < -\mathbf{10})$</tex> is 132.9% <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathbf{60.45}\sim \mathbf{300}\ \mathbf{MHz})$</tex>, or even wider. The gain at the entire frequency averages 3 dBi. The performance of the antenna is very suitable for remote wireless communication.

articleTitle: A Low-Profile Ultra-Wideband Wide-Angle Scan Oblique Polarized Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Based on the need of electronic warfare and radar system, an oblique polarized ultra-wideband(UWB) wide angle scanning array antenna is developed. The antenna element chose the banyan tree antenna(BTA), which has much lower profile than the traditional vivaldi antenna. And more additional shorting posts are added to the original BTA to increase more adjustment parameters. The working bandwidth is 3:1, the scan range is full space cone scan <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm 45 \deg$</tex>, and the number of antenna elements is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$16\times 16$</tex>. The antenna is modeled and optimized by HFSS with master-slave periodic boundary in two-dimensional. The active-VSWR test results of the antenna are less 3 at 3:1 working bandwidth when no scan and scan 45deg, the side-lobe with all scan angle are under -12 dB, and the difference between horizontal and vertical polarized main beams is less than 3dB, which can meet the working requirements of the system.

articleTitle: A Coprime-based Sensing Waveform for 5G NR Radar-Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Fifth-generation new radio (5G NR) network techniques will enable high data rate, large bandwidth communication, low latency for application such as autonomous driving. Integrating radar sensing into the standardized 5G NR systems can potentially benefit many consumer applications that require both ratio frequency functions. However, without an effective transmission signal waveform, such integration may not achieve the expected gains of cost and performance of both functions. This paper presents a novel design for transmission signals based on coprime sampling, which satisfies time domain constraints for joint communication and radar sensing application. Specifically, to adapt the physical downlink control channel (PDCCH) and flexible uplink time slots allocation in one slot of five slots, a novel orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) transmitted waveforms based coprime sampling is proposed. Compared with the conventional uniform OFDM-based waveform design, the proposed OFDM-based waveform operates at a reduced cost and complexity by transmitting a reduced number of pulses. Numerical results are provided and demonstrate its effective performance with only forty percent sensing load and moderate complexity.

articleTitle: Fuzzy K-Nearest Neighbor Graph Regularized Non-Negative Matrix Factorization
