publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) is a feature extraction algorithm for extracting features from non-negative data, but NMF puts more emphasis on local information and ignores global information, which leads to limitations in classifying noisy images. To solve this problem, a new method called Fuzzy Graph Regularized Non-Negative Matrix Factorization (FKGNMF) is proposed to integrate fuzzy set theory into the NMF framework. By combining with graph embedding theory, this method can take into account the properties of the global structure of the image, mark the membership degree of the sample with the fuzzy membership degree, and provide fuzzy decisions based on fuzzy labels. The locality and globality of the data are preserved, improving the robustness and accuracy of feature extraction. Experimental evaluations on various bench-mark datasets show that FKGNMF outperforms traditional NMF and other mainstream methods. Compared to other algorithms, this method can increase the recognition rate by 2%-10%.

articleTitle: A Stock Prediction Method Based on Singular Spectrum Analysis and Long Short-Term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: There are lots of noise influence in stock price time series. Therefore, A stock prediction method based on Singular Spectrum Analysis (SSA) and Long Short-Term Memory network (LSTM) is proposed. SSA is used for stock time series denoising since it is appropriate to the nonlinear data denoising. The stock price prediction is realized using LSTM since it can effectively solve the problem of gradient explosion existing in traditional neural networks. To highlight the performance of SSA-LSTM, other different denoising methods are considered: Move Average filtering (MA), Median Filtering (MD) and Locally Weighted Scatterplot Smoothing (LOWESS). Meanwhile, the processed data obtained preprocessed by MA, MD and LOWESS are sent into Back Propagation network (BP), BP network optimized by Genetic Algorithm (GABP), Long Short-Term Memory network (LSTM) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for comparison seperately. Mean Square Error (MSE) and coefficient of determination (R2) are used to evaluate the predicted performance. The experimental results show that the proposed SSA-LSTM has the highest accuracy for stock price prediction.

articleTitle: A High-Precision Temperature Measurement System for Complex Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: For the problems of electromagnetic interference and low temperature measurement accuracy encountered in the current operation of moving vehicles, this paper proposes a high-precision temperature measurement system based on a high-precision constant-current source and filtering electromagnetic interference. To achieve high precision, anti-interference temperature measurement system design, the single power supply constant current source power supply platinum resistance temperature measurement scheme, and in the signal acquisition part of the use of high-precision analog-to-digital conversion measurement module two strategies are used. Experiments reveal that the absolute temperature inaccuracy of this system's temperature measuring circuit is less than O.I°C, and the error of the anti-interference circuit in the conducted disturbance immunity experiment is less than O.I°C.

articleTitle: Dynamic Resources Management Under Limited Communication Based on Multi-level Agent System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Under the condition of limited communication, the message interaction between different platforms cannot meet the demand of realtime and integrality, which significantly reduces the task-execution efficiency. Aiming at making full use of all kinds of payloads resources in the dynamically changing environment, we use a multilevel agent system model to describe the control relationship between different types of platforms and payloads, and propose an improved contract net protocol to coordinate tasks that different platforms need to undertake and manage different payloads of a platform. The experiment results of the semi-physical simulation show that the proposed method can efficiently assign the required resources to the dynamic tasks while interacting with little information between different platforms.

articleTitle: Perfect Vortex Beam Based Metasurface in Microwave Band
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A perfect vortex beam is a beam with a constant radius regardless of its topological charge, and it may find significant applications in wireless communications systems, radar systems, and imaging systems. This paper introduces a novel perfect vortex beam operating in the microwave band, offering independent modulation of electromagnetic waves in X-polarization. This approach offers advantages such as miniaturization and reduced weight compared to conventional methods.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Link 16 Message Distribution in Operational Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Data link is an information system conforming to specified message formats and communication protocols that links combat units such as sensors, weapons, and command and control (C2) platforms. It could automatically share formatted tactical data, for instance, battlefield situation, command and guidance, tactical coordination and weapon control instructions among combat participants in real time. As a typical data link, Link 16 has been the major means of information dissemination in joint tactical operations of the US military, and has played an important role in all previous wars over the past decades. Link 16 is capable of achieving interoperability and realizing various tactical functions for all combat participants based on unified information distribution and processing mechanisms. This paper investigates message exchanging procedure and applies discrete event system specification (DEVS) method in modeling and simulation (M&S) of information distribution in air interception operations. The experimental results show that the method can be widely applied to modeling information distribution with good scalability. It is able to provide technical reference for subsequent information processing optimization.

articleTitle: Thermal Analysis Model Inside MOSFETs Under HPEMPs Based on the Thermal Flux Boundary Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: On the foundation of the previous research on the thermal failure process, a new thermal analysis model based on the thermal flux boundary condition is derived theoretically in this article. Equations derived based on the thermal flux BC are provided. Results obtained from the theoretical model are compared with the numerical simulation results obtained from the numerical software. The comparison shows that the analysis results of the thermal model based on thermal flux BC are in good agreement with the numerical simulation results. At the same time, the results also agrees well with the results obtained based on the first type BC which used in previous work. The correctness of this model is verified through the comparisons. This analysis model is useful for further failure estimating of MOSFETs and other devices under HPEMP.

articleTitle: Improve the Security of Bandwidth Utilization of Legitimate Users
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In the field of wireless communication, the signals transmitted by mobile devices are vulnerable to illegal eavesdropping by illegal eavesdroppers and blocked by obstacles. By using wireless mobile devices combined with intelligent reflectors, the signals transmitted through the transmitter have certain stability and flexibility in the process of transmission. This process is to adjust the amplitude and phase of the signals between the transmitter and receiver. Therefore, this paper proposes a model to improve the security of MIMO mobile devices with intelligent reflector. By establishing the reflection model, and then using the mathematical equation to obtain the maximum channel utilization rate, the results are derived, and the advantages of the security of the intelligent reflector are compared through simulation.

Author Keywords: smart reflector wireless communication com munication security channel utilization

articleTitle: Optimizations of Authentication Algorithm for Space Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Nowadays, space communication finds its applications in all fields of life; therefore, providing security for space communication is becoming more and more important. Data security algorithms, such as data authentication algorithms, provide the ability for the communicating system to identify the users. As a result, data authentication algorithms offer services for data authenticity and integrity. Besides, data authentication algorithms are often used with data encryption algorithms; As a result, adopting cipher-based authentication will allow for more effective use of the data security techniques while requiring less implementation space. A popular cipher-based authentication algorithm is the Cipher-based Message Authentication Code (CMAC). The CMAC algorithm's throughput is constrained, nonetheless, by its serial architecture. The CMAC algorithm is given a parallel authentication technique in this work, which increases the algorithm's throughput. Further, the throughput can be further improved by using the reduced rounds Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm as an optimization. In addition, the space radiation tolerant implementation is proposed for the AES algorithm that is used in the CMAC algorithm as a block cipher. The proposed technique is implemented on the hardware and software with optimizations, which should boost throughput. The proposed algorithm provides significant improvement in throughput as compared to previous algorithms.

articleTitle: DOA Estimation of Two Adjacent Targets with MVDR Method by Using the Acoustic Vector Sensor Coprime Array
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Coprime arrays may provide a larger array aperture without increasing the number of physical sensors. In the field of acoustic scalar senser coprime array (AS-CA), the traditional direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation algorithms often cannot distinguish two adjacent targets very well, because they do not have enough angular resolution. To solve this problem, this paper introduces the acoustic vector sensor (AVS) techniques to the coprime array signal processing area. Firstly, the AVS's acoustic pressure and particle velocity components are processed together, and a part of the noise in the particle velocity components is filtered out. Then, the MVDR method is applied to the coprime array field. Finally, simulation results verify the performance improvement of the devised schemes.

articleTitle: A Multi-Band Antenna Design for WLAN and WiMAX Communication Protocols
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To meet the requirement of multi-band transmitssion in wireless communication systems, a compact broadband dual-band antenna is designed for the WLAN and WiMAX frequency bands in this paper. The antenna mainly consists of a rectangular ring and two tridents. Good impedance match is obtained in the operating frequency bands by adding an arch structure with circular defects on the ground plane, forming a defective ground. In order to obtain the miniaturized size of the structure, operating frequency bands with good impedance match are optimized by using parameter scanning. The antenna has the advantages of good radiation performance, wide frequency band, high gain, as well as small size and simple structure. Experiment results have been verified our design. The antenna covers very well over the WLAN and WiMAX all frequency bands.

articleTitle: Segmental Resonator Loaded Transmission Line for Robust Crack Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Crack defects widely exist in metallic structures due to cycling stress, and the uncertainty of their locations brings challenges in detection. This paper proposes a sensor design approach to improve the coverage and consistency of crack detection. By serially loading the split ring resonator under the transmission line in a meander format, the coupling effect between the resonant units is weakened. A cap design is carried out at the gap of the split ring resonator. By this way, four sensing regions form to a near length of λ / 2. The crack depth detection sensitivity of each region is -14MHz/mm2. The proposed sensor overcomes the limited coverage of single resonator and the sensitivity limitation varying with position.

articleTitle: Design of Hybrid Continuous Class F Doherty Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This article designs an F-class Doherty amplifier in mixed continuous operation mode. By improving the drain voltage equation on the basis of continuous F-class power amplifiers, it maintains high efficiency characteristics in a wide range of impedance space. Combining the Doherty structure, the traditional 1/4 wavelength impedance variation line is removed, and a smaller power amplifier impedance is pulled. A Chebyshev low-pass filter is used to achieve input and output matching circuit, and a step impedance form of post matching circuit is used to improve saturation efficiency and bandwidth. After physical testing, the overall operating frequency of the power amplifier is between <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{1.7\sim 2.7\text{GHz}}$</tex>) the relative bandwidth is 45.5%, the saturation output power is between <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{45.3\text{dBm}\sim 46.4\text{dBm}}$</tex>, the saturated efficiency is between <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{59\%\sim 69.4\%}$</tex>, the back-off interval around 6.5dB, the back-off efficiency is between <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{41\% \sim 51.2\%}$</tex>.

Author Keywords: Mixed continuous Class F power amplifier

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Precoding for MIMO-OFDM Based Visible Light Communication System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A novel hybrid precoding technique is proposed for multiple input multiple output (MIMO) orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) based visible light communication (VLC) systems to address the adverse effect of memory non-linearity and high correlation of typical indoor channel. Our insight is to leverage the well-designed unitary matrix to average the degradation of sub-carrier data and utilize the singular value decomposition-based precoding to spread the correlated channel into independent parallel sub-channel. In addition, an analytical characterization of signal to nonlinear distortion and background noise ratio is presented to reveal the internal relation among nonlinear distortions, channel correlation and system performance. The bit error rate (BER) of the proposed scheme is investigated via detailed numerical simulations. Excellent BER results indicate that the proposed scheme can reduce the influence of nonlinear distortion and show relative robustness to the channel correlation to some extent, demonstrating the prospect and validity of this methodology.

articleTitle: A Wideband Circularly Polarized Antenna with Non-Uniform Metasurface Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to improve the handset receiver performance, a wideband circularly polarized antenna is designed in this paper. A truncated square patch is used as a driving element to generate circularly polarized wave. Then a non-uniform metasurface structure is used to obtain the wider band; and the characteristic mode analysis is performed on the structure. By loading trapezoidal base and ‘Feng’ font matching branch, the surface wave on the non-uniform metasurface can be better excited. Thus, the axial ratio bandwidth and the impedance bandwidth have been improved efficiently. Experiment results show that the designed antenna is with a good left-handed circularly polarized radiation property; and it can be used in satellite communication.

articleTitle: Measurement and Analysis of Materials EM Parameters for Aviation Cabin Scenario
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Scattering and transmission properties related to the electromagnetic (EM) parameters of materials are important for understanding radio propagation. In this paper, a set of measurement campaigns are conducted to measure the electromagnetic parameters of three kinds of general aeronautical materials, including chromium molybdenum steel (Cr-Mo Steel), aluminium- 7A04 (Al-7A04) and phenolic resin at 55–65 GHz, aiming to explore the electromagnetic parameters of these materials at mmWave band. The results obtained in this paper are expected to offer guidance to get accurate channel models by ray tracing, which can help the design of the wireless communication network in the aviation cabin scenario at mmWave band.

articleTitle: Comparison of Deep Learning Classifiers for the Sudden-Death Positions in Connect6
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Board games can be used as a tool for training logic, which has a positive effect on the science popularization education. Connect6 is a very popular puzzle game because it is a fair and highly complex game with simple rules. The objective of this study is to investigate the essential technical challenges involved in constructing a game-based logical learning system for the Connect6 program using deep neural networks, and this study focuses on the comparison of classic deep learning classifiers for the sudden-death positions in Connect6. Our contributions include the followings: 1) Proposing Connect6Net, a deep learning model designed to determine sudden-death positions in Connect6. 2) Experimental results demonstrate superior performance of the Connect6 model with Dense Block technology, compared to its counterpart using Res Block technology. 3) In scenarios with fewer parameters, the model employing SqNxt block technology (C6N-D-s) outperforms its three counterparts.

articleTitle: A Contactless Testing Method for Parasitic Capacitance of UHF RFID Tag
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A contactless testing approach is proposed to evaluate the parasitic capacitance of ultra-high frequency(UHF) radio frequency identification (RFID) tag. The parasitic capacitance introduced when assembling the UHF RFID tag chip to the antenna results in performance deviation of the tag. This parasitic capacitance affects the accuracy of tag simulation design and leads to the detuning of the RFID tag. This paper presents the analysis of parasitic capacitance through theoretical derivation and experimental investigations. The method is established based on the equivalent circuit model of the UHF RFID tag and the expression of the parasitic capacitance. The measured results show that the simulated resonance frequency, taking into account the parasitic capacitance, closely matches the measured resonance frequency. This study can provide a valuable reference for the good design of the UHF RFID tag.

articleTitle: Real-Valued Feedback Digital Predistortion Based on QR Decomposition Sample Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The digital predistortion technique is effective in balancing the efficiency of the power amplifier and the linearity of the output signal, but it also brings a notable hardware cost and computational effort. In this paper, we propose a new DPD architecture that combines a sample selection technique based on QR decomposition with a digital predistorter over a single feedback signal. The method achieves the goal of reducing the computational effort of DPD parameters while optimizing the DPD system architecture by selecting a representative set of samples on a single feedback signal link. The experimental results show that the DPD structure still has good pre-distortion effect while retaining 38% of the original signal data set.

articleTitle: Human Identification Based on Gaits Analysis Using Sensors-Based Data Bands
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: We all have such learning experiences that our teachers told us that there were no two identical leaves in the world. Based on this, this paper proposes that since there are no two identical leaves in the world, so as that no two people in the world have the same walking postures and gaits. In this study, a human identification system based on gait analysis via sensors-based data bands was introduced. The data bands were affixed to knee joints and calf for human gaits detection. The human gaits detection method was performed based on multi-sensor data fusion, and calculation method based on Cartesian geometric coordinates. In addition, experimental results show that the human gaits were accurately detected, and the human identities were accurately identified by the proposed methods. Moreover, the classifier is applied to output the final human identification ordinary category of people.

articleTitle: Intelligent Optimization Method for Mobile NOMA Network using IMBO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) technology can significantly increase access volume and spectrum efficiency. The introduction of NOMA technology into the mobile communication system can significantly enhance communication performance. The power allocation technology can greatly improve the performance of NOMA systems and has become a research hotspot. However, many research schemes currently have many problems, such as poor system performance and inability to balance between user fairness and service quality. Therefore, this article studies the intelligent optimization for mobile NOMA network using improved Monarch Butterfly Optimization Algorithm(IMBO). First, an <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{N}-\mathbf{Nakagami}$</tex> channel-based mobile cooperative NOMA multi-user network is established. Then, considering the non-ideal communication condition, namely imperfect channel state information (ICSI), the exact expressions of outage probability (OP) for the mobile cooperative NOMA multi-user communication system are derived, and the relation between user power allocation coefficient and the performance of OP is investigated. Finally, an optimization algorithm of power allocation based on the IMBO is put forward, which can get the optimal power allocation coefficient. Simulation results indicate that, compared to the monarch butterfly optimization algorithm(MBO), the artificial fish swarm algorithm(AFSA), and the firefly algorithm(FA), the IMBO is at least 30% more efficient, thereby enhancing the performance of the communication system.

articleTitle: Demodulation of Unitary Space-Time Modulated Signals Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Underwater acoustic channel is a frequency selective fading channel with severe multipath effect and significant Doppler shift, which greatly limits the performance of underwater acoustic communication system. Unitary space-time modulation (USTM) technology can achieve considerable diversity gain for underwater acoustic communication, and no channel state information is required to avoid spectrum resource waste. Signal demodulation is a key step to achieve reliable communication. In underwater acoustic communication, using traditional methods to demodulate USTM signals has high complexity and high bit error rate. This paper proposes a demodulation method CNN-GRU based on convolutional neural network and recurrent neural network for USTM. By fitting the mapping between the received signal and the likelihood information, demodulate the received signals of different constellation points. Simulation experiments show that the proposed demodulation method based on deep learning is superior to the traditional demodulation method, with a signal-to-noise ratio gain of about 0.6 dB and better adaptability to the channel environment.

articleTitle: A Wideband Monopole Antenna with LC Matching for DOA Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A wideband monopole antenna with LC matching is presented in this letter for passive direction finding. The proposed antenna is a kind of omnidirectional antenna, which is applied in Watson-Watt radio direction finding system to find out the location of the signal sources. The designed antenna model is suitable for vehicle location system, which consists of three perfect conductor pieces, LC matching and a structure of inverted triangular in shape. Wherein, the inverted triangle structure and three capacitors can broaden the bandwidth when the monopole antenna operating. The measured impedance bandwidth ranges from 1.22 GHz to 9.44 GHz <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{(S11 < -10{dB})}$</tex>. The structure could be applied in radars and other vehicle direction finding systems.

articleTitle: Application of Windowed ICA-Based Clutter Removal Method to Microwave Breast Multi-Tumor System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a windowed ICA-based clutter removal method (WICD) for microwave breast multi-tumor systems to address the challenge of skin clutter affecting the localization and imaging quality of tumors. The method involves adding a window to the signal to find the entropy and using independent component analysis to decompose the tumor signal, followed by imaging using the delayed multiplication algorithm. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm improves the imaging accuracy of marginal and multiple tumors while suppressing skin clutter to enhance imaging quality.

articleTitle: A Developer Recommendation Algorithm Based on Multi-Relationship Knowledge Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In recent years, collaborative software development has gradually become an emerging software development model. However, with the continuous development of crowdsourcing platforms, the problem of information overload has become increasingly serious, and it has become crucial to recommend suitable developers for tasks. Traditional recommendation methods face two major challenges: first, the text features of tasks and developers are highly concise and contain a large number of entities; second, tasks are one-time and explicit interactive data is sparse. To solve these challenges, this paper proposes a developer recommendation algorithm based on multi-relationship knowledge enhancement. We identify entities and contextual entities from text features and link the relationship between tasks and developers from a knowledge perspective. In addition, we treat developers' participation in registering, submitting, and winning tasks as different preferences, and assign different weights to each relationship. Finally, we enhance developers' feature representation using multi-relationship neighborhood aggregation. We conducted extensive experiments on a real Topcoder dataset, and the results show that our method is significantly better than the other four comparison methods in accuracy and MRR.

articleTitle: Design of Ka-Band Power Combining Network Based on High-Order Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper investigates the power combining network in Ka band based on TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</inf>mode using waveguide structure. By taking advantage of the isolation provided by TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</inf>mode itself, the power combining network is designed based on TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</inf>mode, achieving isolation between ports in the first combining stage without introducing matching loads, thus enabling high efficiency combining. A four-way Ka-band power combining network is designed using a ridge waveguide planar wall waveguide magic T, an improved TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>-TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</inf>mode converter based on vertical excitation, a waveguide-microstrip double-probe transition structure based on TE20 mode, and an H-plane to E-plane waveguide transition structure. The back-to-back passive network is processed and tested, achieving a combining efficiency of over 80% and a port return loss of better than -15dB in the frequency range of 29-36.5GHz, with a loss of about 0.5dB for the back-to-back network.

articleTitle: Edge-Preserving Multi-Exposure Fusion with Guided Filtering for Structural Patch Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Multi-exposure image fusion (MEF) is one of the effective ways to obtain high dynamic range (HDR) images. Multi-scale structural patch decomposition based MEF(MSPD) and edge-preserving structural patch decomposition (MESPD) have achieved state-of-the-art fusion quality. MESPD incorporates edge-preserving factors into MSPD to preserve details in a single-scale setting. However, we find that the edge-preserving factors put too much emphasis on the edge, resulting in artifacts on some edges and loss of details. To tackle this issue, guided filter is introduced into MSPD, which is directly used as an edge-preserving filter instead of mean filter to implicitly decompose images. In addition, we have designed a flexible adaptive weight, which can further maintain details of the light and dark areas. Likewise, we inherit MESPD and MSPD to extend our method to multi-scale framework. Extensive experimental results demonstrate our method can produce satisfactory results in both static and dynamic scenes with fewer artifacts and low computational cost.

articleTitle: Design of Filter Based on Loaded Dielectric Ridge Gap Waveguide Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a U-band bandpass filter based on loaded dielectric ridge waveguide. By replacing the air layer with a dielectric substrate and integrating an air gap waveguide structure, a dual-layer U-band ridge gap waveguide is designed. To verify the feasibility of this waveguide technology applied in filter design, a half-wavelength resonator based on the loaded dielectric ridge gap waveguide technology is designed. Finally, the waveguide technology is combined with microstrip structures to simulate and design a U-band third-order half-wavelength coupled resonator bandpass filter and a parallel-coupled microstrip filter. To improve the filter's high selectivity, a U-band bandpass filter with a three-pole capacitor-type cross-coupled structure is designed. The center frequency of the designed filters is 55GHz, with an insertion loss of less than 3 dB in the passband, a return loss S11 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{< -15\text{dB}}$</tex>., and an out-of-band suppression of 30dB when the filter's rectangular coefficient reaches 3:1.

articleTitle: Implementation of Binocular Stereo Matching in Virtual Environment and its Application in Manipulator Grasping
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a simulation method that uses a virtual binocular camera to accomplish binocular vision positioning algorithm, and uses the method to let the manipulator locate and grab a block in the simulation environment. The simulation process is run under CoppeliaSim. The intrinsic parameter matrix and extrinsic parameter matrix of the virtual camera were derived by simulating the binocular camera. The obtained scene pictures are processed by the SGBM algorithm to generate the point cloud and obtain the coordinates of the target point. The virtual camera model is based on the ZED2i, and the manipulator uses UR5.

articleTitle: A Radar Signal Modulation Recognition Algorithm Based on Multi-branch Fusion Difference
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The time-frequency images of radar modulation signals are similar at low signal-to-noise ratios, which will lead to lower recognition accuracy. This paper proposes an algorithm based on multi-branch fusion differences to identify radar modulation signals. The algorithm designs a multi-branch fusion differential module based on the attention mechanism and differential thinking, to extract time-frequency image fine-grained features and improve the Convolution Neural Network characterization ability. After that, a dual-branch differential network is proposed by combining vanilla convolution and multi-branch fusion difference module. The network can fuse global and detailed features of time-frequency images, which can achieve radar signal modulation recognition. The simulation results show that the recognition accuracy of the algorithm can reach 93.17% at 0dB. Therefore, the algorithm can obtain high recognition accuracy and has high recognition performance.

articleTitle: Design of a Broadband Low-Noise Amplifier Operating at 8-10 GHz with High Gain and Favorable Gain Flatness
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A broadband low-noise amplifier (LNA) designed for the 8-10GHz wireless communication frequency range was developed based on the 180nm CMOS process. The overall circuit adopts a two-stage self-biasing common source-common gate (cascode) structure to improve gain. A parallel feedback circuit is employed to extend the bandwidth, and gain compensation techniques are utilized for interstage matching to improve gain flatness. The simulation results show that within the range of 8-10GHz, the gain is greater than 26.63dB, a flatness fluctuation of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\pm 0.44}\mathbf{dB}$</tex>, and a maximum noise figure below 2.78dB. The power consumption is 18.2mW, and the chip area is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{529.21} \mathbf{um} \times \mathbf{5 8 9. 5 3 u m}$</tex> include RF pad.

articleTitle: Design of a Wideband Dual-Polarized Antenna for 2G/3G/LTE/5G Base Station
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposed a wide band dual-polarized antenna, which can be applied to 2G/3G/LTE/5G base stations. The antenna mainly consists of two crossed dipoles in the shape of “cat-ear” that are perpendicular to each other and there is a disk-shape array above the antenna. Each dipole is fed by a stub connected directly to the coaxial line. In this way, the feeding networks are located in the same plane to avoid extra metal via. Simulated results show that a bandwidth of 69.1% (1.75-3.6 GHz, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\vert \mathbf{S}_{11}\vert < -10$</tex> dB) with a gain of 8.1 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm$</tex> 0.5 dBi can be achieved in the -45º polarized direction, whereas another bandwidth of 68.4% (1.76-3.59 GHz, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\vert \mathbf{S}_{11}\vert < -10$</tex> dB) with a gain of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$7.9\pm 0^{0.7}$</tex> dBi can also be realized. In addition, low cross polarization (X-pol) and good port isolation are achieved.

articleTitle: Retinal vessel segmentation algorithm based on deformable U-net
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The retinal vessel is a very important organ in the medical field, and their morphology and structure can be one of the key diagnostic indicators for many diseases. Due to the complex structure of vessels and the low contrast between vessels and the background in most fundus images, current retinal vessel segmentation algorithms are prone to problems such as low segmentation accuracy and failure to identify fine blood vessels or vessel endings. To address these problems, this paper improves the U-net by replacing standard convolutional kernels with deformable convolutional kernels at some levels of the network, and introduces a channel attention module to enhance the feature extraction of vessel structures, then uses Softpool to retain more of the original image information. This proposed method was applied to public datasets DRIVE for experiments. And it compares the experimental result metrics with those of the original U-net and its several upgraded methods. The results show that the method in this paper achieves better segmentation results.

articleTitle: Radar Small-Sample Working Pattern Recognition Based On Domain Adaptation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The number of radar working pattern samples is relatively small under non-cooperative environments, which will significantly degrade the performance of traditional deep learning recognition. This paper proposes an improved working pattern recognition algorithm based on domain adaptation to address the issue of minor sample conditions. We first present a barcode preprocessing method for converting 1D data to 2D data based on data mapping theory. Then, the support vector machine classifier is improved by fusing Chebyshev metric distance and radial basis function. Finally, the classifier is trained using the extracted features, which are obtained by transferring different layers of the InceptionNeXt model. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is superior to the traditional algorithm and can effectively improve the recognition accuracy of small-sample working patterns.

articleTitle: Fuel Consumption Prediction Model Based on Segmentation of Ship's Voyage Trajectory Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, an intelligent ship fuel consumption monitoring system that collects key parameters of the ship is designed, and the segmented data processing is carried out for the collected ship voyage trajectory, and the processed data are used as input for wind speed, port draft, starboard draft, current speed, port rudder angle and ship speed to ground, and the ship fuel consumption data are used as output for modeling and analysis using an artificial neural network model to predict the fuel consumption level under different voyage conditions to support further optimization of the ship fuel consumption in voyage.

articleTitle: The Enhancement of Inductance and Q-factor in Micro-magnetic Inductors by Self-biased FeCoB Thin Films
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, the design, manufacture and performance test of inductors based on FeCoB thin films are studied. Firstly, FeCoB films were prepared by physical vapor deposition. Then, inductors with different turns were prepared on the substrate by micromachining technology. Finally, the inductor characteristics are characterized by microwave detector and vector network analyzer. The results show that the inductance and quality factor of the prepared thin film inductors are greatly improved and the self-resonant frequency is maintained.

articleTitle: Average BLERs Analysis of Downlink NOMA Short-Packet Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper examines a two-user downlink non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) short-packet communication system in flat Rayleigh fading channels. To accurately assess the average block error rate (BLER) of the system, novel methodologies utilizing two-dimensional inverse Laplace transform are introduced, in contrast to existing works that either neglect or provide a lower bound for the product term. Additionally, a rigorous theoretical derivation of the approximation expression for the product term in the downlink NOMA system is presented. The efficacy of the derived expressions is validated through comprehensive numerical results.

articleTitle: Broadband Chiral Metasurface for Spin-Selective Anomalous Reflection and Absorption
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Chiral metasurface has attracted great amounts of interest for spin-selective wave-front manipulation of electromagnetic waves yet it still faces challenges. Here, a novel circular dichroism unit cell is reported. Lumped resistors are integrated into the I-shaped split ring to break n-fold (n>2) rotational symmetries, which introduces broadband spin- independent absorption and provides an auxiliary degree of freedom for developing spin-selective meta-devices. As validation, a gradient metasurface is theoretically simulated. From 10 to 16 GHz, the incident left-handed circularly polarized waves are converted into their orthogonal polarization and anomalously reflected. In contrast, the incident right-handed circularly polarized waves are almost completely absorbed. Our work may find applications in multi-functional systems.

articleTitle: Clothes Color Segmentation Based on Channel Attention Module
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper studies a color segmentation network for mixed-color clothes based on BiSeNet V2. Aiming at the color category segmentation error in BiSeNet V2, the CAM_BiSeNet V2 network model is designed, and the channel attention module is added before the context embedding block in the semantic branch of BiSeNet V2. The selection of channels is integrated to achieve a better representation of the features in the channel dimension. The experimental results show that this algorithm can effectively improve the segmentation accuracy of the model, and the segmentation accuracy rate is increased by 10.61% (91.19% vs 80.58<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>)

articleTitle: Simutaneous Reductions of Cross-Polarization and Mutual Coupling of Microstrip Antenna Array With Combined Defected Ground Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a novel defected ground structure (DGS) scheme located underneath the patch is proposed to reduce cross-polarization. A simple schematic analysis and the design guidelines are presented. A decoupling scheme combined with the proposed DGS is applied to an E-plane linear four-element array to verify the effectiveness of the methodology. Through the experimental verification of the prototype, the cross-polarization and coupling of the microstrip array are effectively reduced.

articleTitle: Dual-Beam Frequency-Scanning Leaky-Wave Antenna Based on Composite Slow-Wave Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this research, we propose a dual-beam frequency-scanning leaky-wave antenna that utilizes a composite slow-wave waveguide. The composite slow-wave waveguide is created by integrating double-layer symmetrical spoof surface plasmon polaritons structures on both sides of the half-mode substrate integrated waveguide to support a composite slow-wave mode. To achieve the desired dual-beam radiation pattern, periodic circular patches are placed on both sides of the composite slow-wave waveguide. These circular radiation patches are coupled electromagnetically with the slow-wave waveguide. Additionally, a rectangular copper patch is introduced in the antenna design to reduce interference between the two radiation beams. Using simulation, we demonstrate that the proposed leaky-wave antenna achieves continuous beam-scanning within an operating frequency range of 9–11 GHz, with angles of 54° and 55° for the upper and lower beams, respectively.

articleTitle: A Microstrip Magnetic Dipole Antenna with Reconfigurable Beamwidth
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a novel microstrip magnetic dipole (MD) antenna with reconfigurable beamwidth. The proposed design is composed of a microstrip magnetic antenna and two metal planes. The angle of the metal planes is adjustable, and the metal planes are used as a reconfigurable corner reflector. As the angle varies, the reflection coefficients in the operating band (5.67-5.91GHz) are retained below −10dB, and the E-plane half-power beamwidth (HPBW) varies from 37° to 142°. The maximum gain of 12.1 dBi is obtained when the beamwidth is 37°, and the minimum gain of 8.9 dBi is obtained when the beamwidth is 142°. The proposed design is a good candidate for base station applications to enhance traffic capacity.

articleTitle: Slow-Varying Measurement Outlier Mitigation Method for HVC-Assisted SINS/DVL Navigation Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Underwater Doppler Velocity Log (DVL) measurement is susceptible to slow changes owing to interference from forced maneuvers, ditches and fish shoals under uncharted ocean environments, where mismatched measurement model may affect navigation performance of SINS/DVL navigation applications. To solve such problems, an enhanced Kalman filtering method based on adaptive measurement noise estimation technique is proposed in this paper. By designing a centripetal acceleration errors-reinforced holonomic velocity constraint (HVC) and the adaptive Sage-Husa approach, the parameters of the Kalman filter are adjusted online to maintain the system stability and filtering accuracy, which contributes to the measurement outlier mitigation in SINS/DVL navigation applications. The sea trial of autonomous underwater glider (AUG) reveals the proposed method is resistant to external disturbances and maintains the filter convergence in uncharted ocean environments while providing more accurate position estimates than existing methods.

articleTitle: Low Power Intelligent Warehouse Management System Based on Lora
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With the expansion of the company's business scale, the types and quantities of goods stored in the warehouse are increasing, and warehouse management is becoming more complex and diverse. The traditional manual warehouse management mode relies excessively on the experience of employees, which makes it difficult to meet the requirements of modern warehouse management such as speed and accuracy. In order to meet the efficiency of modern warehouse management, this paper designs a low-power intelligent warehouse management system based on STM32 microcontroller, Lora module and e-ink screen. The system enables remote warehouse management, such as remote modification of label information of target goods, etc. It also enables warehouse personnel to find target goods quickly by working with roadway lights and buzzers. In addition, the system can also remotely upgrade the APP program of the label board. The whole system is flexible in application and has a long data transmission distance, which can effectively solve the traditional warehouse management mode problems brought about by the traditional warehouse management model, thus driving the development of the warehousing industry.

articleTitle: Mobile Game Recommendation Based on Clustering Reliable Reviews
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Mobile games are a popular form of entertainment that attract many users, but it is a difficult problem to find the right game from a large number of games. Mobile game community platforms such as TapTap provide player ratings and reviews functions to help users understand the quality and features of games, but there are a lot of fake reviews among them, which may lead to users making wrong choices. In this paper, we propose a Clustering-based Reliable Review Recommender Model (CRRRM) for this problem. The model comprehensively uses the text, the attributes of reviewers and reviews, filters out reliable reviews from unlabeled data through fuzzy C-means algorithm, and then makes recommendations. We collect more than 400 thousand mobile game reviews data on the TapTap platform for experiments. The results show that our model significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art baseline model in recommendation performance.

articleTitle: High-Resolution Spectral Estimation Method for Transient Signals Based on AR Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Transient noise, which often occurs in the case of the sudden state change of the water surface or underwater targets, is the main source of the radiated noise for the quiet submarines and ships. This paper proposes an auto-regressive (AR) spectral estimation method based on the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha-\beta$</tex> filtering to accurately identify and analyze the transient noise. The mathematical model of the transient noise is first constructed according to inherent characteristics of the transient noise. Then, the transient signal is truncated in the time-domain, and the AR parameters of each segment data are estimated. In order to eliminate the frequency jump between data segments, the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha-\beta$</tex> filter is introduced in this method to modify the AR parameters, as a result of obtaining the time-frequency spectral with the high accurate and resolution. Finally, simulation results show the superior advantages of this method over other methods in terms of the resolution and accuracy, which is verified by the lake experiment.

articleTitle: Mining Frequent Closed Itemsets and Generators Over Uncertain Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The rapid development of computer technology and the widespread use of Internet products have already led us into the era of big data, and researchers are increasingly focused on developing advanced data mining techniques to extract valuable insights from large datasets. Frequent itemset mining refers to mining the frequently occurring itemsets in data, which is a reliable method to get useful information from a large amount of data and is used on the Internet, finance, medical and other fields. But as a rule, the number of frequent itemsets extracted from data is exponential, which reduces the usefulness of mining results. To achieve the compressed representation of frequent itemsets, researchers have proposed the concept of frequent closed itemsets, which are greatly reduced in number compared to frequent itemsets and retain the integrity of the information contained in frequent itemsets. In this paper, we propose an algorithm for mining closed itemsets and generators in uncertain data, which can be divided into two steps. First, all probabilistic frequent itemsets are mined, and then, based on the probabilistic frequent itemsets, the closed itemsets and generators among them are identified. And the closed itemsets and generators are associated based on the concept of equivalence classes. The algorithm is proved to be correct and efficient after evaluation on several datasets.

articleTitle: Design of Horn Array Antenna for 24GHz Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a horn array antenna applied to 24GHz radar is implemented. The size of the whole antenna array is 95mm × 45mm × 17.12mm. The realizability and precision of machining are fully considered in the design. The feed network layer is amplitude weighted in the direction of polarization to suppress the sidelobe. The amplitude distribution is realized by the unequal power component of the T-node of the waveguide. The measured results show that the Voltage Standing Wave Ratio (VSWR) of the antenna array is less than 1.5 in the frequency band of 24~24.2GHz, and the normal gain of the whole band beam is more than 21dBi, which meets the practical application requirements in real life.

articleTitle: UAV-Mounted RIS Assisted UAV Communications Incorporating NOMA: Performance Evaluation and Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Reconfigurable intelligence surface (RIS) and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) has been recently applied in mobile edge computing (MEC) networks to enhance communication capacity. However, scatterers often obstruct the channel between UAV and user equipment (UE), causing poor quality of service in urban scenarios. To tackle this problem, this paper proposes and evaluates UAV-mounted RIS (U-RIS) assisted UAV communications incorporating non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) networks. The UE's transmit power, the RIS's phase shift, and the UAV and U-RIS's trajectories are jointly optimized for maximizing the communication capacity of the considered networks. The block coordinate descent (BCD)-based iterative algorithm is developed to solve the joint non-convex optimization problem. The grid search (GS) method is used for trajectory optimation. Numerical results show that the NOMA scheme has significantly improved the communication capacity, but RIS has limited gain.

Author Keywords: unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted reconfigurable intelligent surface

articleTitle: Finger-inspired Tactile Sensor for Three-axis Force Perception and Slip Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: It is crucial for intelligent robots to acquire tactile sensing information to achieve stable grasping of objects. Rich real-time tactile information needs to be collected to improve the performance of manipulators during tactile exploration and object manipulation. However, existing tactile sensors have the relatively low spatial resolution. In this paper, a flexible tactile sensor array with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3 \times 3$</tex> sensing cells was proposed with high spatial resolution, which can be easily worn on the hand to obtain tactile sensing information. The proposed tactile sensor array has a finger-like three-layer structure, including a bottom information reading layer, a middle conductive layer, and a top PDMS buffer layer. Among them, the conductive layer is fabricated using polydimethylsiloxane(PDMS)/multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs)/molybdenum disulfide <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\boldsymbol{(\text{MoS}_{2})/\text{silver}}}$</tex> particles(Ag) composites as sensing materials. The fabricated tactile sensor array has high sensitivity and excellent stability. The sensitivity is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.63\times 10^{-1}\text{kPa}^{-1}$</tex> in the low-pressure range (0–4 kPa) and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3.96 \times 10^{-4}\text{kPa}^{-1}$</tex> in the high-pressure range (5–143 kPa). In addition, cyclic load-unload tests reveal that the sensor is excellent stability, with the sensor maintaining its signal detection after 11,000 cycles of compression at 60 kPa pressure. Benefiting from the finger-like structure and superior performance, when grasping an object with a dummy hand fitted with an array of flexible tactile sensors, the three-axis force applied to the object can be detected and it can successfully detect slipping when grasping objects. The sensor also has the function of human health monitoring, such as monitoring human wrist pulses and carotid arteries. Therefore, the presented flexible tactile sensor array can simultaneously detect the three-axis force and slip state of the object, enabling dexterous control of the object.

articleTitle: Temperature Control Optimization of Electrically Tobacco Product System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This study addresses the issue of inaccurate resistance values of heating elements at room temperature and proposes the optimization and design of electrically heated tobacco products (eHTP) heater system. The system employs short-duration pulses to measure the resistance of the heating elements. By comparing the measurement results with the actual values, the optimized system achieves accurate resistance measurement with an overall error within 0.5%. Subsequently, physical testing was conducted on systems using the measurement results and average resistance values. The results demonstrated consistent and effective temperature control, with calculated temperatures closely matching the actual measured temperatures at all target temperatures. These experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Study of the Radiation-Fields of Vertically Polarized EMP Radiating-Wave Simulator with Different Pad Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The radiation-fields of vertically polarized electromagnetic pulse (EMP) radiating-wave simulator with four different kind of pad models, are simulated and studied by finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method. The comparisons of the peak-values, rise-times and waveforms of vertical component of radiation electric fields at several testing points as the simulator with different pad models are given and analyzed, and the choice suggestion of the simulator's pad model is given. The results show that, the radiation fields of the vertically polarized EMP radiating-wave simulator with the pad model are similar to those of the simulator with pad model only formed by PEC plate, when the sizes of metal meshes' grid of the pad model are small enough and the upper surfaces of the metal meshes are higher than (or equal to) that of the cement; Those pad models mentioned above can be chosen as the vertically polarized EMP radiating-wave simulator's pad; The pad model whose cement's upper surface is higher than those of metal meshes and cement's conductivity is good enough, can also be chosen as the simulator pad.

articleTitle: A Compact Double-Layer Wide Beam Circularly Polarized Beidou Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes and designs a microstrip antenna that can work in the B1 band for Beidou with a double-layer substrate, and realizes the circularly polarized radiation characteristics. The antenna consists of a ground plane, two substrates, and two metal patches. The first layer of the patch is a rectangular structure as well as the second layer of the patch is a T-shaped structure with two vertical branches which are to achieve circular polarization. This structure adopts a simple coaxial feeding method, with the probe passing through the second layer of the substrate to connect the ground plane and the T-shaped strip. The simulation optimization results using the HFSS 2021 show that the axial ratio (AR) beam width in both planes exceeds 160°, and the AR at the design frequency is 0.18 dB. The impedance bandwidth is 70 MHz, which can meet the requirements of Beidou's operation.

articleTitle: Design of Ship Target Detection System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Marine ship target detection needs to process the field data in real time under certain energy consumption circumstances. Traditional methods such as CPU or GPU can hardly meet the requirements of detection accuracy, detection speed, and power consumption at the same time. To address the above problems, this paper proposes a design of a ship target detection system based on the FPGA. The algorithm of this design adopts the improved YOLOv5, and the hardware adopts the Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC ZCU104 development kit. In hardware development, a custom platform architecture is created by Vivado, Petalinux, and Vitis toolchains. In algorithmic deployment, the ship target detection algorithm is transplanted through the Vitis AI framework. Seaships dataset is used as experimental data. The test results show that the system has an average accuracy of 79.8% and an inference speed of 51.3 fps on the test set. This system reduces required power compared to CPU and GPU solutions.

articleTitle: A Low Profile Circularly Polarized RFID Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A low-profile circularly-polarized antenna for RFID readers is proposed, with a size of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{190}\times \mathbf{190}\times \mathbf{14}\ \mathbf{mm}^{\mathbf{3}}$</tex>. The antenna basically consists of a metal square patch and a reflector plane, which are connected by a metal columns. The antenna is excited by a feed point upon the ground, and two diagonally symmetrical 45 degree chamfers are cut on the metal square patch to achieve circular polarization. In order to reduce axial ratio, four shorter metal columns are arranged on corners of the reflector, and a small rectangular metal stub is added on upper part of the radiation patch. The antenna works at 902–928 MHz, with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\vert \mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{11}}\vert$</tex> less than -15 dB, and measured peakgain exceeds 8.5 dBi. Moreover, the thickness of the antenna is only 14 mm, showing a low profile feature. Finally, the antenna has good cross-polarization performance, and radiation efficiencies are almost beyond 85% within the frequency band.

articleTitle: A Compact MIMO Antenna with Two Band-Notches for Mobile Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To use in the ultra-wideband (UWB) wireless system, a multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) antenna is designed in this paper. Two notched frequency bands of the WLAN (5.1GHz-5.8GHz) and a part of the C-band (6.7GHz-7.1GHz) have been considered to be offset the interference. The antenna consists of two planar monopole elements with defective ground planes at the bottom. An E-plane symmetric miniaturized structure and T-shaped ground stubs are used to create current paths and achieve good isolation between two radiating elements. Two L-type slots are etched on the radiating patch to implement the WLAN and C-band notched. The size is optimized for the limited mounted space. This design is verified by experiment. Results show the antenna excellent matched with predicted performance, making it a promising choice for UWB MIMO systems.

articleTitle: A Directional Single Beam MIMO Antenna with 2-Transmitters and 2-Receivers for WLAN System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2\times 2$</tex> MIMO antenna with single beam and high gain has been suggested, which is suitable for WLAN applications operating at 2.4 and 5.8 GHz. The lower-band unit consists of four rectangular slots, a hat-shaped slot and two centrally symmetrical slots, respectively. It adjusts the impedance matching by controlling their length and width. The upper-band unit realizes strong current coupling through the gap between the main radiation patch and the four L-shaped parasitic patches. Besides, the parasitic patches are arranged around the radiating patch to expand the bandwidth. By assembling the units of the dual bands together, a 2×2 array with high gain is formed, covering the WLAN frequency band. Experimental results show that a dual bandwidth of 2.38-2.68 GHz and 4.74-6.61 GHz, covering the common WLAN frequency bands that include 2.4-2.485 GHz and 5.15-5.85 GHz can be achieved. Besides the high isolation, the antenna can also obtain high gain and directional radiation characteristics at low cost. Therefore, the antenna possesses the capability to be extensively utilized in contemporary communication systems.

articleTitle: Modeling of High Gain Tunneling Diode using Verilog-A for Backscatter Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Based on the negative resistance characteristics of tunnel diode, a new low-power backscatter signal transmitter is designed to increase the reflected echo. By constructing the equivalent circuit of tunnel diode AI301A and adjusting different voltage values, we measured the reflection gain at each voltage. The experimental results show that the maximum reflection gain is 9.704dB at the voltage of 120mV and the frequency of 2.8 GHz.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Networks Applied in Fast-designing Parallel Trapping of All-dielectric Nanotweezers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: We construct artificial neural networks to fast-design an all-dielectric nanotweezer, the all-dielectric nanotweezer can be used for high-throughput trapping of the nanoparticles with a radius of 60 nm. The work in this paper is of great significance for further study on the applications of artificial neural networks in other optical devices design for particles trapping.

articleTitle: EEG Data Enhancement and Emotion Recognition Based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In emotion recognition, the requirement for authenticity and real-time of the medium under study has always been a primary consideration. Thus electroencephalogram (EEG) is most suitable as the primary medium for emotion recognition research. However, there needs to be more high-quality training data for building EEG-based emotion recognition models through machine learning or deep learning methods, and manual generation of high-quality data is an effective way to overcome this problem. Generative adversarial networks (GAN) have recently succeeded in generative applications involving images. They are beginning to be applied to EEG data enhancement, so this paper generates high-quality artificial data through generative adversarial networks.

articleTitle: K Band Transceiver Components
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The real-time nature of information is critical in modern information warfare. As the number of combat units gradually increases, it is necessary to establish a timely and reliable information sharing platform between each unit to complete the information sharing. Data chains enable rapid and reliable networking and sharing of information resources on the battlefield. In the networking system, each unit is required to have wireless communication capability with higher communication bandwidth, faster speed, and higher security. Therefore, the study of communication transceiver components has important theoretical significance and application value. In this paper, a miniaturized K-band transceiver assembly with fast frequency hopping is designed and implemented. The assembly can operate in the RF band from 25 GHz to 26.5 GHz. The system design uses a secondary conversion scheme to achieve high spurious rejection. In addition, the system is equipped with a unique structural design in order to cope with the difficulties of high power and heat dissipation.

articleTitle: A RIS-Supported DOA Estimation Using Combined Norm Constraint in Non-Gaussian Noise Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) is a revolutionary technology in modern wireless communication systems, since it can adjust the wireless communication environment with passive components. In this paper, we consider the system environment in the presence of Base Station (BS) interference and implement the estimation of the target Direction-of-Arrival (DOA). To improve the estimation performance, we propose a DOA estimation algorithm based on RIS. The proposed algorithm consists of an error term for the lorentzian bound function and a regular term for the atomic norm (termed as LBF-AN), which are implemented to eliminate system noise and signal interference, respectively. The simulation results show that the DOA estimation performance of the proposed algorithm is better than existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Compact Dual-/Tri-Band SIW Filtering Antennas Using Cavity-Backed Slots
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Compact dual-/tri-band SIW filtering antennas using cavity-backed slots are proposed. By etching a pair of open-loop slots (OLSs) and a slot on the SIW cavity, the slot can be treated as a radiator as well as a resonator. As a result, a dual-band filtering performance with four radiation nulls (RNs) is obtained, achieving high selectivity and good out-of-band suppression. The formation mechanism of RNs is analyzed. To further prove this design method, two pairs of OLSs and a horizontal straight slot are simultaneously etched on the SIW cavity, achieving the tri-band filtering response with 6 RNs in the stopband. Two prototypes are fabricated and tested for demonstration, showing the excellent dual-band filtering response with center frequencies of 4.56 and 5.7 GHz, and the superior tri-band filtering response with center frequencies of 4.1, 4.82 and 5.62 GHz. Moreover, both designs exhibit the compact size of 0.4 ×0.5λ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> due to compact structures.

articleTitle: A Novel Airborne Radar Sea Clutter Simulation Method Based on Full Link Factors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Since accurate radar sea clutter simulation is an important part for target detection performance, this paper introduces a novel method based on full link factors for airborne radar system. Due to the complex characteristics of sea clutter and motion of aircraft, target detection under sea clutter faces the impact of doppler and range ambiguity. Besides, the existing methods do not consider full link conditions and detecting scenarios, which leads to phenomenon of sea clutter characteristics vary with the radar parameters. Therefore, this paper focused on analyzing the geometric relationships of airborne radar and aimed range bins. Then, the coherent sea clutter model is established, while the echo power formula of backscattering model is also calculated. Finally, through analysis the relationship between K distribution sea clutter echoes and Two-Scale Composite (TSC) sea clutter backscatter model, the sea clutter datasets are simulated based on full link factors above. And the results show that the simulated sea clutter datasets are within realistic time-frequency characteristics and improve target detection performance under multiple sea states sea clutter.

articleTitle: CapsuleGAN for Sound Event Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Polyphonic sound event detection (SED) refers to the detection and identification of multiple sound events in complex environments, such as car noise, ocean waves, bird calls, etc., and locating the start and end of each sound time occurrence. In practice, polyphonic SED usually requires a large amount of annotation data, however, it is difficult to annotate a large number of sounds in natural environments. Therefore, weakly annotated polyphonic SED has become one of the current research hotspots. In this paper, we propose a weakly annotated multi-voice event detection method based on generative adversarial capsule networks (CapsuleGAN). The aim is to solve the problem of difficult annotation in polyphonic SED and to improve the detection accuracy and robustness of the model. Specifically, we adopt a CapsuleGAN structure that combines a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) [1] with a Capsule Network (CapsNet) to improve the robustness of the model and enable the model to better handle complex datasets of sound event representation. In addition, we employ streamwise regularisation, adversarial loss, and cross-entropy loss as the classifier's objective function to improve the classification accuracy of the model. To evaluate our approach, we conducted experiments on the DCASE2017 Task 4 dataset. Among them, the F-score of the audio annotation subtask reached 58.9% and the error rate of sound event localisation reached 0.75. The results show that our method has an advantage in weakly annotated polyphonic SED, with better robustness and higher detection accuracy.

articleTitle: A Non-Invasive RF Sensor with Fast Response Based on Artistic Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A glucose sensor based on Chinese character patch antenna was proposed for glucose concentration detection. By adding the defect ground structures (DGSs), the optimized patch antenna shows good RF performance. The resonance frequency of the final patch antenna is 3.70 GHz, the bandwidth is 174 MHz (3.61 GHz-3.78 GHz) and the S11 parameters is -36 dB. The effective sensing region was determined by the electric field distribution, and the changing of dielectric constant of glucose solution was detected by observing the shifting of resonant frequency. The sensor was applied to detect the glucose solution in the concentration range of 25 mg/dL to 500 mg/dL. The measured results show that the resonant frequency and S11 parameters increased linearly with the increasing of glucose concentration.

articleTitle: Topology Design, Analysis, and Optimization for a Bandpass Baw Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, the effect of topology structures on filter out-of-band (OoB) rejection is analyzed and the approximate expressions for OoB rejection of different structures are provided. Using the Mason model, the optimal synthesis topology of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pi$</tex> -type and L-type is applied for designing a Band39(1880 MHz-1920 MHz) filter to achieve good performance of low OoB rejection exceeding -70 dB as well as a return loss less than -15 dB according to the simulation results.

articleTitle: Design of Environment Data Acquisition System Based on Gitwits Cloud
