publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: An environmental data acquisition system based on Gizwits is designed which adopts STM32 development board as the control core and combines with the Gizwits Platform. The system solves the problems existing in general data acquisition systems: such as the need for on-site wiring during development and no APP available to view the collected data in real time. In the design, the environmental data acquisition system integrates the temperature and humidity, photosensitivity, amount of percipitation, soil moisture, smoke and other modules to realize the function of collecting environmental data, and the data flow is transmitted in two ways: one is based on WiFi and the other is 2.4G radio frequency transmission. The collection end and the uploading end are transmitted via 2.4G RF, and the transmission between the uploading end and the Gizwits Platform is realized via WiFi. Finally, this data acquisition system can realize to view the data through the Gizwits cell phone APP, which is convenient and simple, and enjoy a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Diamond Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor Field-Effect Transistors on a Large-Area Wafer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Diamond-based devices are suitable for high-power, low power-loss, high-frequency, and high-temperature applications. Most of diamond-based metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (MOSFETs) are fabricated on small-size diamond wafers <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(3 \times 3\ \text{mm}^{2})$</tex>. In order to promote the diamond-based devices for future applications, it is necessary to investigate the electrical properties of them on the large-area wafers. Here, we fabricate hydrogen-terminated diamond MOSFETs on a large-area wafer <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(8\times 8\ \text{mm}^{2})$</tex> with a quantity of 720. Electrical properties of them are investigated and discussed.

articleTitle: A Novel Transformed Nested Array with Enhanced DOFs Based on Sum-Difference Coarray
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Sum-difference driven coarray (SDCA) was paid great attention in array-signal-processing (ASP). By considering SDCA, the degrees of freedom (DOFs) for sparse arrays can be further improved. Here, a new transformed nested-array (TNA) is constructed, which reduces the element redundancy via rearranging the density of sub-arrays of the constructed new TNA. Compared to former TNAs, the constructed TNA gets higher DOFs and maximization signals, numerical simulation are given for getting its superior behaviors.

articleTitle: Millimeter Wave Circularly Polarized Full Duplex Antenna Array with High Isolation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A circularly polarized full-duplex antenna array is designed for a 60 GHz wireless transmission chip. Firstly, a dual-polarization antenna based on the cavity-backed slot is designed. Two orthogonal modes <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\text{TE}_{120}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{TE}_{210})$</tex> are used to realize two different polarization states of the antenna, thus effectively reducing cross-polarization. A layered feeding structure is adopted in the design, which can enhance the isolation between the two ports. Then a circularly polarized antenna array is proposed based on the proposed dual-polarization antenna. The four antennas are rotated 90° around the phase center of the array to achieve the right-hand circular polarization function. The simulation results show that the antenna can operate between 63.3 to 64.5 GHz with isolation of 37 dB between the transmitting and receiving ports.

articleTitle: A Low-Complexity Three-Dimensional Parameter Estimation Algorithm for FMCW Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) radar has been widely used in the field of vehicle mounted millimeter wave radar to detect the parameters of targets. A low complexity three-dimensional (3D) parameter estimation algorithm for time-division multiplexing multiple-input multiple-output (TDM-MIMO) FMCW radar is proposed to detect the range, velocity, and azimuth angle of targets. The proposed algorithm utilized the data block selection and rank-reduced technique to avoid the high computational burden of the traditional subspace-based algorithm. Moreover, the proposed algorithm solves the problem of velocity ambiguity in conventional TDM-MIMO FMCW signal processing. The simulation results show that the accuracy and resolution of the algorithm are much higher than the conventional algorithms, such as 3D-FFT, and 3D-MUSIC.

articleTitle: Overview of Task Offloading of Wireless Sensor Network in Edge Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This review article introduces the concepts, server architecture and application scenarios of Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) and Wireless Sensor Network (WSN). By differentiating between rechargeable and non-rechargeable systems, it presents the research status of task offloading in WSN in an edge computing environment. Various strategies are analyzed and compared in terms of their characteristics and application domains. The existing methods can reduce offloading latency and energy consumption, but still face some issues. Based on this, the research hotspots of edge computing task offloading for WSN are summarized, and its research and development trends are pointed out.

articleTitle: Named Entity Recognition Method Based on ERNIE2.0-BiLSTM-AT-CRF-FL
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To address the problem that the named entity recognition task cannot address the phenomenon of multiple meanings of words in context and unbalanced label classification when dealing with Chinese words, the ERNIE2.0-BiLSTM-AT-CRF-FL entity recognition method is proposed, and the pre-training model adopts enhanced language representation with informative entities 2.0 (ERNIE2.0). The model can learn dynamically by combining the context of words to obtain dynamic semantic features of words and solve the phenomenon of multiple meanings of words; Then the word vector is input to the bi-directional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) neural network to extract features, and the weight size of each word is calculated by the soft attention mechanism (AT) layer; Finally, the entity labels are obtained by decoding in the conditional random field (CRF), and by using the focal loss function (FL) to alleviate the label classification imbalance. The proposed algorithm model is applied to the MSRA corpus for validation, and the experimental results show that the model achieves an F1 value of 95.39% which can better handle the Chinese-named entity recognition task.

Author Keywords: Enhanced Language Representation with Informative Entities 2.0

articleTitle: Fault Location in Ungrounded Neutral System with Distributed Generators
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In response to the increasingly complex fault location problem caused by more and more access of distributed power sources to distribution networks, this paper proposes a fault location method based on the distribution characteristic of fault zero-sequence voltage. This method only requires the position of detection points and the zero-sequence voltage information at these points to construct reliable functions for the upstream and downstream sections. The fault location can be determined by the intersection point of these two reliable functions. This method has a simple principle, is economically practical, does not require the addition of extra equipment, and is adaptable to networks with distributed power sources.

articleTitle: Modulation Recognition Method of Underwater Acoustic Signal Based on Parallel Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In underwater non-cooperative communication systems, efficient and accurate identification of underwater acoustic signal modulation is a prerequisite for stable and reliable communication. However, the underwater environment is complex and changeable, and various noises seriously interfere with the correct identification of the modulation mode of underwater acoustic signals at the receiver. A parallel neural network model is proposed in this paper based on the Encoder module and convolutional module, which fuses the convolutional network and the attention mechanism. In the results, higher recognition accuracy than the traditional machine learning algorithms is demonstrated. It can achieve high accuracy in identifying eight underwater acoustic signal modulation methods on the South China Sea dataset with a recognition accuracy of 99.3%.

articleTitle: A Pattern Reconfigurable Antenna Array Operating at WLAN Band
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a pattern reconfigurable antenna array consisting of two identical antenna elements on an FR-4 substrate. Each antenna element includes a main patch (MP), four main parasitic patches (MPP), and four sub-parasitic patches (SPP). Ten ideal switches are mounted on the MPP and SPP to control the connection/disconnection of each parasitic patch with the ground plane to achieve pattern reconfiguration. By controlling ON/OFF state of the switches, the proposed antenna can operate in eight states with eight steerable beams at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\boldsymbol{\theta=\pm 18^{\mathrm{o}}}}$</tex> in the XOZ plane. The proposed antenna has a common bandwidth of 2.33-2.49 GHz and gain ranging from 5.11 to 8.54 dBi on the eight states.

articleTitle: Triple Attention Vision Transformers for Remote Sensing Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Remote sensing image classification is gradually growing into an attractive research topic and is widely used in various tasks. But unlike natural general images, remote sensing images are usually high-resolution, which are consist of complex backgrounds and various randomly arranged targets. Remote sensing images usually have the characteristics of large intra-class differences and huge inter-class similarity, which make it difficult for the network to focus on the main objects in the scene, resulting in unsatisfactory classification performance. In this paper, we propose the Triple Attention Vision Transformers (TaViT) network to solve this problem. The backbone of TaViT is mainly composed of two branches, namely Dual Attention Vision Transformers (DaViT) and Branch Attention Module (BA Module). DAViT uses the self-attention mechanism of “spatial tokens” and “channel tokens” to capture the features of the global context. The BA Module aggregates the features of each channel along the horizontal and vertical directions, respectively, and continuously provides rich local details for the network. Experimental results on three publicly available remote sensing datasets demonstrate that our TaViT achieves state-of-the-art performance.

articleTitle: A Stub-Based Design for Wideband Unequal Filtering Power Divider with Transmission Zeros and Arbitrary Phase Difference
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this letter, a wideband unequal filtering power divider (UFPD) with two transmission zeros (TZs) and the arbitrary phase difference is proposed. The phase difference can be adjusted arbitrarily by changing the delay parameter, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\theta}_{\boldsymbol{delay}}$</tex>. For verification, a UFPD with a power ratio of 2:1 is designed, simulated, and fabricated. The measured results demonstrate that the phase difference in the passband is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{42.5}^{\circ}\pm \mathbf{2.5}^{\circ}$</tex>. Additionally, the isolation is better than 15 dB while the return loss is better than 18 dB.

articleTitle: Transparent Antenna Using Metal Mesh Fabricated by Electric-Field-Driven Microscale 3D Printing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a new method for fabricating transparent antennas using metal mesh. A transparent microstrip antenna for application at 2.45 GHz is fabricated on a glass using electric-field-driven (EFD) microscale 3D printing combined with a micro-plating process, obtaining a sheet resistance of less than 0.4 Ω/sq and 78% transparency, which also achieves good impedance matching and good agreement between simulation and measurement. Compared to traditional methods such as photolithography and laser writing, it reduces manufacturing costs and enhances the conductivity of low-temperature-cured silver paste materials. Additionally, it also enables customization, providing a cost-effective and efficient solution for the production of transparent metal mesh antennas.

articleTitle: A DOA Estimation Method for Coherent Signals Based on Weighted l1-SVD
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The study of Direction of Arrival (DOA) estimation aims to obtain the spatial domain parameters of the target signal through the analysis of the array received data, and then complete the target signal location. Aiming at the correlation and even coherent signals caused by multipath propagation and same-frequency interference caused by complex propagation environment, this paper will be based on the traditional <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l$</tex><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>-SVD algorithm in Compressive Sensing, and on this basis, the existing weighted <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l$</tex><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>- SVD Dalgorithm is improved. Aiming at the problem that the existing weighted <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l$</tex><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> - SVD algorithm can not directly estimate the coherent signals, a new weighted matrix is proposed after Toeplitz pretreatment, so that the improved weighted <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l$</tex><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> - SVD algorithm can be used to estimate the DOA of the coherent signals. At the same time, DOA estimation of two close coherent signals can be completed under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio, low fast beat number and small Angle interval. The simulation results show that the improved weighted <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l$</tex><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> - SVD algorithm has higher estimation accuracy and resolution, and solves the problem that the existing weighted <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l$</tex><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> - SVD algorithm cannot directly estimate the coherent signal.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Classification Based on Multi-Level Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Over the previous few years, the incidence of brain tumors has been increasing, and it is now among the top 10 most prevalent tumors worldwide. Early detection and diagnosis of brain tumors can assist doctors in creating targeted treatment regimens. The method of deep learning to classify brain tumor magnetic resonance (MR) images can increase the speed and precision of diagnosis. This paper proposes a multi-level attention model to categorize brain tumors. This model uses EfficientNetV2 as the backbone. The Efficient Triplet Attention (ETA) module and the Pyramid Spilt Attention (PSA) module improve the model's capacity to retrieve meaningful information from MR images and decrease the impact of noisy information. The conclusion shows that our model can effectively increase the classification accuracy of brain tumors, with a rate of 98.53%.

articleTitle: Research on Uniderectional Non Reflection Characteristics of Photonic Crystals Based on PT Symmetry
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a parity-time (PT) symmetric one-dimensional photonic crystal structure with double defects and double symmetric periods is proposed. By setting the same defect layer in the periodic structure on both sides, the symmetry broken pase in the structure on both sides appears at the same frequency point. This structure presents a one-way non-reflection characteristic at a frequency point in the near-infrared band. By adjusting the thickness of the defect layer, the position and value of the reflection peak can be flexibly changed. It is found that with the increase of the thickness of the defect layer, the performance of the uniderection reflection point decreases and moves to the high frequency direction. Peiod number has no effect on the position of the reflection peak, when <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{N}=\mathbf{6}$</tex>, the maximum forward reflection peak is obtained; the change of the incident angle will make the uniderection reflection point move back and forth within a certain range. After adjustment, the reflectance of forward incident light of the structure can reach 47, while the reflectance of reverse incident light is only <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{3.9}\times \mathbf{10}^{-\mathbf{5}}$</tex>. This structure realizes high-performance one-way reflection transmission, which can be used for stealth or optical isolation, etc.

articleTitle: Large-Range W-Band Frequency-Hopping Signal Transmission System Based on Optical Switch
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: We proposed and experimentally demonstrated a W-band frequency-hopping signal transmission system based on photonics with a high speed of 8 Gbit/s and a large hopping scale of 4.1 GHz. Based on power budget equivalence, this system can achieve a 400-m wireless communication.

articleTitle: A Wearable Pressure Sensor for Human Pulse Signal Monitoring and HRV Parameter Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The development of a wearable pressure sensor capable of achieving reliable and continuous detection of human pulse signals and assessment of heart rate variability (HRV) parameters holds significant importance in distinguishing between healthy individuals and patients with cardiovascular diseases, mental health issues, and more. In this study, we introduce a wearable capacitive pressure sensor using a sponge-like dielectric layer fabricated by a template-assisted ultraviolet-curable method. The proposed wearable capacitive pressure sensor demonstrates the capability of continuous monitoring of human pulse signals and analysis of inter-beat intervals (IBIs) as well as HRV parameters of volunteers, which holds promising potential for applications in human-machine interaction, personalized medical services, communications, and entertainment.

articleTitle: The Effect of Deposition Temperature on the Morphology and Superconductivity of YBa2Cu3O7-δ Thin Films
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This experiment mainly studies the influence of deposition temperature changes on the surface morphology of thin films and tests the effect of temperature on the electrical transport properties of thin films through photolithography and microfabrication technology. By adjusting the deposition temperature, when the temperature increases from <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$740^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex> to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{780^{\circ}\mathrm{C}}$</tex>, the transition temperature of the thin film was increased from 85 K to 89 K and the critical current density was increased from less than 1 MA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to over 3 MA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. However, as the temperature continues to increase to above 790 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${}^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex>, the performance of the thin film begins to decrease, which is due to the decomposition of YBCO thin film and the formation of multiple in-plane orientations due to excessive temperature. These experimental results provide a method for controlling the preparation of YBCO thin films with good performance by PLD method.

articleTitle: High Gain Horizontally Polarized Omnidirectional Slot Antenna Array for Base Stations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A compact horizontally polarized omnidirectional (HPO) slot antenna array is presented for base stations. It is made up of four antenna units, each of which obtains HPO radiation pattern by etching vertical slots on the four faces of the metal shell. The simulation results demonstrate that the gain variations of this antenna unit are not more than 2.5 dB in the azimuthal plane over the frequency band 2.38-2.51 GHz, which covers the frequency range of wireless local area network (WLAN) system. Besides, the peak gain is around 2.8 dBi and the cross-polarization (X-pol) level is less than -30 dB in the entire band. Then, a four-unit antenna array is designed to meet the high gain requirements of the base stations. Simulations show that the presented antenna array has a bandwidth of 3.68% (2.40-2.49 GHz) and a peak gain approximately 8.6 dBi. Besides, the gain variations are not more than 3.5 dB for the horizontal radiation pattern.

articleTitle: Adaptive Topology Control Strategy for Heterogeneous Multichannel Data LinkNetworks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper considers a topology control strategy in the multichannel heterogeneous datalink network, which can meet the connectivity optimization requirements of the network by deploying multimode nodes reasonably and adapting different task priorities. This strategy can improve the performance of data link networks in dynamic scenarios. Finally, simulation results are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Deep Learning and Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Over the next decade, we can expect artificial intelligence (AI) to have a profound impact on our society. As AI technologies continue to advance and become more integrated into various industries, we will witness significant changes that are shaping the human being's future for the better. This paper reviews the major deep learning algorithms that have accomplished latest achievements on various fields such as manufacturing robots, smart assistants, automated financial investing, social media monitoring, marketing chat-bots and self-driving car. These algorithms are trained on large datasets of labeled images, where each image is associated with a set of labels or categories. This paper provides an overview of popular techniques for image recognition. It discusses the convolutional neural network (CNN), which is made up of multiple convolutional layers followed by pooling layers, dropout layers, batch normalization lays and fully connected layers. The paper addresses other techniques used in deep learning for image recognition include transfer learning, where a pre-trained model is refined on new datasets, and generative adversarial networks (GANs), which can generate realistic images by training two neural networks against each other. This paper highlights that deep learning has revolutionized the field of image recognition and has opened up new possibilities for many applications.

articleTitle: Fast Estimation of Full Depth Sound Speed Profile Based on Partial Prior Information
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The distribution of underwater sound speed profile (SSP) is of great significance for the design of underwater acoustic communication and positioning systems. SSPs can be accurately measured by conductivity–temperature–depth profiler (CTD) or sound velocity profiler (SVP), but it spends a long time. SSPs can also be estimated by inversion methods, such as matching process, artificial neural networks, but the inversion result is not as accurate as CTD or SVP. With the development of expendable conductivity–temperature–depth profiler (XCTD), the SSP can be quickly and accurately measured with the help of autonomous vehicles (AUV), however, the measured SSP could not cover the full ocean depth. In order to obtain a full–depth SSP based on prior information obtained by XCTD, we propose a fast SSP estimating method, called empirical–orthogonal–function–based partial sound speed profile matching extension (EOF–PSSP–ME). The feature coefficients are obtained through projecting prior information on partial–depth feature vectors, then the full–depth SSP is constructed by combining the feature coefficients with full–depth feature vectors. Results shows that the full–depth SSP can be estimated accurately based on partial prior information.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of CR-NOMA Based on Untrusted Relay in IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Cognitive radio (CR) technology can be used as a key technology for wireless communication to integrate heterogeneous networks, increasing channel capacity and improving spectrum efficiency because secondary users can access to the spectrum of the primary network for communication without authorization. It can, to some extent, pose communication security issues. To address this issue, a system model combining CR network with non-orthogonal multiple access (CR-NOMA) is proposed, in which secondary users are utilized to support the primary network communication while cognitive users are untrusted. To begin, the proposed system CR-NOMA model is constructed in the Internet of Things to guarantee that it is compatible with a wider range of scenarios. Secondly, physical layer security technologies such as redundant information and jamming signal are used to improve the secrecy performance. Finally, the closed-form results for the exact and asymptotic outage probabilities of the near-end user and the remote user are studied, taking information secrecy into account. The secrecy throughput performance of various users is examined. The simulation results demonstrate that using cognitive users as relays to forward information can significantly improve the performance of the proposed system. The performance of the remote user, in particular, demonstrates that the considered model may effectively improve the quality of service of the cellular-edge user and therefore expand the coverage of the base station.

articleTitle: Research on System of Genetic Algorithm-Based SQL Injection Test Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With the rapid development of network science and technology, an increasing number of network security vulnerabilities have emerged, among which SQL injection is a particularly severe security vulnerability. To effectively detect vulnerabilities, how to construct a high-quality test dataset has become a research hotspot. This paper proposes and implements a system design based on genetic algorithms to optimize SQL injection test data, which can automate the generation of test data. Specifically, it involves filtering, completion, and feature extraction of SQL injection attack characteristics using filtering rules and completion rules. The system also utilizes genetic algorithms to process the test dataset through selection, crossover, mutation, and other operations in multiple iterations to generate the best SQL injection test dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that this design can generate high-quality test datasets, effectively discover SQL injection vulnerabilities, and improve the comprehensiveness and accuracy of vulnerability detection. It addresses the drawbacks of high cost in manually constructing test data and low quality of test data generated based on rules.

articleTitle: Portable Diabetic Ketoacidosis Detector via the Human Exhaled Breath Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Ketoacidosis is a life-threatening condition among diabetic patients prevalent in the general population. The acetone level in human exhaled breath symbolizes the diabetic ketoacidosis, which normally requires a complex laboratory equipment to quantify. A portable device using the metal-oxide-semiconductor sensors, therefore, is developed to measure low-concentration of acetone in the human exhaled breath – allowing diabetic patients monitor and manage their ailments at home. Multiple techniques and analysis methods, such as sensor array, the Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) were uniquely integrated into this automatic device. The work was further advanced by measuring acetone level in the presence of other volatile organic compounds (VOCs) such as ethanol. Experimental data indicated that the device was able to measure a sample gas of acetone concentrations at 0.32 ppm, 0.45 ppm and 0.65 ppm with mean responses of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{R}=\mathbf{1.03}$</tex> (SD 0.03), 1.12 (SD 0.02) and 1.14 (SD 0.02), respectively, representing a useful resolution of 0.3 ppm. The PCA revealed that acetone-only, ethanol-only, and binaries of the two gases can be well distinguished in a lower-dimension subspace.

Author Keywords: volatile organic compounds (VOCs) in human exhaled breath

articleTitle: Hydroacoustic Array Beamforming Technique Based on KPM-LCMV Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The adaptive beamforming algorithm, Linearly Constrained Minimum Variance (LCMV), is improved and implemented in simulation. In this paper, we propose an adaptive beamforming algorithm based on Kalman filtering with special matrix processing (KPM-LCMV, Kalman filtering & PID control & Matrix processing based on LCMV) for PID control optimization, and its main research contents are as follows: Firstly, to reduce the directional angle estimation error, this paper firstly iterates the classical DOA (Direction of Arrival) estimation algorithm by using Kalman filtering algorithm and corrects it by error. This paper further optimizes the above algorithm by using Proportion Integration Differentiation (PID) control to obtain more accurate directional angles. Kalman algorithm optimization based on PID technology: It is based on PID technology to eliminate the steady-state error in Kalman algorithm to optimize the accuracy of DOA estimation, and some direction-of-arrival estimation algorithms can be further optimized by this technology; secondly, for how to reduce the computational effort and stability of the covariance matrix, in this paper, optimization is performed by a special matrix processing method. Optimization of the adaptive beamforming method based on linear constrained minimum variance: that is, based on the linear constrained minimum variance criterion, the covariance matrix of the signal is optimized by frequency domain transformation and generalized inverse correction to reduce the computational effort, improve the convergence speed, and reduce the effect of small eigenvalue perturbations on beamforming when the signal-to-noise ratio is elevated.

articleTitle: The Construction of Healthy City in the 5G Era Evaluation Index Based on AHP Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The sudden epidemic disaster of COVID-19 in 2019 has made people reflect on the concept of “healthy cities” and the indicator system in the face of unexpected public events. This shows us that there is a need for reflection and improvement in the construction of healthy cities. By constructing a healthy city indicator system based on post-epidemic thinking, it can compensate for the inability of the current healthy city concept and indicator system to provide constructive advice on urban management and residents' lives in the context of public health emergencies, and to provide theoretical research for the continued construction of healthy cities. According to the basis of the existing experience of healthy cities and the social problems exposed during the epidemic, a set of scientific and reasonably healthy city indicator system is formed, which is suitable for the post-epidemic development background and the actual foundation of the current stage.

articleTitle: Fish Target Detection and Speed Estimation Method based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Taking the monitoring of fish status in aquaculture cages as the research background, the survival status of fish is assessed through the estimation of fish swimming speed, and the Yolov3 target detection algorithm and Deep-sort multi-target tracking algorithm based on deep learning are studied to achieve fish target detection. And trajectory tracking, the imaging model of the underwater binocular camera is established, the three-dimensional coordinates of the underwater fish target image point are obtained, and the speed estimation of the fish target is realized on the basis of the continuous tracking of the fish target. Compared with the other algorithms of fish body separation, the research results show that the method proposed in this paper has an average detection accuracy of 96.16% for underwater fish targets, and the average relative error of fish movement speed estimation under natural lighting conditions is 1.60%.

articleTitle: Research on the Algorithm of Combined GNSS/SINS Navigation System based on Adaptive UKF
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to improve the positioning accuracy and reliability of intelligent farm machinery in orchard environment, a combined GNSS(Global Navigation Satellite System)/SINS (Inertial Navigation System)navigation system for orchard in loose combination mode was built based. An improved UKF algorithm, IUKF (Improved Unscented Kalman Filter), is proposed for the problem that interference in the orchard environment causes observation coarseness in the measurement data and the standard UKF causes degradation in the filtering accuracy of the combined navigation system. Physical experiments show that compared with UKF, the average absolute error of IUKF is reduced by more than 47.16% and the root mean square error is reduced by more than 59.78%, and IUKF meets the requirements of orchard positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Intelligent Prediction of Information Security Industry Data Based on Machine Learning and Adaptive Weighting Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Entering the critical year of the 14th Five Year Plan, China's information security industry has entered a new stage of development. With the increasing importance of information security, its industrial development has been paid attention to, but the data fragmentation of China's information security industry is serious, and there are few corresponding summaries and predictions. To achieve the development prediction of the industry, this article studies the intelligent prediction of information security industry data based on machine learning and new adaptive weighted fusion, and deduces the system based on the research results to promote industry development. Firstly, collect, filter, integrate, and preprocess industry data. Based on the characteristics of the data, machine learning algorithms such as linear regression, ridge regression, logical regression, polynomial regression and random forest are selected to predict the data, and the corresponding optimal parameters are found and set in the model creation. And an improved adaptive weighted fusion model based on model prediction performance was proposed. Its principle is to adaptively select the model with the lowest mean square error (MSE) value for fusion based on the real-time prediction performance of multiple machine learning models, and its weight is also calculated adaptively to improve prediction accuracy. Secondly, using technologies such as Matplotlib and Pyecharts to visualize the data and predicted results, it was found that the development trend of the information security industry is closely related to factors such as national information security laws and regulations, the situation between countries, and social emergencies. According to the predicted results of the data, it is observed that both industry input and output have shown an upward trend in recent years. In the future, China's information security industry is expected to maintain stable and rapid growth driven by the domestic market.

articleTitle: Credit Risk Prediction Network Based on Semantic Feature Transformer and CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Credit risk is one of the main risks faced by financial institutions. Establishing credit risk prediction model is an important means to help financial institutions avoid risks and reduce losses. To fully extract the feature information in the credit data and improve the parallel computing capability of the model while reducing the network size, a credit risk prediction network based on semantic feature Transformer and CNN is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a Semantic Feature Transformer (SFTransformer) module is constructed by introducing semantic features into Transformer to extract credit risk features. Secondly, because one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1DCNN) has good feature extraction ability and parallel computing ability, the 1DCNN module is combined with the SFTransformer module to build a parallel network CNN-SFTransformer. Finally, the feature data of the borrower is fed into the CNN-SFTransformer model to calculate whether the borrower has default risk. In this paper, two real credit datasets from Australia and German in the UCI database are used for experiments. AUC and KS, two commonly used evaluation indicators, are used to evaluate the predictive performance of the model. Experimental results show that the CNN-SFTransformer model proposed in this paper has good performance in the task of credit risk prediction, with high accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Research on Porosity Prediction Based on Wavelet Transform and BGRU
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The traditional rock porosity measurement methods based on laboratory are costly and time consuming. The porosity prediction using logging data has been a research hotspot. A porosity prediction method based on wavelet transform and Bidirectional Gate Recurrent Unit network(BGRU) is proposed in this paper. First, to mine both the longitudinal depth deposition relationship among the adjacent samples and the transverse features relationship among different logging parameter in one data sample, the features with different scales are extracted and denoised using the wavelet decomposition at the same time. And then, to extract and process feature detail information with depth of the feature sample sequences, a Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (BGRU) neural network is constructed to extract the detail feature with longitudinal and transverse information and predict the porosity. The experimental results show that the proposed method improves the accuracy of porosity prediction.

articleTitle: Multi-Layer Visual Perception for No-Reference Image Quality Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this work, we propose a no-reference image quality evaluation approach, aiming to solve the problem that the traditional convolutional neural network is insufficient to express the global information of the image. Therefore, in order to make the captured image features have the coherence of global context information, we combine a Transformer structure widely used in NLP (natural language processing) with the traditional CNN to realize the attention mechanism in the human visual perception characteristics. Firstly, the self-attention mechanism of Transformer is used to learn the global representation of the image from the multi-layer features extracted from different levels of CNN. Additionally, to forecast the ultimate image quality score, the global and local attributes are combined. Finally, the proposed algorithm is evaluated on three public datasets commonly used in CSIQ [1], TID2013 [2] and LIVE [3]. Compared with eight traditional no-reference image quality evaluation algorithms and five methods based on deep learning, the proposed algorithm achieves competitive results.

articleTitle: An Underwater Features Matching System Integrated with Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With the increasing demand for ocean exploration and underwater observation, video-based 3D reconstruction tasks and simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) tasks in underwater scenarios attract great attention. Accurate point correspondence extraction from consecutive underwater video frames is crucial for estimating camera poses and motion trajectories in video-based 3D vision tasks. However, the poor quality of underwater images, caused by light absorption and scattering in water, makes it challenging to obtain accurate matches solely relying on a robust feature-matching network. This paper proposes a matching system designed explicitly for achieving more precise matching between underwater video frames. The system integrates an image enhancement model, a feature extraction model, and a feature-matching model. To address the lack of ground truth depth and camera poses for underwater images, we introduce a unique homographic transformation to simulate camera motion-induced viewpoint changes. The transformed images, paired with the original ones, are utilized to train the feature matching network, which is a graph neural network with self- and cross-attention. And we replace dot-product attention with linear attention to reduce computational complexity. The experimental results validate the effectiveness of underwater feature-matching of the proposed method.

articleTitle: AIS Trajectory Partition Algorithm of Fishing Vessels Based on Complex Network and Community Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With the development of spatial data acquisition technology, trajectory data analysis based on location information has attracted widespread attention, which makes trajectory segmentation, as one of the basic steps of trajectory data mining, more critical. Proper segmentation of long-term trajectory data is conducive to the semantic enhancement of trajectory data, subsequent trajectory data calculation, and improvement of storage effectiveness. In this work, we focused on the partition of the AIS trajectory data of fishing vessels and proposed an AIS trajectory segmentation algorithm for fishing vessels based on complex network and community detection. In this algorithm, we first transformed the AIS trajectory data of the fishing vessels containing spatial-temporal information into a complex network through a complex network representation model, then used a community detection algorithm to find the community structure in the complex network and extracted the segmentation points, finally using the segmentation points to divide the trajectory data. We verified the proposed algorithm on real AIS trajectory data of fishing vessels and compared it with the trajectory segmentation benchmark algorithms CB-SMOT(Clustering-Based Stops and Moves of Trajectories) and GRASP-UTS (Greedy Randomized Adaptive Search Procedure for Unsupervised Trajectory Segmentation). The experimental results showed that the proposed algorithm achieves the optimum in the harmonic average of purity and coverage.

articleTitle: An Underwater Sonar Small Sample Image Transformation for Feature Domain Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Underwater Image transformation uses deep learning to generate images with the target domain and the source domain. It can quickly and accurately solve transformation problems such as image blurring for underwater images. To solve the problem of the poor transformation effect caused by the limited number of sonar images, we propose an underwater small sample image transformation (SSIT) for the feature domain with representation enhancement. We use Canny and histogram equalization to extract the details of images. Then, a channel attention mechanism with sub-pixel convolution is applied to improve the feature extraction ability and enhance image representation. We adopt a noise addition strategy and an image reconstruction strategy to scale the loss of cycle consistency. The weakened cyclic semantic consistency is applied to improve the quality of transformed images. Due to the different image datasets having different data characteristics, the underwater sonar small sample dataset is selected for image transformation with Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN). We choose FUNIT as the baseline, and do the ablation experiment to demonstrate the validity of the model. Comparing with different situations, the experimental results show that the image representation enhancement constructed in this paper can effectively enhance the details of images.

articleTitle: A Binary Sparrow-Hybridized Beluga Whale Optimization Algorithm for Jamming Task Assignment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In the context of non-cooperative electronic countermeasures, the problem of formulating effective jamming task assignments arises due to insufficient collaborative jamming resources. This paper proposes a binary sparrow- hybridized beluga whale optimization algorithm based on jamming task assignments. The algorithm combines the binary sparrow search algorithm(BSSA) and the binary beluga whale optimization(BBWO), which is set with multi-dimensional constraints in the time, frequency and spatial domains. To achieve the optimal strategy for collaborative interference task assignment, a fitness function is constructed using both radar coverage and the signal-to-jamming ratio received by each radar. When the number of UAVs is 7 and the number of radars is 10, the simulation results show that the optimization speed and accuracy of the proposed algorithm are significantly higher than the BSSA and BBWO. Therefore, the algorithm has good coverage and performance in the field of jamming task assignments.

articleTitle: FedPVD: Clustered Federated Learning with NoN-IID Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Federated Learning (FL) is a distributed machine learning framework, which makes full use of private data of client for model training under the premise of protecting client privacy. Although the research on federated learning has made great progress, in the real world federated learning system, data samples are usually scattered and NoN-IID, which will seriously lead to the deterioration of federated learning performance. In order to solve the problem of the deterioration of federated learning performance caused by NoN-IID data, this paper proposes a clustered federated learning algorithm based on the direction of client model parameter change, which is used to improve the accuracy of federated learning model and reduce the influence of NoN-IID data on federated learning. Moreover, this algorithm supports any proportion of clients to participate in federated learning. Specifically, on the premise of not increasing the calculation amount of the client, through analyzing the changes of the model parameters uploaded by each client at the server, the changes are taken as the direction of their local update for clustering, based on this, a new aggregation method is designed. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is significantly better than the baseline federated learning algorithm under various NoN-IID and IID data, and has strong robustness under different client participation rates.

articleTitle: ST2T: A Spatio-Temporal Transformer for Cellular Traffic Prediction in Digital Twin Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Cellular traffic prediction is vital in network optimization, traffic management, and anomaly detection within Digital Twin (DT) systems. However, the task poses significant challenges due to the complexity of spatio-temporal data and its high dynamic range, especially when integrated within a DT framework. Traditional methodologies often interpret cellular traffic data as images, utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) or Transformers. Still, such techniques can be compromised by weak semantic information and limited spatial correlation in the data. This paper introduces a Spatio-temporal Transformer for Digital Twins (ST2T), a groundbreaking model designed to tackle these challenges within the DT context. The ST2T combines the strengths of convolutional and self-attention mechanisms in a unique hybrid encoder and employs a two-stage decoder specifically devised to handle the high dynamic range of spatio-temporal data. We also utilize tubelet patching for an intuitive capture of adjacent space-time relationships. Our experimental results show that the ST2T model substantially advances the state-of-the-art in cellular traffic prediction within DT systems. It provides a promising avenue towards more accurate and efficient cellular traffic prediction, showcasing the potential of Vision Transformers for handling complex spatio-temporal data in Digital Twins systems.

articleTitle: A Reputation-Based Learning Nodes Selection Algorithm for Decentralized Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Due to the increasing risk of data security, distributed learning model based on real-world data analytics has attracted more attention, and it has been applied in a variety of areas ranging from medical screening to agriculture, industry, finance, and defense science. Generally, participants provide their own private datasets to efficiently train the distributed models on real-world data, which inevitably leads to privacy and security concerns. Without uploading raw training data, Federated Learning enables large-amount nodes to train a distributed model and preserves security and privacy of user sensitive information. However, Federated Learning is limited by expensive computational costs during collective parameter server aggregation. Moreover, malicious nodes among computing nodes interfere model training to some extent and further cause the leakage of data privacy. To address the above-mentioned problems, we propose a novel Decentralized Federated Learning by integrating blockchain and federation learning for efficient node selection and communication. Based on the proposed model, a reputation-based learning nodes selection algorithm is presented to measure the probability of honest participation of distributed nodes. The simulation results demonstrate that our RBLNS is capable of improving the training result significantly and decreasing convergence time.

articleTitle: Narrowband Tunable Optical Filter with An Arch-Like Configuration Using SOI Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a low-loss optical bandpass filter with a narrow bandwidth and a steep roll-off, which is based on three feed-forward silicon microring resonators (MRRs). Using the scattering matrix method, we elaborate the simulation model and spectral response analysis of our proposed filter, thereby determining the geometric parameters of the proposed optical filter. Moreover, we compare its performance with different MRR-based filters composed of three ring cavities. Our proposed filter exhibits a different spectral line shape, lower insertion loss and a distinct roll-off feature for the same target 3dB bandwidth. As a proof of concept, we fabricate the proposed optical filter on a silicon-on-insulator (SOI) platform. The device exhibits a 3dB bandwidth of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sim 25$</tex> GHz @1550nm and an on-chip loss of -2.5 dB. Additionally, at the transition band points -10 dB and -20 dB lower than the passband center, we observe a roll-off rate of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sim 45$</tex> dB/nm. Compared with traditional high-order MRRs, our scheme has lower fabrication accuracy requirements and produces lower thermal crosstalk.

articleTitle: Label Update Based Partial Label Learning for Remote Sensing Scene Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A remote sensing scene image frequently contains various objects, hence it is described with multiple labels, all of which are equivalent in status. In fact, however, the importance of these labels to the description of the scene is different from a semantic point of view. In order to obtain the importance distribution of a set of multiple labels, partial label learning (PLL) is introduced into remote sensing scene classification task in this paper. Multiple labels used to describe a scene image are considered as candidate labels in the context of partial labeling learning. During the training process, ‘partial label’ are gradually strengthened, while other labels are gradually weakened, resulting in an indication of the importance of the labels. Specifically, in this paper, a ‘label update based partial label learning’ (LU-PLL) method is proposed to learn the relationship between a set of multiple labels in remote sensing scene images. The model will simultaneously learn the most significant labels and use them as the primary classification basis. Experiments on several classical remote sensing data sets demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method for label importance description.

articleTitle: Single-Channel Speech Enhancement with Conformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The transformer model is renowned for performing well in the field of natural language processing, thanks to its capability of extracting global features. Initially, conformer model was proposed for separating continuous speech. Inheriting the transformer model's ability to extract global features, the conformer model is equipped with a convolutional layer structure that can extract local features with more efficacy. This study aims to introduce a waveform-level end-to-end single-channel speech enhancement approach based on conformer. The proposed approach is made up of three distinct components: the downsampling layer, the conformer layer, and the upsampling layer. The conformer layer is composed of multiple conformer blocks that leverage residual connections in both parallel and series. The ablation experiments demonstrate that the conformer layer with series-parallel connections significantly improves speech enhancement performance. The experimental results, employing the VoiceBank-DEMAND corpus dataset, indicate that the proposed approach outperforms other competing techniques in terms of speech enhancement performance.

articleTitle: Anti-interference Algorithm Based on the Projection Matrix and Gray Wolf Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In the case of high intensity of main flap interference and the desired signal in the sampled data, the traditional anti-dominant flap interference algorithm will have the problems that the main flap interference feature vector is not easily distinguished, the desired signal is self-cancelling and the side flap zero trap is easily affected. To address this problem, an anti-interference algorithm based on the projection matrix and gray wolf optimization is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the spectral estimation and the integration of the spectral estimation are used to obtain the covariance matrix of the main flap interference and the desired signal region, which enables to accurately obtain the main flap interference eigenvector and eliminate the desired signal self-cancellation problem; secondly, the weigh-t vector is optimized by the improved gray wolf optimization (IGWO) algorithm to deepen the flap interference trapping. The simulation validation of this algorithm is carried out under the BELLHOP simulated hydroacoustic channel model. The algorithm improves the correlation coefficient difference by at least 0.638 compared with the traditional anti-interference algorithm, can extract the main flap interference eigenvector more accurately, deepens the side flap zero trap, improves the output signal-to-noise ratio by at least 3.054 dB, and can solve the useful signal self-cancellation problem.

articleTitle: Gain-phase Error Self-calibration DOA Estimation Method Based on Sparse Bayesian
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To estimate direction-of-arrival (DOA) in the case of coherent signals with unknown gain-phase errors, a gain-phase error self-calibration DOA estimation method based on sparse Bayesian is presented in this paper. Firstly, the decoherence is realized by the unitary transformation of the extended received data matrix. And then an off-grid SBL model with gain-phase error is proposed by vectorizing the covariance matrix obtained after the transformation and introducing the off-grid model into it. Finally, sparse Bayesian learning is combined to obtain the true DOA. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method provides improved performance in terms of both estimation accuracy and angular resolution over the most traditional compressed sensing method.

articleTitle: A Design and Implementation of Underwater Wireless Optical Communication System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With extremely high information rate, great data transmission capability, and strong anti-interference, underwater wireless optical communication (UWOC) becomes a promising short-range solution for various marine sensors and types of equipment. Related key technologies are discussed in this paper, and a laser diode (LD) and an avalanche photon diode (APD) are selected as light source and receiver. The 450 nm light beam will be generated, and modulated using orthogonal frequency division multiplex (OFDM) for its adaptive ability and resistance to multipath effect. Therefore, a Qualcomm QCA6410 chip with OFDM module is chosen as core processor. Furthermore, a constant current driver circuit, a TPS55340-based negative bias generator with temperature compensation, and a trans-impedance amplifier (TIA)-based post-stage signal processing unit are designed to steadily drive the LD, provide the high voltage leading to the avalanche effect of the APD and generate differential signals that can be received by the chip, respectively. Finally, a full-duplex UWOC system is implemented and tested in a one-meter-long water tank under several water conditions. Results show that a stable data link will be connected with water attenuation coefficient of less than <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.58\ m^{-1}$</tex>, and an average data rate of 6.6 Mbits/s ∼ 10 Mbits/s can be achieved.

articleTitle: Research and Applications of Terahertz Water
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This study investigates terahertz (THz) water, highlighting its unique characteristics and diverse applications. THz waves, straddling the attributes of light and radio waves, enable material penetration and are non-hazardous to biological tissues. In the THz range, water resonantly absorbs these waves, improving solvation and inducing physical transformations. THz water, derived from natural minerals, escalates solvation and biological activity via resonating water molecules. Its bactericidal version exploits alkalinity and electrical properties to dissolve microbial cell membranes. The absorption attributes of water in the THz range allow substance detection and identification, while THz irradiation modifies molecular arrangements, potentially benefiting health and environmental realms. The study underscores the potential of THz water across multiple fields.

articleTitle: Federated Kalman Filter Based on KMEWMA Control Chart for Integrated Navigation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Integrated navigation systems are prone to faults in complex environments, necessitating the isolation or mitigation of their effects on the system. This paper introduces a federated Kalman filter (FKF) structure based on the kernel multivariate exponentially weighted moving-average (KMEWMA) control chart, which incorporates statistical process control techniques to detect and mitigate faults effectively in integrated navigation systems. The proposed method demonstrates outstanding fault detection capability, successfully addressing both gradual and sudden-varying faults. Compared with chi-square test, the KMEWMA control chart could detect faults more precisely. Furthermore, instead of solely isolating faults, the system adaptively adjusts them to enhance positioning accuracy and stability. The simulation results validate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Anycast Service Function Chain Provisioning in Space-Air-Ground Integrated Networks Leveraging Cloud-Edge Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel Space-Air-Ground Integrated Networks (SAGINs) architecture based on cloud-edge collaboration leveraging network function virtualization (NFV). The cloud-based services are provisioned by the selected ground datacenters (DCs) and the traffic is processed by the virtual network function (VNF) hosted in edge nodes and DCs. DCs provide various cloud-oriented network services, and edge nodes enable flexible solutions for SFC provisioning. We apply anycast to further improve the agility of SFC provisioning. From these perspectives, we investigate the cloud-serving and edge-processing SFC provisioning problem leveraging anycast, concerning DC assignment, edge and VNF placement, and SFC mapping simultaneously. A mixed integer linear program (MILP) model is formulated to jointly minimize the communication and computation cost subject to their trade-off. A decomposition approach is further developed for the sake of scalability. Numerical simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme provides savings of up to 12.44% overall cost.

articleTitle: Interpretable Credit Card Fraud Detection Using Machine Learning Leveraging SHAP
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: More and more companies are taking their services online as a result of how widely accessible the internet is. Besides, because of the growth of E-commerce websites, both individuals and businesses that deal in finances are more dependent on internet administrations to handle their business. Since more and more people are using online banking and making purchases online, credit card fraud has increased. These days, fraudsters use a variety of cutting-edge ways to thwart the methodical operation of the fraud detection system that is already in place. In this research, we have implemented six different machine learning (ML) models to develop an efficient fraud detection system. The techniques in our research include Logistic Regression, SVM, Random Forest, AdaBoost, and AdaBoost with Random Forest and Logistic Regression as the base estimators. Furthermore, to illustrate the classification results, we employed SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to demonstrate the explainability of the two top-performing models. This research shows that the Random Forest and AdaBoost with Random Forest as a base estimator models, are the most effective algorithm with a test accuracy of 99.999% each. Besides, these two models have performed very well in terms of Precision, Recall, and F1-Score than the other ML models.

articleTitle: A Radio Modulation Data Augmentation Method Based on Improved CGAN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of 6G, edge computing, Internet of Things and other technologies has made wireless communication technology an important direction of modern scientific and technological progress. The research of wireless communication technology based on machine learning is facing the common pain point problem of lacking large-scale and high-quality data sets. The application of data-driven learning algorithms is restricted by its inherent characteristics, and wireless communication data has problems such as high collection difficulty, high cleaning cost, and large label data. Therefore, in order to develop wireless communication technology based on machine learning, we first need to meet the needs of high-quality wireless communication data sets. This paper proposes a radio modulation data augmentation method based on improved conditional generative adversarial networks (RMDA-CGAN), and verifies the effectiveness of the augmented data set through classification tasks.

articleTitle: Evaluation of 2.4GHz Signal of Opportunity Localization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Temporal-spatial information plays a critical role in the transportation sector, and a vast number of transportation users rely on Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS), including the BeiDou satellite navigation system, for accurate positioning, navigation and timing services (PNTs). However, the vulnerability of satellite navigation systems highlights the importance of ensuring assured PNTs. The 2.4 GHz frequency band, which falls within the industrial, scientific, and medical (ISM) spectrum, is of significant importance as it accommodates various navigation, communication, and system services. Moreover, it serves as a valuable resource for the advancement of next-generation low-earth orbit satellites (LEOs). This makes it an ideal frequency band for signal of opportunity (SOP) applications. In this paper, we propose an SOP operating at the 2.4 GHz frequency. Through a comprehensive evaluation and analysis, our objective is to develop an effective strategy that can be applied to multi-vehicle, multi-source positioning beacons, offering alternative PNTs in transportation sector.

articleTitle: A Quadratic Sparse Reconstruction Algorithm for DOA Estimation Based on L-shaped Coprime Array
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: An L-shaped coprime phased array has the minimum redundancy of antenna elements, but the high sparsity makes the two-dimensional (2-D) direction of arrival (DOA) estimation very difficult when carrying on a data reconstruction. In this paper, a quadratic reconstruction algorithm based on convex optimization is proposed to restore the whole covariance matrix of an L-shaped coprime array and thus the 2-D DOA estimation can be obtained. First, two virtual uniform linear arrays (ULAs) with the same aperture of the real arrays were extended on X and Y axis, respectively. The properties of Hermite positive definite and Toeplitz structure were used for the first sparse reconstruction to restore the covariance matrix of the two extended ULAs. Then, with the sparse mutual covariance data between the two linear arrays, a secondary sparse reconstruction based on convex optimization was conducted to get the full covariance matrix of the extended L-shaped uniform array according to its positive definite Hermite property. Finally, based on the whole recovered covariance matrix, the 2-D DOA estimates were obtained. By means of the commercial CVX computing platform, the effectiveness and accuracy of the algorithm are verified. The simulation results demonstrate that the accuracy of DOA estimates produced by the proposed method is better than that of the comparison algorithms especially in the low signal-to-noise ratio interval.

articleTitle: Small Object Detection Algorithm Based on Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In response to the problem of low detection accuracy of current object detection algorithms for small objects, a small object detection algorithm based on feature fusion is proposed. In this algorithm, a feature pyramid is constructed in the first three convolutional layers before the backbone network, and two path aggregation channels are added to use the features of high-resolution feature maps and reduce the loss of spatial information for small objects during downsampling. Then, an additional bottom-up channel is added to the feature pyramid of the network neck to fully utilize the spatial information of shallow networks and fuse it with the semantic information of deep networks, retaining more small object features. This algorithm is applied to the YOLOX_s algorithm, and the backbone network structure and feature pyramid network structure of YOLOX_s are improved. Experimental results show that the improved algorithm has an average precision of 84.6% and 42.4% on the PASCAL VOC dataset and the MS COCO dataset, respectively, which is 4.7% and 1.9% higher than that of YOLOX_s. The average precision of small objects reaches 26.2%, which is 2.9% higher than that of YOLOX_s.

articleTitle: Research on Blind Equalization Technique of Hydroacoustic Channel Based on Adaptive Spiral Search Sparrow Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In the process of hydroacoustic communication, the receiver has the problems of serious signal distortion and high bit error rate (BER) due to the multipath effect and Doppler effect of hydroacoustic channel. Therefore, a new sparrow optimization algorithm (WA-SSA) based on adaptive spiral search is proposed and used for the blind equalization technique to solve the above problems. In this algorithm, the population is initialized by Tent chaotic mapping to ensure the diversity of initial positions, and the positions are updated by using the spiral search strategy in the whale algorithm. In addition, the algorithm improves the optimization search process by using the adaptive step size factor, and also perturbs the population by using the Gauss-Cauchy variation to improve the ability of jumping out of the local optimal solution. Finally, the WA-SSA algorithm is used to optimize the tapped power vector of the constant modulus algorithm (CMA) which is applied to the hydroacoustic communication system. Compared with other optimization algorithms, the WA-SSA algorithm converges faster and has higher convergence accuracy. The results of the sea trial experiments show that the CMA technique based on the WA-SSA algorithm improves the convergence accuracy of the constellation map, reduces the mean square error and the BER, and achieves a better equalization effect under three modulation methods, namely 8PSK, 16QAM and 64QAM.

articleTitle: Toward Digital Twin: Leveraging Pre-training Approaches for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Time series forecasting has been an active research area, particularly in the context of Digital Twin (DT) systems. Despite the excellent results yielded by pre-trained models in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Computer Vision (CV), only a few studies have researched pre-training strategies for time series forecasting networks within DT systems. Recent studies demonstrate that transfer learning across multiple time series datasets does not always provide promising results, making self-supervised pre-training directly on the downstream dataset a temporarily considered optimal solution. To the best of our knowledge, the only general pre-training task in the time series field is the Masked Autoencoder. However, this approach may lead to redundant representations for downstream forecasting within DT systems. Therefore, we propose three pre-training tasks specially designed for time series forecasting within DT frameworks: Inverse Forecasting (IF), Coarser Forecasting (CF), and Anomaly Forecasting (AF). These tasks are respectively designed to capture bidirectional dependency, reduce noise, and augment data, all crucial aspects in enhancing the predictive capabilities of DT systems. By integrating the three tasks, we obtain a composite pre-training task which generally improves the forecasting results of time series models within DT systems across multiple datasets. This work contributes to the ongoing efforts to improve the accuracy and efficiency of DT systems, paving the way for more robust and reliable digital representations of physical systems.

articleTitle: Trusted Data Sharing and Storage Technology Based on IPFS and Consortium Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: As an important asset in today's society, data circulation and sharing have become a trend, and privacy and security have become important concerns in the sharing process. To balance privacy, security, and performance in data sharing, and to efficiently share real-time data among collaborating parties, this paper designs a distributed data storage and sharing system that combines IPFS and consortium chains and implements trusted data sharing with TEE. In this system, to address the problem of data leakage in the data sharing process, a TEE-based off-chain contract environment is designed, and based on the IPFS data storage system and the smart contract design in the consortium chain HyperLedger Fabric, multi-level data access restrictions and reputation-based incentive mechanisms are implemented, enabling nodes to actively and reasonably participate in data sharing in the system. Finally, through analysis and experiments, this paper demonstrates the advantages of this system in data security and performance.

articleTitle: Speech Enhancement Based on Dual-Path Cross Parallel Transformer Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
