abstract: In this study, a two-path cross parallel transformer neural network is proposed for simultaneous simulation of amplitude and complex spectrum speech enhancement. An innovative structure is introduced, incorporating a residual connected cross parallel transformer module between the encoder and decoder to achieve outstanding performance. Each module can parallelly utilize local and global transformers to extract local and global information, and apply transformers with cross-attention mechanisms to obtain accurate contextual information. To further enhance accuracy, a mask module is introduced for improving gradient propagation. The output of the mask module passes through the attention sensing fusion module, aiming to fuse the amplitude and complex features learned from the dual path structure for optimal spectrum estimation. Through experiments, it has been proven that our dual path cross parallel transformer neural network performs excellently in terms of performance, surpassing other models. In addition, we also conducted ablation experiments to verify the effectiveness of the cross-transformer module and attention perception fusion module. These experiments further support the superiority and innovation of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Juristic Sentiment Topic Model on Legal Texts
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With the construction of intelligent courts, recommending cases plays an important role in judicial activities. The evaluation of legal texts makes legal texts have a kind of juristic sentiment. Given the lack of supervised information for texts in traditional topic models, JSTM (Juristic Sentiment and Topic Model) is proposed, which takes the evaluation of legal texts as the response variable by continuous transformation and uses the method of variation inference to get topic distribution. The experimental results show that the JSTM can find common and unique topics in different legal texts, and it significantly improves text recommending and dimensionality reduction.

articleTitle: Quadratic Detection Water Depth Estimation Algorithm Based on M-estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To accomplish outlier detection and data quality control for MBES (Multi-beam echo sounding), a quadratic detection water depth method based on M-estimation has been proposed. The single Ping data has been processed. In order to improve the tolerance, the preliminary results of M-estimation are used to identify suspicious areas. The sliding window for M-estimation and the historical window for suspicious areas are used to conduct a quadratic investigation on the data. We estimate the position marked as abnormal by M to be the last point in the quadratic inspection window and process a number of depth measurements up to that point. Since what we examine are the left-hand historical data and the window length has been increased, the proportion of the valid input samples can be increased correspondingly. The suspicious measurement values processed by the algorithm are marked and automatically eliminated at the next input. A hypothesis model was established using a Bayesian model, and multi-depth estimation was established by examining the continuity of different results. The depth with the greatest number of models was used as the estimation depth, while the remaining depth models served as post-processing reference values. This algorithm provides the results of the depth estimation of the corresponding sounding values of each beam, and the detection of outliers can be performed by selecting various thresholds based on the estimation results. The experimental results demonstrate that abnormal pulse outliers and cluster outliers can be detected, and the details can be well reserved. The proposed algorithm has superior estimation performance and improved tolerance.

articleTitle: Nyström-Based 2D DOA Estimation for Large-Scale Polarized Arrays Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the calculation of Long-Vector-based MUSIC(LV-MUSIC) method is too large, a low-complexity direction of arrival (DOA) estimation method suitable for large-scale polarized arrays is proposed. By using the principle of Nyström estimation, the receiving matrix is divided into blocks, and the noise subspace can be estimated only by the feature decomposition of the low-dimensional subcovariance matrix. Then, with the help of the LV-MUSIC method based on rank deficit, the computational load is further reduced from the perspective of spectral peak search. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has a comparable estimation effect with rank deficit LV-MUSIC method. Moreover, under the condition of high Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR), the estimation effect of the proposed method is not affected by the block parameters. For large-scale arrays with large array number of elements, the proposed method has higher operation efficiency.

articleTitle: STAR: Spatial Temporal Network for Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The human body can be regarded as a Kinematic chain composed of multiple rigid bodies connected by various hinges, so studying human action through the skeleton is very effective. With low research costs, skeleton data can be obtained through RGB videos, deep videos, etc. It is not sensitive to views and lighting; it has high accuracy. Skeleton data can be intuitively determined as graphical data, so it is very suitable to study through topography. Using a graph convolution network for spatial feature extraction is very reasonable. However, action is a continuous process and cannot be determined by looking at the skeletal point state of a particular frame alone. Therefore, it is necessary to extract temporal features from data. Therefore, this article proposes a spatiotemporal composite network based on skeleton data. Firstly, skeleton points are removed frame by frame through behavioral videos, followed by spatial and preliminary temporal features extracted through graph convolutional networks and time convolutional networks. Subsequently, temporal features are extracted using transformers and finally perform, feature fusion and behavioral classification through fully connected networks. This article conducted experiments on the NTU-60 and Kinetics datasets and achieved accuracy rates of 86.58%, 91.49%, and 32.93%, respectively. Compared with existing methods, the method proposed in this article has better performance.

articleTitle: No-Reference Image Quality Assessment Based on Active Reasoning Module
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: We present a no-reference image-quality - assessment algorithm based on active reasoning module. This algorithm has three modules: the feature extraction module, the active reasoning module, and the quality assessment module. The active reasoning module incorporates the generator component of the generative adversarial network and enhances its structure with the Res2Net architecture. By integrating this module into the backbone feature extraction network, we improve the receptive field of each convolutional layer, enabling the network to capture information at different scales of the image. To preserve the texture information of the image, we input the gradient map of the distorted image, the distorted image itself, and the image features generated by the generator into the quality assessment module, which has a multi-feature regression networks. This module establishes a mapping model from image-feature to image-quality scores. We conducted experimental analysis of this algorithm on three widely used public datasets, confirming the excellent performance and superiorities of the presented algorithm. The results validate the effectiveness of the designed algorithm and its ability to assess image quality accurately.

articleTitle: Gini Index Based Sparse Reconstruction for Radio Tomographic Imaging
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Radio tomographic imaging (RTI) is a computational imaging technique that estimates the distribution of shadowing loss caused by obstructions in a monitored area using received signal strength (RSS) measurements between radio frequency (RF) network nodes. However, finding a solution to RTI under noise interference is generally an ill-posed inverse problem, and additional measures are required to reduce noise and achieve the desired image properties. The sparse distribution of targets in the monitored areas is intuitively an important prior for accurate image reconstruction. In this article, we propose a Gini index (GI)-based sparse reconstruction approach for RTI that fully leverages sparsity for high-quality imaging. Based on the linear cumulative shadowing model, RTI is formulated using the classical GI from economics as the sparsity measure to construct the optimal objective function. The GI-based objective function is quasi-convex, and RTI is solved by the simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation (SPSA) algorithm. Experimental studies in three different environments are conducted to validate the superior performance of the proposed approach with respect to commonly used regularization and sparsity measures.

articleTitle: Competitiveness Evaluation of Marine Engineering Equipment Manufacturing Enterprise Based on BP Neural Network: Evidence from A-Share Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The marine engineering equipment manufacturing industry is characterized by high technology and high added value. It is one of the key industries for “Made in China 2025”, the foundation for China to build maritime and manufacturing power, and an important step to maintain the interests of national maritime security. The industry's safe and independent development depends on the central role of enterprises, and the improvement of the competitiveness of enterprises plays a considerable role in promoting the transition to new from old economic engines and the formation of the system of the whole industry. Combining with the characteristics of China's marine engineering equipment manufacturing enterprises, we establish the competitiveness evaluation system, determine the index weight using the Analytic Hierarchy Process, and set the BP neural network model for the competitiveness evaluation of China's marine engineering equipment enterprises. We analyze the sensitivity of the index through BP neural network, summarize the influencing factors of enterprise competitiveness, and combine them with the advantages of Japanese and Korean vital enterprises to provide a reference for the competitiveness of China's marine engineering equipment manufacturing enterprises. Results show that most of our country's marine engineering equipment manufacturing enterprises have significant differences between production and marketing ability, environmental support ability, and R&D ability. At the same time, the degree of influence of secondary indicators on competitiveness varies from company to company, so we have formulated the corresponding strategy to enhance the overall competitiveness and promote the healthy and sustainable development of the marine engineering equipment manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: A Hyperspectral Image Classification Method Based on The Multi-Angle Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The number of hyperspectral image samples is relatively small, which leads to extracting incomplete features and low image classification accuracy. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a hyperspectral image classification method based on multi-angle feature extraction. Firstly, The algorithm divides original bands into groups based on principal components analysis. The bands form the spectral, spatial, and channel modules. Secondly, the method builds a three-branch network model to extract hyperspectral image features by designing attention mechanisms and improving the convolutional network. Finally, the fused features are passed through a classifier to achieve hyperspectral image classification. The classification results show that the classification accuracy has reached 92.4% under the condition that the proportion of training samples is only 5%. It shows that the proposed algorithm can effectively improve the classification accuracy of hyperspectral images with excellent performance in the case of small training samples.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Analysis and Prediction of Trailing Suction Dredger Mud Pump Based on Grey Correlation Analysis and Stacking Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To optimize the construction parameters of trailing suction dredger, as well as reduce the energy consumption and carbon emission of dredging operation, the energy efficiency analysis and prediction of trailing suction dredger mud pump are carried out. Firstly, the energy consumption per unit productivity (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$EC_{\text{pup}}$</tex>) of dredging and its six influencing factors are analyzed by grey correlation analysis, and the importance of various factors affecting energy efficiency is obtained. Then, a learner based on stacking strategy (LBSS) composed of support vector regression (SVR), random forest regression (RFR) and light gradient boosting machine (LightGBM) models is used to predict the energy efficiency of the trailing suction dredger mud pump. The results show that the importance of the factors that affecting the energy efficiency of the mud pump are as follows: mud pump vacuum > mud flow velocity > mud pump pressure > mud density> mud concentration> mud pump rotation speed. The prediction performance of LBSS model is better than SVR, RFR and LightGBM models, and higher accuracy is achieved in predicting the energy efficiency of mud pump. During the dredging operation of the dredger, the operator can optimize the construction parameters according to the energy efficiency prediction results and the importance of various factors. The study can provide guidance and reference for real-time optimization, energy conservation and emission reduction in dredging construction of the same type dredger.

articleTitle: Model-based Strong Electromagnetic Pulse Protection Optimization Design of Wheeled Armor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The wheeled armor is faced with more complex external electromagnetic environment in the modern war, in which the threat electromagnetic environment led by strong electromagnetic pulse has the characteristics of narrow time-domain waveform and steep rising edge, high intensity and wide coverage, which poses a serious threat to the vehicle platform with high electronic and electrical integration. The EMP protection design of the whole vehicle platform needs the support of fast and accurate modeling methods to help designers analyze and evaluate the electromagnetic threat and complete the improvement and optimization. An innovative platform-level EMP protection optimization design scheme is proposed. This method is based on the vehicle level strong EMP effect model and takes electromagnetic protection and reinforcement measures for electrical discontinuities such as car windows, holes and gaps. The protection effectiveness of the vehicle platform is also compared and verified through simulation in the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Path Optimization Method for Maritime Drones
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, based on graph theory and multi-objective optimization theory, the trajectory planning problem of maritime drones is studied. A mathematical model is established using directed graphs, with the objectives of minimizing the trajectory length and the number of corrections. Different from previous algorithms, this paper refers to the idea of the A-star algorithm and combines dynamic labeling and non-dominated sorting strategies to propose an efficient heuristic algorithm: the multi-objective path planning algorithm based on forward labels. The result of this algorithm is a set of Pareto optimal solutions, which require further selection using an ideal point-based best compromise solution method to obtain the best compromise plan. In addition, this paper conducts a comparative study with the NSGA-II algorithm, verifying the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed algorithm. The results show that the algorithm in this paper can quickly obtain the best compromise solution.

articleTitle: Robust Integrated Navigation Signal Processing Method Using Variational Bayesian Cubature Kalman Filter with Chi-Square Test
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper considers a robust integrated navigation system that copes with the time-varying measurement noise in a hostile environment. The Chi-square test is used to get rid of the disturbance of measurement outlier. And the estimation of measurement noise is provided by the variational Bayesian method to perform an accuracy state estimation within a challenged navigation environment. With regard to a practical system, the computation burden of the proposed algorithm is vital for the embedded system resource. The detailed numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed filter has an advantage over the traditional filter in global performance.

articleTitle: Fault Location Method for Distribution Network Based on Fusion of Transient Energy and Polarity Value Comparison
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The widespread application of distributed generator (DG) in distribution networks can improve the quality of electrical energy and ensure the stability of power supply, but at the same time, it raises the electricity network's complexity and fault rate, which has a significant impact on the power network's ability to operate safely, reliably, and effectively. Consequently, in order to assure the safety, dependable, and effective functioning of distribution network systems, it is crucial to minimize the hazards that DG pose to their operation. To successfully use DG to address the issue of single-phase ground fault location in distribution networks, this paper elucidates the transient energy and the polarity value comparison fault location method, proposes a distribution network fault location method based on fusion of transient energy and polarity value comparison.

articleTitle: A Pruning Method of the Generalized Memory Polynomial Model for Power Amplifiers Based on the LASSO Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a pruning method based on the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression is proposed for pruning the redundant terms of the generalized memory polynomial (GMP) model. As an advanced machine learning algorithm, the LASSO regression is also an effective option for behavioral models of power amplifiers (PAs). The GMP model increases the number of model coefficients significantly with increasing memory depth and non-linear order, which can lead to a significant increase in model complexity and the risk of overfitting. The pruning method takes advantage of the fact that the LASSO regression can prevent overfitting and yield sparse solutions by introducing the L1-norm as a penalty factor into the coefficient extraction process of the GMP model, which can directly reduce the number of coefficients in the model to prune it while maintaining modelling performance. Compared to other model pruning techniques, this pruning method allows for better control over the number of coefficients in the model, determining the appropriate model complexity and accuracy based on the actual application scenario. The experimental results show that the proposed method maintains good modeling performance with low model complexity, requiring only about 60% of the number of coefficients from the original GMP model.

articleTitle: A Multi-Frequency Diplexer for the Sub-6 GHz Band
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a microstrip diplexer network that covers the frequency bands of 0.6–0.96 GHz, 1.7–2.7 GHz, 3.3–4 GHz and 4.9–6 GHz. The diplexer is composed of the multiple matching branch and the filtering branch. Its insertion loss at lower- and middle frequencies is less than 1.5 dB, and that at upper frequency is under 2.5 dB. The diplexer achieves broadband and steep-edge filtering performances. Therefore, it can be well applied in 5G indoor distribution systems.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction Based on Wavelet Transform and Group of Long-Short Term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In the research of stock price prediction, predicting with neural network has gradually become popular. In this paper, the stock price data is processed through wavelet and Long short-term memory (LSTM) network group(W-LSTMG). The original data is decomposed using Wavelet Transform (WT) to obtain their time frequency features with different scales. And then, every component is inputted to a LSTM model. Each LSTM model has different topological structure and parameters. At last, the prediction results are reconstructed using inverse WT. In order to verify the feasibility of the model, mean square errors (MSEs) of LSTM, the model using WT and single LSTM network (W-LSTM) and W-LSTMG is calculated as performance evaluation criteria of the prediction. The results suggest that W-LSTMG model presents the lowest prediction error in stock price prediction.

articleTitle: Document Image Object Detection Algorithm Based on Transformer and Mixed-MLP Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The feature extraction network based on convolutional neural network has a strong ability to extract local features, but it is insufficient to connect the information of different spatial regions in global scope. To solve this problem, a document image object detection model using Transformer as the feature extraction backbone network is proposed. On the one hand, Transformer extracts image features and utilizes self-attention mechanism to establish global information connections. On the other hand, Mixed-MLP network consisting of channel mixing (C-Mix) layers and spatial mixing (S-Mix) layers explores information communication in spatial dimension and channel dimension. The extracted image features are represented by multi-scale hierarchical network, and feature pyramid is built to detect objects of different scales. The experimental results show that the precision of detection on PubLayNet and ICDAR-POD are 0.958 mAP and 0.952 mAP respectively, which achieve competitive results.

articleTitle: A Non-Stationary Geometry-Based Channel Model for Vehicle-to- Vehicle Communications in Tunnel Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In the framework of the fifth generation (5G) wireless network, vehicle-to-vehicle(V2V) communication in tunnel scenarios has received more and more interests. In the article, a three-dimension (3D) geometry-based channel model (GBSM) is proposed. By considering the scattering of tunnel walls and other vehicles, a semicylinder and two cylinders centered on the transmitter (Tx) and receiver (Rx) are applied to simulate the communication environment of the tunnel scenario. We derive and explore the corresponding statistical properties including temporal auto-correlation function (ACF), space cross-correlation function (SCCF) as well as frequency correlation function (FCF). The conclusions indicate that the velocity of Tx and distance between Tx and Rx both have impacts on the statistical properties.

articleTitle: A Global Optimal Association Algorithm Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this study, a global optimal association algorithm based on fuzzy comprehensive decision-making is proposed to enhance the accuracy and computational efficiency of associating radar and Automatic Identification System (AIS) track data. The algorithm combines spatial partitioning to reduce computational complexity, and utilizes error calibration and global optimal methods to enhance association accuracy. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm achieves higher association accuracy and shorter running time compared to traditional track association algorithms. This improvement is particularly notable when handling a large number of tracks.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of Image Super-Resolution Based on Bicubic Interpolation and CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In the field of GPU graphics processing, pixel performance is often the bottleneck of system performance. Reducing the load of the pixel engine is of great significance to improving the graphics performance of the chip. After rendering low-resolution images, the resolution is scaled to the desired size, which has become a widely used performance optimization method. Inspired by this approach, this paper proposes a method based on FPGA acceleration to scale 1K low-resolution (LR) images to 4K super-resolution (SR) images. The combination of bicubic interpolation and improved SRCNN is adopted to scale images. The algorithm structure is optimized through High-Level Synthesis (HLS), and the accelerated circuit is deployed on Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA). Experimental result shows that FPGA achieves image super-resolution with lower latency than Intel Core i5- 8300H CPU and lower power consumption than NVIDIA GTX 2080Ti GPU.

articleTitle: Dual-Band Millimeter-Wave Filtering Power Divider Using Groove Gap Waveguide and Spoof Surface Plasmon Polariton
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a millimeter-wave dual-band filtering power divider, which is based on groove gap waveguides (GGW), spoof surface plasmon polariton (SSPP), and full-metal resonance structure (FMRS). First, the GGW and SSPP are used to construct a T-junction single-band filtering power divider. Then, a full-metal resonance structure is introduced to form a stopband, dividing the single wideband into dual-band operation. Finally, these two components and functions are integrated. Simulation results prove the good performance of the proposed design, with lower band ranging from 20.65GHz to 25.42GHz (FBW=20.71%) and upper band ranging from 27.73GHz to 30.97GHz (FBW=11.04%). The return loss is better than 12.8 dB and 15 dB, respectively. Both bands maintain a rather low insertion loss below 0.24 dB. Due to the use of full-metal structure, the proposed design shows the characteristics of low loss and large power capacity.

articleTitle: An Implementation of Fading Channel Simulator for Discrete-Time Wireless Communication Based on USRP Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents an implementation of a channel simulator in software-defined-radio(SDR). The implementation of simulator is implemented on an Universal Software Radio Peripheral (USRP) and GNU Radio software. Simulation part is implemented in GNU Radio software, and RF conversion is performed by USRP. This channel simulator includes multipath simulation and fading simulation, such as Rayleigh and Rician fading channels. Fading simulation is implemented by sum-of-sinusoids-based model, and using fir filter to realize fractional delay in multipath simulation. Using the proposed method, we can efficiently achieve the desired simulate result.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Improvement of GNSS Receivers Based on Robust Cascade Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Conventional Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) receivers are designed based on scalar tracking loops, which can lead to performance degradation or even loss of lock under high dynamic and weak signal environments. A cascaded vector tracking loops is designed to enhance the receiver performance in harsh environments. Firstly, the delay/phase locked loop is replaced by Kalman filter (KF), and fading factor is introduced into loop filter to improve the dynamic performance of loop tracking. Then, extended Kalman Filter (EKF) is adopted to fuse all channel information to estimate the receiver state, and the Chi-square detection is used to isolate channel fault information in vector feedback to enhance the robustness of vector tracking. Finally, the vehicle experiments results confirm the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method in dynamic scenarios.

articleTitle: A Jamming Decision-Making Method Based on Next State Prediction SAC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In light of the growing complexity of the electromagnetic environment, traditional jamming decision-making methods have become less effective due to poor generalization and inefficient jamming performance. This paper proposes a jamming decision-making method based on next state prediction SAC (Soft Actor-Critic) to address this issue. Firstly, we design the state, action, and reward elements under electronic warfare scenarios. Secondly, a next state prediction critic network is proposed to accurately estimate the value function by modeling the environment dynamics and extracting richer representational information. Finally, a negative activation ReLU is introduced to improve the utilization ratio of network parameters. Simulation results show that the proposed method achieves a 98.4% success rate at a distance of 90 km from the radar and a 70.0% success rate at 30 km. Therefore, this method exhibits good adaptability and jamming performance in the field of jamming decision-making.

articleTitle: Design of a Coupled-Fed Implantable Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a miniaturized implantable antenna working at ISM 2.4 GHz band. The antenna consists of radiation layer and a full ground plane. The radiation layer comes from a microstrip-fed rectangular patch half cutting at the middle line forming two parts. One part of the half cutting patch is direct fed and another one is coupled fed to obtain wide bandwidth. The proposed antenna is printed on a flexible <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$70\ \mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> thick polymide substrate with size of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{11}\ \mathbf{mm} \times \mathbf{16}\ \mathbf{mm}$</tex>. The simulated bandwidth of the proposed antenna is 2.34 - 2.58 GHz covering ISM 2.4 GHz band.

articleTitle: Popularization and Advancement of Cybersecurity in China: Status and Measures
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In recent years, due to the increasing frequency of global cyber-attacks, the importance of cybersecurity has also increased. The popularization of security science in the entire cyberspace has become a key issue in China. In order to improve the public awareness and quality of cybersecurity, the related departments have introduced a series of relevant laws and measures, actively carrying out cybersecurity science popularization work. This paper explores the current situation of cybersecurity science popularization in China and propose corresponding suggestions.

articleTitle: An Optimization Method for LDO Design Based on ANN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to solve the issues of long design cycles and low efficiency of integrated circuit design., a new method combining ANN algorithm was proposed to improve the comprehensive performance of LDO circuits. In this paper., the device parameters and corresponding performance of the LDO circuit were collected as a dataset to train the ANN model. When given the specific target performance of the LDO circuit., the model can predict the optimal device parameters corresponding to the performance., achieving the synchronous improvement of the four key parameters of PM, UGBW., PSRR., and I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Q</inf>. The results show that the R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of the ANN model can be as high as 0.982. Therefore., the proposed method in this paper can effectively accelerate the design of LDO and improve its comprehensive performance.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Object Detection Algorithm Based on Decoupled Networks and Upsampling Aggregation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Multi-scale object detection requires addressing the challenge of differences between features at different scales. To improve detection precision across scales, a Scale Decoupled Networks (SDNets) and Upsampling Aggregation Module (UAM)-based algorithm is proposed. SDNets uses three parallel detection branches for small, medium, and large-scale objects to reduce conflicts between different scale features. Convolutions with different receptive fields extract features of different scales, enhancing the network's ability to express them. UAM adds a pathway for upsampling feature fusion during downsampling, improving the effect of feature fusion. Experimental results show that our algorithm achieves 83.2% detection precision on the VOC dataset, 2.0% higher than YOLOX and 0.3% higher than YOLOv7, and improves detection precision for small, medium, and large-scale objects by 3.7%, 2.7%, and 2.1%, respectively.

articleTitle: A Tri-Band Millimeter-Wave MIMO Antenna for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a two-element tri-band CPW-fed millimeter-wave multiple input multiple output(MIMO) antenna is proposed for Internet of Things (IOT) applications. The antenna elements are parallel placed. The isolation is enhanced by utilizing the defected ground structure(DGS) and CSRR structure. The MIMO antenna is printed on substrate liquid crystal polymer(LCP) with a compact size of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{11}\times \mathbf{22}\times \mathbf{0.1}\text{mm}^3$</tex>. The proposed antenna covers the frequency ranges of 16.94-19.31GHz, 27.64-30.45GHz and 37.39-40.09GHz. Furthermore, the MIMO antenna possesses an excellent isolation performance with the isolation of better than 21dB in the whole operating band. Moreover, the presented antenna realized low ECC of less than 0.05 with a high DG of 9.99dB. The presented MIMO antenna shows promising application prospect in KU band and 5G 28/38GH field.

articleTitle: Adaptive-Bert Network for Advertising Text Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Our system automatically generates tailored ad text based on the travel magazine advertisements layout and multiple travel blogs. The user inputs the layout of the travel magazine advertisement, which is then processed by a prediction-evaluation model (PEM). This model predicts the required number of text words and font size in the layout based on the input layout. Next, feed the data generated by the PEM and multiple tourism blogs into the text generation model, and ultimately produce text that meets the requirements and fits the designated text area in tourism magazines' advertisements. The generated text is then placed in the text area of the layout. It includes our new self-attention layer to ensure that the output text contains essential information. We conducted extensive experiments on real datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed model. Using our model(Adaptive-Bert), users can create travel magazine advertising text that meets their requirements. Our method ensures that the generated text is of high quality and meets layout requirements.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Resistance of TSV in TSV-Based Inductors with Air Core
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: An analytical method is presented for determining the resistance of through-silicon via (TSV) in TSV-based inductors with air core. Firstly, integral equations are established by the boundary condition. Secondly, we solve integral equations by an approximate method of undetermined coefficients, and obtain the current density. Thirdly, the resistance calculated by current density are compared with the result got from the full-wave simulator in Ansys HFSS, which shows that error is less than 7%.

articleTitle: Research on Double Closed Loop Equalization Control Strategy of Lithium-ion Battery in Electric Vehicle Based on Multivariable Coordination
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In trying to address the discrepancy between single batteries in series connection of power li-ion battery packs for electric vehicles, a multivariable coordinated equalization control scheme is proposed according to the OCV -SOC curve, which is characterized by “steep at both ends and gentle in the middle”. When the State of Charge (SOC) is no less than 20% and no more than 90%, SOC is nominated as a variable in the course of equilibrium; When the SOC is less than 20% or more than 90%, voltage is selected as a variable in the equalization process. Therefore, on the basis of the cascaded cuk equalization circuit, a double-closed-loop equalization control strategy based on multivariable coordination is designed. The outer loop adopts variable theory division fuzzy control, and the inner loop adopts fuzzy PID control. The balance current is dynamically adjusted by modifying the duty ratio of MOSFET in the balance circuit. The analog results revealed that the equalization strategy can accurately control the equalization current under three different conditions of resting, charging and discharging, to achieve effective equalization of the battery group and the desired balancing effect.

articleTitle: Measurement-Based Extraction and Analysis of Multipath Component for Suspension Bridge Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a measurement campaign conducted to investigate the characteristics of the vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) wireless channel in the context of a suspension bridge environment is introduced. Based on the measurement, the main multipath components (MPCs) that significantly affect the channel are extracted. The analysis is performed on the power, delay, and Doppler frequency of these main MPCs. The differences and connections between the extracted and measured values are compared and analyzed, providing a better understanding of the impact of MPCs caused by the unique structure of the bridge on the V2V channel.

articleTitle: Channel Estimation of RIS-Assisted Communication System Based on Residual Ratio Threshold
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) can improve the coverage range and signal quality of wireless networks. But its performance depends on the estimation accuracy of channel state information (CSI). The compressed sensing based on stage-wise orthogonal matching pursuit (StOMP) algorithm can be employed to estimate the CSI, however, the hard threshold methods involved in the traditional StOMP can introduce the undesired noise components and redundant atoms, thereby reducing the accuracy of estimated CSI and even lower the convergence speed. To this end, a novel channel estimation approach using the improved StOMP algorithm is proposed in RIS-assisted system to improve the channel estimation quality while achieving the high-speed convergence. By utilizing the difference between residual ratios of adjacent iterations, a normalization procedure can be performed to optimize the iterative stopping conditions, and the algorithm can effectively reduce the impact of out-of-band noise while optimizing the iteration stopping condition with normalized residual ratios. Furthermore, it can reduce redundant atom selection and leads to faster system operation. The results demonstrate that the proposed method can reduce the run time by 5 times at a relatively low complexity with favorable estimation accuracy. Moreover, it can also achieve 86% reduction in the selection of redundant atom.

articleTitle: E-Band Substrate Integrated Waveguide Bandpass Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes and designs an E-band bandpass filter based on substrate integrated waveguide (SIW). On the basis of the traditional SIW filter, a folded hybrid coupling SIW filter is designed by further miniaturization and the combination of through-hole magnetic coupling and slot electric coupling. Adopting rectangular slots to provide electric coupling, the resonant cavity is excited by a combination of through-hole magnetic coupling and slot electric coupling, with the coupling efficiency controlled by the width and length of the slot. Physical test results show that the center frequency of the filter is 83.5GHz, and the filter performance is good. Within the passband range of 81-86GHz, the insertion loss is less than 3dB, the ripple inside the waveguide is less than 1dB, and the out-of-band suppression is excellent.

articleTitle: The Detection Performance Analysis of Vector Circular Array for Small Underwater Platforms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The weight and volume of a sonar receiving array are strictly limited by small platforms, so finding an efficient acoustic receiving array with a small size and light weight has received extensive attention. Acoustic vector hydrophone has better directivity and anti-interference ability than traditional acoustic pressure hydrophone. In this paper, the detection performance of a small underwater platform with a vector circular array was studied. The performance of direction of arrival (DOA) estimation and distance estimation of sound pressure array and vector array were compared. Then, examples were given to illustrate the detectable area and proportional error of distance measurement under different types of signals. The simulation results showed that the acoustic vector sensor array consisting of fewer elements had the same detecting performance as the acoustic pressure array with more elements. Finally, it was also proved that it was feasible to replace the large volume acoustic pressure array with a small volume acoustic vector sensor array working at low frequency.

articleTitle: The Magnetic Anomaly Inversion of Magnetic Targets Based on Convolutional Neural Network Using Undersampled Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In magnetic target detection, the inversion of the target object can be achieved by observing and recording the magnetic anomaly values of magnetic bodies, thereby obtaining the position information of the target magnetic anomaly body. In order to identify the shape and location of the magnetic anomaly objects accurately, an under-sampled data magnetic anomaly inversion method based on convolutional neural networks was proposed. In this method, a large number of magnetic anomaly observation data were generated through the forward model, the observation data were undersampled, and then the undersampled data were used as input to train the network. Finally, the validation of the model data was achieved. The experiment proves that this method can accurately reflect the position information and magnetization strength values of magnetic anomaly bodies.

articleTitle: Wave Self-Attention Mechanism for Three-Dimensional Features
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Accurately distinguishing organs from CT scans is a demanding yet indispensable task due to its complexity. A frequent quandary in various preceding studies is that we are required to utilize Visual Transformer (ViT) technology and expend significant resources to attain comprehensive self-attentive insights into characteristics. In this paper, we propose a new paradigm for integrating self-attention and feature dimensionality reduction into CT image segmentation, aiming at reduce resource consumption by compression of feature which is used for self-attention extraction. Specifically, we propose a novel module to extract condensed attentional features, wherein wave attention is used to precisely identify the focal areas of interest from the compressed features. In those identified regions, the self-attention with head fusion records the interrelatedness of spatial features over extended distances. Furthermore, an Parallel wave dimensionality reduction strategy is proposed to compression voxel characteristics and decompression wave characteristics by the generated approximation reciprocal matrix in a asymmetrical fashion. The experimental results of kidney segmentation on the Synapse benchmark dataset manifest that our approach achieves an absolute enhancement of 1.56% and 32.83% accuracy (DSC) and efficiency (PST) respectively, when compared to the existing state-of-the-art techniques.

articleTitle: Design of Wideband Transmitarray with 1-Bit Beam-Deflection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper introduces a linearly polarized beam-deflection array that operates in the X-band and has a phase resolution of 1 bit. The transmission unit consists of three media layers and three metal layers. Its metal layers include metal strips with specific arrangements are used to twist the polarization of electromagnetic waves by <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\pm 90^{\circ}}$</tex>, and then the middle metal layer is rotated by 90° to form a phase difference of 0°/180°. A <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{20\times 20}$</tex> transmission array with beam deflection is designed using this unit. The designed antenna array shows good electrical characteristics including gain of 16 dBi at 11GHz and stable radiation patterns at both H- and V-planes.

articleTitle: A System of Layout Robust Text Detection and Recognition for Washing Label
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The washing label on the clothes contains information about the fabric composition and washing instructions. Text detection and recognition of the washing label can be used to recommend suitable washing and caring programs for the clothes. The goal of this study is to design an algorithm for detecting text and an algorithm for recognizing the text in washing labels. To solve the problem of lacking washing label dataset, this study constructs a washing label dataset (WLD) for text detection and recognition research task. By training these models on the WLD and experimentally verified the advantages of this study in washing label text detection and recognition.

articleTitle: P-Norm Based Subband Adaptive Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The normalized subband adaptive filtering algorithm can improve the convergence rate of the normalized least mean square algorithm when dealing with the correlated input signals, but it is plagued by a slow convergence issue in the stable noise. For that reason, the normalized subband p-norm (NSPN) algorithm based on the mean p-power error criterion is proposed in this paper, which shows a fast convergence rate in the α-stable noise. Moreover, by taking advantage of the tap-weights feedback-based convex combination (TFC) scheme, we propose the TFC based NSPN algorithm, which further reaches low steady-state misadjustment under fast convergence. Simulation results have confirmed the superior performance of the proposed algorithms in both system identification and acoustic echo cancellation scenarios.

articleTitle: A Wide-Band Miniaturization Power Amplifier by Using Short-Step Chebyshev Impedance Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a wide-band miniaturization power amplifier (PA) is proposed. A short-step Chebyshev impedance transformer is used to solve the output match circuits of the proposed PA. By selecting the match impedance value with compromise in desired pass-band appropriately, the short-step Chebyshev impedance transformer realizes wide-band impedance matching as well as miniaturization. A brief analysis of the short-step Chebyshev impedance transformer is presented. To prove the effectiveness of this method, a wide-band miniaturization PA operating from 1 to 3 GHz is designed, simulated and measured. The measured results show that the saturated output power of 41-42.7 dBm with the gain of 9.2-11.6 dB is achieved, and the power-added efficiency (PAE) is 51.5-64.8%. The proposed method is potential in the applications of wide-band, miniature PA, and so on.

articleTitle: A Simple Directional Patch Antenna with High Gain for WLAN Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a high-gain directional antenna, which is suitable for 2.4 GHz wireless local area network (WLAN) applications. The antenna consists of a T-shaped patch etched with a rectangular slot, a rectangular ground plane, a reflector with metal strips around it. By adding symmetrical rectangular metal sheet around the antenna, the profile of the antenna can be reduced to 0.112 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\lambda}_{\mathbf{0}}$</tex> (where <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\lambda}_{\mathbf{0}}$</tex> is the wavelength of 2.4 GHz in the free space), and the bandwidth can be expanded. This work is constructed using the finite element method based on the ANSYS HFSS software. The antenna has an impedance bandwidth of 35.4% (2.23-3.08 GHz), and the corresponding gain varies within <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{7.43}\pm \mathbf{0.02}\ \mathbf{dBi}$</tex>. The proposed antenna with the simple and thin structure is suitable for the applications such as bluetooth and zigbee.

articleTitle: An Improved Algorithm for Identifying Facial Images Feature of Shadow Puppets Based on YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In response to the subjectivity and high workload of traditional cultural image feature recognition methods, a deep learning model, YOLOv5s-GCT (YOLOv5s with Ghost, Coordinate, and Transformer Modules), is proposed in this paper for recognizing facial features in shadow puppet images. The model is based on YOLOv5s and is designed to reduce both computational and model complexity by incorporating the Ghost structure. The features of the model are assigned weights using the attention module, CA (Coordinate Attention), and the Transformer module is utilized to enhance the model's global information acquisition ability. The model parameters are reduced to 2.6MB, which is one-fifth of the size of YOLOv5s, and the mAP is improved to 91.6%. The proposed approach shows effective results in achieving fast and accurate recognition with reduced computational complexity.

articleTitle: Research on Cross-coupling Compensation Method Based on Multi-transmitter WPT System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In the multi-transmitter wireless power transmission system (WPT), the cross-coupling between transmitting coils will affect the operating state of the system, leading to the reduction of the transmission power and efficiency of the system. Aiming at the problem of cross-coupling in multi-transmitter wireless charging system, starting from its equivalent circuit model, the zero-coupling model and cross-coupling model are established respectively, and the influence of cross-coupling between transmitting coils on the transmission efficacy of the system is analyzed. The compensation conditions of the cross-coupling system are given, and the cross-coupling effect of the multi-transmitter WPT system is compensated by adding a compensation reactance to the transmitting loop. The simulation results show that the method can compensate the cross-coupling effect and improve the transmission efficacy of the system.

articleTitle: Adaptive Modulation and Coding Scheme Based on Multi-source Indicator Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Underwater acoustic communication systems play a crucial role in ocean development and management. However, the complexity and variability of ocean communication channels pose challenges for ensuring reliable and stable communication quality using single-modulation coding systems. Consequently, the effectiveness of underwater acoustic communication technology is significantly impacted. To enhance the throughput of ocean communication systems, researchers have explored and implemented adaptive modulation and coding (AMC) techniques in underwater acoustic communication systems. However, traditional AMC methods that rely on fixed thresholds suffer from issues such as inaccurate channel state assessment and imprecise Modulation and Coding Scheme (MCS) selection. In this paper, we propose the integration of neural network algorithms into adaptive modulation and coding for ocean channels. Specifically, we present a novel approach called the multi-source index fusion underwater adaptive modulation and coding method, which leverages neural networks. We also devise a neural network-based solution to address the Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) feature matrix, thereby enhancing system classification accuracy and throughput. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed adaptive modulation and coding method, based on multi-source index fusion, outperforms the traditional method that relies on fixed threshold MCS judgment. It achieves a significant increase in system throughput.

articleTitle: An Improved Equivalent Circuit Model of Single Photon Avalanche Photodiode with Voltage-Variable Junction Capacitance and Current-Controlled Avalanche Switch
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, an improved single-photon avalanche photodiode (SPAD) equivalent circuit model is proposed. As a high-performance optoelectronic device, SPAD has a wide range of applications in optical communication, biomedical and quantum communication, etc. Establishing the SPAD equivalent circuit model is crucial for the analysis and use of SPAD performance because EDA tools can direct the design and optimization of photodetection systems. In order to make the simulation of photocurrent behavior more compatible with the actual scenario, this paper adopts segmented modeling of SPAD photocurrent and uses approximate fitting function to solve the problem of non-convergence in simulation analysis. Additionally, in this study, current control switches are used to replicate the SPAD's avalanche state in response to a change in photocurrent and to provide more accurate avalanche control. To address the problem that the junction capacitance of the SPAD varies with the voltage between the anode and cathode, this paper uses ABM devices to build an accurate and portable model of the voltage-variable junction capacitance, which can improve simulation accuracy.

articleTitle: A Beam-Scanning Reflectarray with the Weighted Average Phase Compensation for the150-160 GHz Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a 15×15 beam scanning reflectarray operating in 150–160 GHz is proposed. The element consists of 3-layer patches conducted with metal vias. The proposed weighted average phase compensation method is used to obtain stable beam and low gain variations during the beam scanning process. Furthermore, the comparisons of radiation between normal phase compensation and weighted average phase are given to verify the effectiveness of the method. Results show that a large scanning angle of ±50° and a maximum gain of 18.7 dBi with gain variations less than 1.8 dB can be achieved, and hence the proposed antenna array is suitable for future 6G communication system.

articleTitle: High-Precision UAV Micro-Motion Feature Extraction and Estimation Method Based on Local Maximum Synchroextracting Transform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Accurately estimating the micro-motion parameters of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is of significant importance for UAV recognition and classification. Traditional time-frequency analysis methods have low resolution and suffer from severe cross-term interference, making it challenging to precisely estimate the micro-motion parameters of UAVs. In order to slove this problem, this paper proposes a high-resolution local maximum synchroextracting transform method(LSET). Firstly, echo data is collected using FMCW, and then the data is subjected to STFT. Next, an estimation of the instantaneous frequency is calculated, and finally, the value of the maximum energy in the time-frequency representation is extracted to retain useful information. The experimental results from the actual data testing show that compare with the traditional time-frequency analysis method, the proposed method reduces the average Renyi entropy by 4.7 dB. A smaller entropy value indicates higher time-frequency resolution and energy concentration. This method improves the average length estimation accuracy of rotating blades by 33.3%.

articleTitle: The MMSE MIMO Detector Under a New LMMSE Channel Estimation Error Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The MIMO detector should output the log-likelihood ratio (LLR) of each coded bit to the channel decoder in order to achieve the desired bit error rate (BER) performance in a channel coded multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) system, whereas channel estimation error which will result in performance degradation in the practical MIMO system. This paper proposes to divide the linear minimum mean square error(LMMSE) into two parts: white noise error and Wiener filter error (the error caused by the ideal channel after Wiener filtering). Based on the Wiener filter coefficients, noise, and channel response, we can derive channel estimation errors and incorporate them into the MMSE detector to improve system performance. The simulation results show that the proposed new method can improve system performance with negligible complexity increase.

articleTitle: A High-Performance SIW Slot Antenna Array for mmWave Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a high-performance millimeter-wave radar antenna is designed. This antenna is Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW) planar slotted array with narrow beam width, high gain and low sidelobe level at 77 GHz. Firstly, the excitation amplitude distribution of the array element corresponding to −20 dB sidelobe level is obtained by Taylor synthesis method. Thus, the design parameters of the array elements can be obtained. The feed network of the antenna is composed of an air-filled rectangular waveguide (RWG) to Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW) transition and a power division feed network. Finally, the array element and the feed network are combined to form an <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$8\times 16$</tex> slot array. The overall simulation design is carried out in HFSS. In the simulation, RWG is used to replace SIW equivalently to accelerate the simulation speed and save design resources. The simulation results show that the gain at 77 GHz is 21.4 dB with 75 % radiation efficiency, and the front-to-back ratio is 45.5 dB. Within the relative bandwidth of 2 %, the VSWR of the feed port is less than 1.78. The design can satisfy the antenna requirements in millimeter-wave radar systems.

articleTitle: TCR Self-Calibration System for Electrically Heated Tobacco Products
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: An adaptive temperature coefficient of resistance (TCR) calibration scheme is proposed in this paper. The aim is to address temperature control errors caused by TCR of heating elements, in the heater of electrically heated tobacco products (eHTP). Data on the resistance and temperature of the heating element are collected. The adaptive scheme and a direct fitting scheme are executed based on the data obtained. Comparing the temperature control effect of the two schemes, it can be found that those two schemes have similar temperature control accuracy. The results show that the proposed scheme maintains temperatures within <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm 3{}^{\circ }\mathrm{C}$</tex> of the target, and the direct fitting scheme can control the temperatures within <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm 2{}^{\circ }\mathrm{C}$</tex> of the target. Finally, a physical test is carried out. The adaptive scheme can meet the expected criteria for TCR calibration and temperature control effects.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Speech Enhancement Method Based on CNNLMS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This letter presents a two-stage speech enhancement framework based on a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) and the Least Mean Square (LMS) algorithm. Feature extraction and channel filtering can reduce background noise and enhance speech quality. Combining these techniques can improve speech quality in low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions. Temporal features are extracted with a one-dimensional convolutional neural network. The nonlinear mapping between the signals is estimated. The output signals of the neural network are further denoised using the LMS algorithm, which can adjust the filter coefficients to suppress noise signals and improve the clarity of speech signals. Compared with other algorithms, such as a neural network algorithm based on spectral mapping, or the algorithm based on time-frequency masking, our proposed CNNLMS method can increase the Short-Time objective intelligibility (STOI) value of speech by 0.076. The perceptual evaluation of speech quality (PESQ) score is increased by 1.2. Even in situations where the actual environment does not match the training environment, this algorithm can still maintain effective speech enhancement performance.

articleTitle: A Multiband CPW Plate Antenna with Symmetrically Coupling Structure for Indoor Wireless Communication System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In the article., the antenna with a CPW (Co-Planar Waveguide) structure is presented in Sub-6GHz band. By using a cascade of rectangular and circular patches., which are surrounded by the ground of CPW structure., the antenna realizes the good performances of wideband and high gain. Moreover, the symmetrically coupling structure is introduced in the proposed antenna., which can greatly improve the bandwidth and gain., so that it can cover the needed bands of Sub-6GHz communication. In order to realize the directional radiation, a box-type reflector is used to achieve high gain. Finally., for comparison, the beneficial effects of the symmetric coupling structure on the performance of antenna concluding bandwidth and realized gain are verified. The simulated results present the directional gain of the planar antenna is 6.4-10.7dBi at 0.6 GHz-0.96 GHz., 1.7 GHz-2.7 GHz and 3.3 GHz-4.2 GHz. The antenna possesses several benefits, including broadband., high-directivity., and economical, making it a fitting choice for contemporary communication systems.

articleTitle: Effect of Variation of βc Parameter in DC-SQUID on SQUID Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In SQUID, there are three important parameters, namely Stewart-McCumber parameter <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta_{\mathrm{c}}$</tex>, shielding parameter <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta_{\mathrm{L}}$</tex> and thermal noise parameter <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${}^{\prime\prime}\Gamma^{\prime\prime}$</tex>, among which <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta_{\mathrm{C}}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta_{\mathrm{L}}$</tex> play a very important role in the performance of SQUID under ideal conditions. We ignore the thermal noise parameter ” <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Gamma^{\prime\prime}$</tex>, which are closely related to the critical current, SQUID resistance, loop inductance, and SQUID capacitance in SQUID, so this paper focuses on the effect of these parameters on the voltage-to-flow conversion coefficient for bias current, SQUID resistance, and loop inductance. The FLL simulation circuit can be built to simulate the flux noise of the designed squid during the study. Different noise profiles can be obtained by varying the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta_{\mathrm{C}}$</tex> parameter, which was not so intuitive in the previous studies.

articleTitle: Design of a Dual-Polarized High-Gain Yagi Antenna Array for 2G/3G/LTE Base Stations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The present paper introduces a novel Yagi antenna array consisting of dual-polarized dipoles. The antenna consists of a pair of dipoles and two orthogonally mounted Yagi antennas with dielectric plates. To ensure that the antenna performance is consistent in both polarization directions, a symmetrical structure is adopted. Simulated results show a wide working frequency band ranging from 1.7 to 2.8 GHz(48.9%) with a high gain of 15±3 dBi, and the 30°-horizontal and vertical beam widths.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Near-Field Focused Antenna in RFID Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this article, the near-field Radio Frequency Identification Devices (RFID), reader antenna is designed. In the study of near field reader antenna, it is mainly divided into induction near field reader antenna and radiation near field reader antenna. Firstly, an antenna array element is designed in this paper. The antenna realizes circular polarization. The near-field focusing method is adopted to realize the control of the identification area in the near field. On this basis, the identification performance is further optimized by the design of unequal spoke feed, which can effectively reduce the error rate outside the identification area. The area of high electric field intensity remains <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${120}\text{mm}^{{*}}{120}\text{mm}^{{*}}{200}\text{mm}$</tex> and the electric field intensity outside the region is effectively reduced

articleTitle: Ferroelectric Polarization Assisted Trapping Memcapacitor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this letter, a ferroelectric memcapacitor based on Hf<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</inf>Zr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>(HZO) deposited by atomic layer deposition (ALD) is fabricated. The synergistic effect of ferroelectric polarization and charge trapping behavior is used for achieving reliable memory properties and controllable intermediate states. The memcapacitors themselves generate no joule heat during the processing. This work paves a way for ultralow-power memory based on ferroelectric memcapacitors.

articleTitle: Visual Servo Control with YOLOv5 and Kalman Filter for Apple Sorting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Real-time sorting of items on an assembly line is a challenging task to accomplish without causing any stoppages. Visual servoing may enabel to be a highly efficient solution. This paper achieved sorting by utilizing the Dobot Magician manipulator and the ZED2i binocular camera as the hardware framework. The system is capable of performing tasks such as targeted identification, tracking, and grasping of various apples, on the moving conveyor belt. This paper studies a new system for sorting immature apples by binocular camera and manipulator, and applies deep learning and visual servo technology. The YOLOv5 algorithm is used to realizes object detection and positioning in 2D image and multi-thread processing of the image to achieve accurate and rapid positioning of different targets. The kinematic model and hand-eye calibration of the manipulator are used to realize the coordinate transformation between the camera and the manipulator, and the real-time detection and tracking of the target are completed. Finally, kalman filter is used to predict the trajectory of the target and complete the sorting action. The YoloV5 algorithm realizes the precise positioning and maturity identification of apples in 2D images, and the ZED2i binocular vision realizes the 3D spatial positioning of apples. Use visual servo control to guide the manipulator for real-time and precise sorting. This study provides an effective way to improve the level of agricultural automation, reduce labor costs and ensure fruit quality, and has high practical value and broad application prospects.

articleTitle: A Fractional-Order Logarithmic Adaptive Filtering Algorithm Under $\alpha$-Stable Noise
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In practical applications, noise is more appropriately modelled as an a-stable random process than as a Gaussian process. To cope with a-stable noise, a fractional-order stochastic gradient descent (SGD) method is invented to adaptive filtering (AF) algorithms. When both input signal and noise follow α-stable random processes, the AF algorithms based on mean square error (MSE) criteria can be affected. Nevertheless, the fractional-order AF (FoAF) algorithm can effectively address this issue. For the purpose of better stability performance of the FoAF algorithm, different cost functions (CFs) are introduced into fractional-order SGD method. Based on the fractional-order derivative of a logarithmic CF (LCF), a fractional-order logarithmic adaptive filtering (FoLAF) algorithm is formed in this condition. Trials show that the FoLAF algorithm achieves faster convergence, excellent steady-state performance and superior tracking performance.

articleTitle: Study on the Structure and Characteristics of a Novel Semi-SJSGT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a novel semi-SJSGT structure is proposed to optimize the static and dynamic characteristics of the device by combining the structural characteristics of SJMOSFET and SGT-MOSFET. The results show that compared with Con.SGT, the breakdown voltage of the novel semi-SJSGT is increased by 15.8%, and the on-resistance is reduced by 29.9%. Compared with Con.TrenchSJ, the gate charge of the novel semi-SJSGT is decreased by 27.5%, and the gate to drain charge is decreased by 31.2%. In order to further reduce the process difficulty of semi-SJSGT, the Dif.semi-SJSGT structure is proposed. At the same time, in order to further reduce the on-resistance of semi-SJSGT, the NFD.semi-SJSGT structure is proposed. Compared with semi-SJSGT, the on-resistance of NFD.semi-SJSGT is reduced by 1.9%.

articleTitle: Application of a 3D Parabolic Equation Model with Higher-Order Operator Approximation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A parabolic equation sound propagation model with higher-order operator approximation is introduced for three-dimensional numerical calculation. The higher-order approximation is implemented by Taylor expansion of the Helmholtz root equation, and then applies the split-step Fourier method to calculate the sound field recursively. The model is applied to analyze sound propagation in both mesoscale eddy and frontal environments, and the features of sound fields with these dynamic processes are discussed. Moreover, the results of 3D sound fields effectively prove the performance of the parabolic equation model approximated by higher-order operators.

articleTitle: A Novel Omnidirectional Antenna with Null-Filled Radiation Pattern
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A novel omnidirectional antenna with the null-filled radiation pattern is proposed in this work. The designed antenna can fill the inherent blind zone at the zenith of a traditional monopole antenna and, meanwhile, maintain good omnidirectional radiation characteristics in the horizontal direction. A metallic ring connected to the monopole antenna is utilized to adjust the original current distribution so that the elimination of the blind zone can be achieved. Furthermore, a ring slot is opened centering on the ground plane to improve the radiation capability of the antenna in the horizontal direction. The measured s<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> of the antenna is better than -10 dB in 3.4-6.0 GHz, achieving a relative bandwidth of 54.9%. The zenith gain of 0.8 dBi and the lowest H-plane radiation gain of -0.4 dBi are obtained. The measured and simulated results are in good agreement, effectively verifying the feasibility of the proposed antenna in practical applications.

articleTitle: Fully Solution-Processed Non-Contact Printed Capacitive Sensor with Dispensing Printed Carbon Electrode and Transfer Printed g-C3N4 Doped PVDF Polymer Capacitive Layer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In recent years, flexible capacitive tactile sensors have garnered increasing attention from researchers worldwide. They have focused on enhancing the sensor's preparation method, mechanical properties, sensitivity, and other aspects, making it a significant area of research. This paper presents a simple yet effective approach for fabricating a highly sensitive haptic sensor using the dot matrix printing technique. The sensor's forked finger electrode is prepared through this method, followed by the printing of graphene carbon nitride/ polyvinylidene fluoride (GCN/PVDF) dielectric layer on the electrode.
