By utilizing the exceptional properties of GCN/PVDF, the electrodes printed on a glass substrate can be successfully transferred to the dielectric layer. This enables the fabrication of carbon electrodes as flexible devices through high-temperature curing conditions, thereby enhancing the overall performance of the sensor. The resultant sensor exhibits excellent mechanical properties and performs admirably in both contact and non-contact systems. Moreover, the sensor is designed and arranged as a flexible wearable touch-sensitive keyboard, capable of accurately capturing the user's touch and duration. This design opens up possibilities for various applications, such as flexible keyboards. Experimental results demonstrate that the sensors prepared in this study possess significant potential for integration into wearable electronic devices. In summary, this paper presents a straightforward yet effective method for preparing a highly sensitive haptic sensor. By leveraging the dot matrix printing technique and GCN/PVDF dielectric layer, the sensor demonstrates excellent mechanical properties and performs exceptionally well in both contact and non-contact scenarios. The successful integration of these sensors into a flexible wearable touch-sensitive keyboard further highlights their potential for various applications in wearable electronics.

articleTitle: Tunable Single-wavelength Fiber Laser Based on a Microbubble Cavity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A tunable fiber laser with feedback based on a high-quality factor <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{(Q\sim 10^{7})}$</tex> microbubble cavity is suggested and demonstrated. The single-wavelength fiber laser output with a linewidth of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\sim 11.68\ \text{kHz}}$</tex> and a threshold power of approximately 35mW is achieved by incorporating a microbubble cavity-tapered fiber coupling system into an all-fiber ring laser. The tuning method of fiber lasers is achieved by the pressure variations within the microbubble cavity in the feedback loop, which has the advantages of fast tuning and continuous tuning. And a wavelength sensitivity of 0.1291 pm/kPa is obtained. This tunable fiber laser has several applications in optical fiber communications, fiber sensors, and other fields.

articleTitle: Evaluation of ORB-SLAM2 and Stereo-DSO in Complex Indoor-Outdoor Scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The application of the visual SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) algorithm in the domain of robotic navigation has been increasingly widespread. During the robot's locomotion, the visual SLAM algorithm leverages image-based information to estimate the relative motion of the robot at different instants and simultaneously constructs the environmental map of the robot's surroundings. The estimated pose information and environmental map can further be utilized for path planning and navigation of the robot. Currently, the mainstream visual SLAM algorithms deployed in the robotics adopt binocular cameras as sensors for image acquisition, such as the feature-based ORB-SLAM2 and the direct method-based Stereo-DSO algorithm. To evaluate the performance differences of these two mainstream algorithms in different scenarios, we construct a dataset using the ZED2 binocular camera to capture images of indoor and outdoor scenes, along with ground-truth camera poses. We run ORB-SLAM2 and Stereo-DSO on the dataset to obtain estimated trajectories and reconstructed point clouds, comprehensively evaluating their positioning accuracy and environmental reconstruction effects. Detailed evaluation data and results comparisons are provided on the main text. This study provides reference value and improvement ideas for subsequent research on the localization problem of Visual SLAM algorithms in diverse scenarios.

articleTitle: Design of Non-Uniform Bending Dual-Band Monopole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a non-uniform snake-shaped dualband monopole antenna is studied and designed using the equivalent circuit method. Based on the traditional monopole antenna, the non-uniform bending technique is applied to effectively improve the miniaturization and multifunctionalization of the antenna. The simulation results show that the antenna can work in DCS1800 band and UMTS2100 band, and return loss less than -10dB at 1747MHz-1878MHz and 2078MHz-2335MHz, showing good operation performance.

articleTitle: Comparison of Plain Network and ResNet Classifiers for Fruit Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: As deep learning techniques continue to advance, image recognition and classification have become research hotspots in the field of computer vision. This study aims to investigate the application of deep learning classifier in fruit image recognition problems, and we have compared two distinct deep neural network architectures: Plain Network and ResNet. In addition, this study primarily focuses on the practical application of deep learning neural networks in classification problems. Therefore, we use fruit classification as an example and build a deep learning classifier for fruits. The introduction and popularization of deep learning neural networks hold significant meaning. The contributions of this study are as follows: 1) Popularization of deep learning neural networks through educational efforts. 2) Experimental evidence demonstrates that the deep network learning architecture ResNet outperforms the traditional Plain Network in terms of learning efficiency and accuracy in classification problems.

articleTitle: An Amplifying Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface Based on Van Atta Array
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents the design and simulation of a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) integrated with a van atta array layout linkage and four power amplifiers (PA). This design aims to enable electromagnetic wave retro-reflection while simultaneously enhancing the reflected signal. Specifically, we construct a planar <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{2\times 4}$</tex> RIS array based on the van atta principle to accurately implement the retro-reflection function. The CST transient EM/circuit co-simulation method is employed to effectively control the gain of the amplifier. The simulation results demonstrate that, at a frequency of 5.8 GHz, the far-field intensity can be manipulated by adjusting the amplifier gain, thereby achieving the desired retro-reflection functionality.

articleTitle: A Fast Radiation Performance Prediction Method for Reconfigurable Transmitarray Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Traditional full-wave simulation method and electromagnetic calculation method based on ray tracing method (RTM) have the huge defect of consuming computing time and hardware resources. In this paper, a fast radiation performance prediction method for reconfigurable transmitarray (RTA) based on BP neural network (BPNN) is proposed. The discrete phase distribution of the RTA is used as the input of the dataset, and the gain and sidelobe level of the corresponding E-plane and H-plane of the pattern as the output. Randomized phase quantization method-appropriate two probable value (A2PV) method and pattern calculation tool based on RTM are used to generate dataset for training. Reference to calculated results, the trained network outputs precise gain and sidelobe results of E-and H- planes of the RTA under different random phase distributions. The proposed method has a huge speed advantage, which can realize the real-time output of the pattern parameters.

articleTitle: Digital Farming System based on The Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This study integrates Bluetooth BLE, GPS, and 4G communication technologies to create a digital agricultural system based on the RT-Thread and Cloud platforms. The system compromises three major components, namely the gateway, the ear tag, and the cloud platform. The ear tag detects the target's movement steps, real-time body temperature, and battery level and transmits the data to the gateway via Bluetooth. The gateway receives Bluetooth data from numerous ear tags through the Bluetooth chip and then communicates with the Cloud platform for networking purposes. The system achieves digital farming with minimal power consumption, accomplishing all of the activities of a digital farm and meeting product-level requirements.

articleTitle: Grating-Lobe Suppression of Non-uniform Large-Element-Spacing Antenna Arrays
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Large-element-spacing (LES) arrays provide cost-effectiveness and structural simplicity. However, they experience the drawback of excessive grating lobes. In this study, we tackle the problem by introducing a metasurface lens positioned above a non-uniform LES array. The purpose is to manipulate and correct the phase characteristics of the near fields produced by the array; in doing so, the grating lobes are reduced or eliminated. Theoretical analysis and simulations of an example design are conducted. The results show that this approach can not only mitigate the grating lobes from the non-uniform LES array but also increase the antenna gain and aperture efficiency.

articleTitle: Dangerous Behavior Detection in Gas Stations Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method to detect dangerous behaviors using an improved CV-YOLOv5s convolutional neural network, aiming to solve the problem of missed and false detection in existing gas station video analysis software. The algorithm consists of four components: region segmentation, classification learning, feature extraction and target detection. The model was trained on a gas station surveillance video dataset. Experimental results show that the proposed model can achieve an accuracy of 88.2% under various weather conditions, which is more accurate than a single YOLOv5 model. Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

articleTitle: Semantic Consensus Model and Behavioural Control Model for Visual Data Link
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The Visual Data Link is a new type of data Link based on vision and artificial intelligence. To address the problems of information interaction, information sharing and behavioural control faced by Visual Data Link, this thesis proposes a semantic consensus model for Visual Data Link that can achieve semantic consensus among unmanned platforms and realize the information interaction and information sharing capability of Visual Data Link in the “spectral domain”; the semantic consensus model and behavioural control model for Visual Data Link proposed in this study can realize the common sense cognitive understanding and collaborative control of related information resources based on vision. Semantic consensus and behavioural control models can effectively support the development and application of Visual Data Link.

articleTitle: A Microwave Resonator Sensor and its Application in Human Pulse Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The microwave resonator sensor consists of resonant structures designed to resonate at a specific microwave frequency. The resonant frequency or other characteristics of the resonator can be changed as the sensor interacts with the environment due to variations in environmental factors such as temperature, humidity, pressure, or the presence of certain substances. By measuring changes in resonant frequency or other parameters, microwave resonator sensors can offer useful information about the physical features of the environmental variation. In this work, a rectangular open-loop resonator sensor is proposed to monitor the human pulse signal by measuring the capacitance of the resonator. The proposed sensor provides precise measurements with a high degree of accuracy. It exhibits great potential in human pulse monitoring.

articleTitle: The Improvement of Magnetic Field Sensitivey of Magnetoelectric Sensors in Series
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The array is a new structure that can effectively improve the performance of the sensor. Many scholars have studied the role of charge accumulation in the array, but there is no basic performance study for one unit, that is, two sensors in series. In this paper, a sensor with the same size made of piezoelectric material PZT and magnetostrictive material is designed. It is connected in series to study the bias magnetic field, resonance frequency, resonance peak, sensitivity and linearity. Through the test of the series structure, we found that compared with a single sensor, when the input excitation does not become, the bias magnetic field of the series inductor does not change, the resonance frequency does not change, and the resonance peak is the sum of a single sensor. The sensitivity and sensitivity have also been significantly enhanced. It provides an idea for the study of multi-unit array sensor performance.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electrostatic Discharge Waveforms from High-Voltage Solar Arrays
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: High-voltage solar cell arrays in space plasma environment have serious surface discharge risks. In order to effectively reduce the risk of ESD (Electrostatic Discharge) of solar arrays in orbit, ESD tests need to be complemented on solar cell samples on ground to verify the design status. In this paper, the characteristics of the solar cell array ESD and the solar array electrostatic discharge signal is simulated. A typical electrostatic discharge test is also carried out.

articleTitle: XPD Enhancement and Decoupling of $\pm 45^{\mathrm{o}}$ Dual-polarized Antenna Array by Parasitic Strips
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A parasitic metal post scheme is proposed to enhance the cross-polarization discrimination (XPD) of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm 45^{\mathrm{o}}$</tex> dual-polarized cross-dipole antennas in this paper. The technique's effectiveness is verified by designing vertical and horizontal <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm 45^{\mathrm{o}}$</tex> dual-polarized antenna elements. The array-antenna decoupling surface (ADS) decoupling scheme and the proposed XPD enhancement scheme are applied to four <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2\times 2$</tex> arrays to explore the relationship between enhancing XPD and decoupling. The results show that decoupling and enhanced XPD are independent, due to which the design of large-scale base station (BS) arrays can be convenient in future methodologies.

articleTitle: Design of Filtering $180^{\mathrm{O}}$ Hybrid Coupler Based on Coupled-Resonator Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper reports <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$a 180^{\mathrm{o}}$</tex> hybrid coupler with filter function. Comprising four resonators, the proposed coupler achieves a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{180^{\mathrm{o}}}$</tex> phase shift through different type of couplings. The whole structure is analyzed theoretically, and it is proved that the structure can realize the filter <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$180^{\mathrm{o}}$</tex> hybrid coupler. To test the correctness of this design method, a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{180^{\mathrm{o}}}$</tex> hybrid coupler with second-order filtering characteristics is devised, manufactured and tested. The coherence observed between the simulation and experimental results substantiates the accuracy and reliability of the design methodology.

articleTitle: Radio Coverage Prediction for Railways Based on GIS+BIM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Radio coverage prediction is crucial for designing railway wireless networks. If the prediction result is inaccurate, it can cause problems such as poor coverage, low network quality, or extra adjustments of the base station locations during railway construction and testing. Ray-tracing technology can predict radio propagation accurately based on high-precision 3D models of the environment. However, since the landform can change dramatically during railway construction, using maps or models obtained at the early stages of construction may not reflect the final railway environment, which restricts the usage of ray-tracing technology. In this paper, we propose a method that compounds 3D Geographic Information System (GIS) maps and Building Information Modeling (BIM) design models to simulate the final railway environment and perform ray-tracing radio coverage prediction based on it. The results show that this method can capture the impact of the environment on radio propagation and improve the accuracy and efficiency of the calculation.

articleTitle: Efficient and Lightweight Human Pose Estimation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This study examines a straightforward and effective human posture estimation technique based on a SimpleBaseline network. A simple and effective network model is created, and a multi-feature fusion module is implemented on the foundation of SimpleBaseline to fuse high-resolution feature maps and low-resolution feature maps, in an effort to address the issue that the present human pose estimation task model is too complex. The effective Shuffle module's functions include replacing the original network's basic module, reducing unnecessary parameters, and enhancing model inference. A coordinate attention mechanism is presented to embed location information into channel attention to increase the accuracy of the lightweight network and make the network more lightweight and efficient in order to address the issue of prediction accuracy decline after model light weighting.

articleTitle: Path Planning Algorithm for UAV Data Collection Based on Improved DDPG
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In the process of path planning during UAV data collection, some traditional deep reinforcement learning algorithms suffer from poor path planning, slow convergence speed and high energy consumption. Therefore, for the above problems, a novel approach called RDER-DDPG is proposed, incorporating a continuous action deep reinforcement learning framework and double experience replay with retrace mechanism. By storing superior empirical information and adjusting the sampling ratio between replay buffers, the algorithm achieves faster convergence, higher average reward, and shorter flight trajectories. The retrace mechanism enables effective obstacle avoidance learning and improves path planning efficiency while reducing UAV energy consumption. Experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in task execution success rates and energy consumption compared to conventional DQN and DDPG methods. The proposed RDER-DDPG approach enhances the effectiveness of UAV data collection path planning in IoT networks.

articleTitle: Named Entity Recognition of Lithium-ion Battery Defects Based on BiLSTM-CRF
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The global market for new energy vehicles has been rapidly expanding, driving the development of the lithium-ion battery industry. According to customs statistics, China's exports of Li-battery increased by 86.6% from the same period in 2021 during the period of January to November 2022. The safe export of Li-battery is highly valued by Chinese customs. Lithium-ion batteries have defects in production, harsh environmental usage, and transportation, which may pose safety risks. Effective text mining of Li-battery defects is beneficial for researchers to analyze the defects mechanisms of Li-battery, which is important in preventing battery accidents. In this regard, this paper creates a Chinese entity recognition corpus for multi-level Li-battery defects and proposes a solution based on the BiLSTM-CRF model to extract defect entities from Li-battery defect texts. The results show that compared to other baseline methods, the BiLSTM-CRF model achieves better performance in Li-battery defect named entity recognition, which is of great importance for further constructing a multi-level Li-battery defect knowledge graph and ensuring the healthy development of the battery industry in the province and even the whole country.

articleTitle: Fast and Large-range Frequency-hopping mm-wave Signal Transmission System Based on Direct Modulation Laser
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: We proposed and experimentally demonstrated a millimeter wave frequency-hopping signal transmission system. The system can realize fast optical wavelength tuning based on direct modulation laser and millimeter wave frequency-hopping signals generation by optical heterodyning. In experiments, frequency hopping signals with a switching time of 100 us and signals whose carrier frequency hops from 27.5 GHz to 29.7 GHz were successfully received.

articleTitle: An Optimized Dynamic Disperse and Shrink Anti-Collision Algorithm for UHF RFID
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Multi-tag identification is one of the research hotspots in the field of RFID. Collision occurs when two or more tags send response simultaneously to the reader. Lack of efficient anti-collision mechanism results in low tag identifying performance. This paper proposes an optimized dynamic disperse and shrink algorithm (ODDS), which dynamically adjusts the timeslot value of the tags to enable rapid tag access. The instructions in the ODDS algorithm are concise, improving the UHF RFID system's implementation ability, and achieving better anti-collision efficiency without increasing the complexity of tag implementation.

articleTitle: Filtered-X $q$-Gradient Least Mean Mixed-Norm Algorithm for Active Noise Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: On the basis of the notion of Jackson derivative, the filtered-x q-gradient least mean mixed-norm algorithm (FxqLMMN) is proposed for active noise control by using q-gradient to minimize the cost function. To reconcile the balance between errors in steady-state and convergence speed, an additional time-varying q-parameter is introduced in the proposed algorithm. Simulation consequences exhibit that, compared to prior algorithms, the proposed algorithm speeds up convergence and provides excellent noise suppression effects under a diversity of common noise input environments.

articleTitle: Efficient DOA Estimation Based on Cauchy Loss Variable Step Size Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The Cauchy loss function is robust to large outliers and has successful applications in signal processing. In this paper, a DOA estimation algorithm based on adaptive zero technology is proposed, which updates the weight of the filter by applying the Cauchy loss function, and further improves the algorithm performance by using the variable step size method. The algorithm step size is adjusted by accumulating errors and establishing a nonlinear function with instantaneous errors. The DOA estimation ability, estimation error and accuracy of the improved Cauchy algorithm in the impulse noise environment are analyzed. The algorithm is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Fully Printed Soft Triboelectric Nanogenerator for Self-Power Device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Triboelectric nanogenerators (TENG), particularly in wearable electronic devices, portable self-powered systems, and human-machine interfaces, have transformed the field of renewable energy collection and utilization since 2012. Printed electronics in nano friction motors offer several advantages, including low manufacturing cost, flexibility, scalability, high energy efficiency, small size, repeatability, and consistency. This paper introduces a single-electrode TENG fabricated using a printed composite electrode, consisting of silver paste doped with carbon nanotubes (CNT) encapsulated inside polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS). The paper demonstrates the excellent conductivity and stability of the printed composite electrode by optimizing the ratio of silver to CNT, the number of single cycles, and the cycle time. The findings provide a valuable reference for the development of self-powered stress recognition devices based on flexible TENG, showing immense promise for practical applications in self-powered electronics.

articleTitle: Design of K-Band Multilayer Cross-Coupled Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This article proposes a K-band multilayer cross-coupled filter based on active space mapping algorithm. The algorithm is implemented using Matlab program, and the variable parameters of the filter structure are iteratively optimized. After five iterations, the optimal solution of the filter structure can be obtained, achieving automatic iterative optimization of filter parameters. The physical test results show that the center frequency of the filter is 22GHz, the bandwidth is 1GHz, the insertion loss in the passband is less than 3dB, and the return loss is less than -15dB. By employing the active space algorithm for quick optimization of the filter, the design time can be greatly reduced while improving the accuracy of simulation.

articleTitle: Classification of Cervical Images Based On Deep Neural Network With Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a DenseNet-CBAM model that utilizes DenseNet121 as the backbone network for feature extraction. The features are then weighted using the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM), which incorporates both channel and spatial attention mechanisms. The features are further processed with ReLU activation and adaptive average pooling operations. Finally, a linear classifier is applied to output the final category predictions. Experiment results show that the proposed model performs the best in terms of the ability in detecting patients with high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions (HSIL).

articleTitle: Advancing Efficiency in Thermal Simulation Algorithms for Chip Packaging
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, the alternating-direction implicit finite-difference time-domain (ADI-FDTD) approach and the hybrid explicit-implicit finite-difference time-domain (HIE-FDTD) approach are introduced as two effective numerical computational techniques to implement heat conduction simulations. The ADI-FDTD and HIE-FDTD approaches' computational precision has been numerically verified using analytical solutions and COMSOL simulations. The techniques ADI-FDTD and HIE-FDTD are used for the thermal simulation of a typical 3D chip package model. The techniques ADI-FDTD and HIE- FDTD have significant advantages with regard to computational effectiveness compared to the general Finite difference time domain method. Since the ADI-FDTD and HIE-FDTD methods show excellent stability, efficiency and applicability to modeling complex structures in the experiments of this paper, they can be widely applied to heat transfer simulations, especially those involving fine structures.

articleTitle: Human Action Recognition and Counting Based on Embedded System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Although action recognition and counting based on embedded systems have already emerged in daily life, such as using mobile phones for exercise training, it is still a challenging problem to balance the fluency of operation in hardware systems and the accuracy of counting. A hardware platform with built-in acceleration modules and a moderately sized deep neural network may be a feasible solution. In this paper, the NVIDIA Jetson TX2 and the CNN model are selected to build a realtime application. Then, the feature extraction network and branch network are compressed using a lightweight method for better adaptation. Thus, whether it is a still posture or active movement, the key coordinate of the human body joint can be obtained, and then the actions can be distinguished using corresponding discrimination methods. Especially in the case of sports, such as Push-ups and Sit-ups, the angles of joints and bodies can be calculated mathematically and the number of actions can be estimated according to the action standards. The experiments show that the proposed algorithm can achieve 13~16 frames per second(FPS) and the accuracy of movement recognition and counting is higher than 90% in the choosen embedded system.

articleTitle: Tactical Data Chain Link Effectiveness Assessment Based on Cloud Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To address the complexity of tactical data chain system effectiveness assessment, a tactical data chain system effectiveness assessment index system is established by drawing on the principles of cloud theory, and a tactical data chain system effectiveness assessment method based on cloud theory is proposed. Based on the description of the hierarchical analysis method and the evaluation steps of cloud theory, the evaluation of the effectiveness of the tactical data chain system is realized by calculating the cloud model of each indicator and the weight of each indicator parameter in combination with a specific example. The example proves that this method can effectively integrate the uncertainty and ambiguity of quantitative and qualitative indicators, is highly operable, and can provide a scientific and objective method for the comprehensive effectiveness assessment of tactical data chain systems based on network information systems.

articleTitle: Short-term Electricity Load Prediction Based on Machine Learning and Improved LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With the continuous development of computers, artificial intelligence is gradually integrated into our lives, and electricity is one of the most important energy sources in today's era. Power load related problems also lead to a lot of power loss, using machine learning to provide reliable power load prediction is of great significance. In this paper, LSTM (Long Short Term Memory Model) is used to forecast power load. The data comes from parts of Linyi City, combined with weather factors such as temperature and sunshine and the daily electricity consumption of continuously developing new energy vehicles to predict the total electricity consumption. LSTM model is used for power load prediction, and the learning rate and iteration times of the model are optimized and adjusted. The short-term power load prediction algorithm of LSTM model with higher accuracy and stronger applicability and stability is obtained by fully considering many influencing factors such as climate and electricity consumption of new energy vehicles that have an impact on power load.

Author Keywords: electricity consumption of new energy vehicles

articleTitle: DOA Estimation for RIS Assisted Multi-User Wireless Communication System with Squared-Sine Error Criterion and Lawson Norm Constraint
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) can control the phase of reflected signals, and has become a hotspot in the field of wireless communication. In this paper, we propose a direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation algorithm for RIS assisted multi-user wireless communication systems with squared-sine error criterion and Lawson norm constraint. This algorithm utilizes the sparsity of the signal and can achieve fast and accurate DOA estimation under the interference of impulsive noises. To suppress the line-of-sight (LOS) interference and thus to maximize the received signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR), we also propose a random optimal phase selection (ROPS) technique to design the control matrix of RIS elements. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm performs better than the existing methods.

articleTitle: Slow-Wave Substrate Integrated Filtering Antenna with Defected Ground Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This work reports a slow-wave substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) filtering antenna with defected ground structure (DGS). The open side of the half mode substrate integrated waveguide (HMSIW) cavity is extended with an epitaxial dielectric plate to be utilized as a radiation resonator, while the other side is cascaded with the SIW cavity to form the second-order filtering response. The proposed filtering antenna has two controllable transmission zeros (TZ), which is generated by the cross coupling between microstrip, SIW cavity, and HMSIW cavity. The DGS and slow-wave structure are loaded into the resonant cavities to change the distributed inductance and capacitance, which can contribute to bandwidth widening and size reduction. Then, with the epitaxial radiation dielectric plate, the radiation area is widened, and the realized gain can be further enhanced effectively. To verify the design concept, a prototype was simulated. The simulated results exhibit that the center frequency is 8.74 GHz, the relative bandwidth is 4.8%, and the return loss is better than 16.2 dB. Moreover, two radiations zero locates at 7.95 GHz and 9.6 GHz, respectively, and the realized gain can reach up to 6.5 dBi.

articleTitle: Thermal Design and Optimize of Satellite Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The satellite antenna contains a large number of electronic components, and the external temperature changes greatly during operation. The thermal design is the key point of the satellite antenna design. The satellite antenna designed with the traditional scheme is simulated, and module 1, the main heating component of the antenna, the maximum working temperature reaches 96.9 °C, which does not meet the operating requirements. This paper analyzes the reasons and adopts the measures of increasing the heat dissipation area and shortening the heat dissipation path to optimize the antenna. After optimized, the temperature rises of the modules are reduced, and the maximum working temperature of module 1 is 67.6 °C, which verifies the effectiveness of the design optimization.

articleTitle: Multi-Polarization High Gain $16\times 8$ Array Horn Antenna with Superstrate for Downlink Satellite Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The polarization and gain are the most important things in satellite communication. Each country or region uses different polarizations to prevent signal interference. Multi-polarization and high gain are essential to receive signals anywhere, regardless of skew and the country or region. In this study, we propose a multi-polarization, high gain <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{16}\times \mathbf{8}$</tex> array antenna with a superstrate for satellite communication. This antenna targets the 10.7 - 12.75 GHz band, which is a widely commercialized satellite communication band. The proposed antenna achieves multi-polarization by using septum polarizers, and a fish-net pattern superstrate is proposed to enhance the gain of the antenna. The array antenna feed line structure is located between each single antenna unit to reduce the height of the array antenna. The proposed antenna achieves multi-polarization, a peak gain of more than 35 dB, and high cross-polarization discrimination.

articleTitle: A Cross-domain Data Trusted Fusion Method of Energy IoT Based on Blockchain and Metadata
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: As the energy Internet of Things (IoT) develops by leaps and bounds, energy sources are no longer planned separately, and the integration of energy cross-domain data is imminent. However, due to the scattered and chaotic levels of energy subjects, cross-domain integration faces the problems of complex processes and low credibility. In this paper, a cross-domain data trusted fusion method of energy IoT based on blockchain and metadata is designed, which realizes the whole process supervision, standardizes the energy data storage and integration mode, ensures the security of the system, reduces the consumption of resources, and improves work efficiency.

articleTitle: A Bandpass Flter with Combinational Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this letter, a combinational technique to design medium-band bandpass filter (BPF) is presented. The filter is composed of a classical stub bandpass filter with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\lambda/4$</tex> short-circuited stubs and two short-step impedance transformers. Main part of the filter is designed based on classical stub bandpass filter with higher normalized impedance, which effectively solves the problem that the width of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\lambda/4$</tex> short-circuited stubs is too large to be realized in design medium- or narrow-band BPF process. And the short-step impedance transformer is used to match higher impedance to 50 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Omega$</tex>. For demonstration, a bandpass filter with five-poles with a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{20}$</tex> -dB-ripple Chebyshev response and fractional bandwidth of 0.25 at a mid-band frequency 2 GHz is simulated, designed and tested. Excellent results between the simulated and measured is achieved.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Video Target Tracking Based on TensorSSA and Deep Features
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Most target tracking is performed on visible video. This conventional RGB video lacks spectral information, leading to the tracking process being susceptible to interference from background clutter, illumination changes, etc. Hyperspectral images (HSIs) have the advantage of spectral integration, which can interpret the features of a target in both spatial and spectral dimensions. Therefore, HSIs with continuous spectral information have unique advantages in the field of target tracking. In this paper, a correlation filter-based HSIs tracking method is proposed. Feature maps are generated using tensor singular spectrum analysis (tensorS SA) feature and depth features to jointly exploit spatial contextual information and deep semantic information. Then a kernelized correlation filtering framework is used to generate feature responses on HSIs, and the largest region in the final output response is the center of the target in the current frame. Experiments conducted on hyperspectral images show that the proposed method can effectively utilize spatial-spectral information and outperforms the hyperspectral video tracking methods that partially use single features and the traditional color video tracking methods.

Author Keywords: tensor singular spectrum analysis (tensorS SA) feature

articleTitle: A Multifunctional Reflectarray Antenna for Sub-THz Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a reflection element sensitive to polarization direction is proposed, which can independently control the phase of incident wave in dual polarized directions. Then, a reflectarray including the proposed 7×7 elements is designed to offer dual-polarized deflection. The results show that the reflectarray achieves a -15° beam deflection with an X-axis polarized incident wave. In contrast, it realizes a +15° beam deflection with a Y-–axis polarized wave. In addition, the cross polarization (X-pol) level is less than -20 dB, and the gain of the array is higher than that of the waveguide feed by 8 dBi. Therefore, significant gain enhancement can be successfully obtained.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning Optimization Algorithm Designed for IRS-Assisted Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To reduce the computing delay of the terminals and improve the poor wireless channel environment, in this paper, a computing resource allocation algorithm for IRS-assisted edge computing is proposed. By introducing the intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) technique to reduce the edge computing latency, the computing offloading variables are optimized through an Alternating optimization approach, and a partial offloading strategy for MEC offloading is adopted. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is applied for coarse phase control of the IRS, and fine phase control of the IRS is achieved through fine phase optimization. In simulations, the proposed scheme is demonstrated to be effective and low latency.

articleTitle: Investigation of Broadband Flattening Amplification Characteristics in PT-Symmetric Photonic Crystals Based on Multiple Defect Coupling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a crystal structure based on PT-symmetric photonic crystals with multi-defect coupling, achieving wideband and flat gain in the near-infrared region. The transmission matrix method is employed to analyze the influence of material and structure parameter variations on the wideband amplification characteristics of the PT symmetric photonic crystals. Through the adjustment of the refractive index and thickness of the gain-loss medium, the adjustment of the passband transmission and the improvement of the flatness of the photonic crystal can be realized. In the near-infrared band of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{1433}\mathbf{nm}\boldsymbol{\sim 1596}\mathbf{nm}$</tex>, the broadband amplification with an average transmission of 6.7835 can be realized, and it has good flatness. This research has broad prospects for applications in high-efficiency optical amplification, photonic crystal lasers, and high-efficiency optical filters.

articleTitle: A Modified Two-Line Method for Determining Dielectric Properties of Unknown Materials
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a modified two-line method for determination of continuous dielectric properties of unknown dielectric materials at a frequency range of 0.5 to 20 GHz. The dielectric constant and loss tangent of three types of different-thick dielectric materials: (i) Microfiber (ii) FR4-like substrate, (ii) non-stretch denim are investigated. The results have demonstrated that the initial values can be arbitrary, and accurate broadband properties can be obtained by using the modified retrieval algorithms based on the TRACE algorithm. Finally, the reliable and convergent results can be obtained after a few iterative simulations.

articleTitle: Design of Campus Parking Guidance Experimental Platform Based on Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper focuses on enhancing the practical teaching of embedded system development, Internet of Things technology, and other related courses, and a campus parking guidance experimental platform based on Raspberry Pi is designed for this purpose. The platform enables users to obtain vehicle information and parking space status information through license plate recognition, query and reserve available parking spaces through the Baidu cloud server and WeChat public account. It also offers parking space navigation, code scanning for space occupation, and functions for parking timing and video monitoring through WebSocket instant messaging and WeChat applet. Experimental testing demonstrates that the platform runs stably, displays real-time parking space information, and provides a good human-machine interaction experience. It can be easily applied in practical teaching and provide a platform for comprehensive curriculum design and graduation design.

articleTitle: Relay Selection Methods for the Uplink NOMA System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To further improve the transmission reliability of the uplink non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) system, based on decode-and-forward (DF) protocol, we propose two relay selection (RS) schemes: React RS (RRS) and successive interference cancellation (SIC) RS (SRS). Firstly, fully considering the decoding situation at the relay, we analyze the closed-form results of the two RS schemes in terms of exact outage performance under the perfect and imperfect SIC technologies, which can be derived that both schemes have the same outage performance. Then, asymptotic results are given in the high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) region and the best power allocation coefficient is analyzed. Finally, the correctness of the theoretical derivation is verified by simulation. The results show that the proposed schemes are superior and have the best interrupt performance when compared to other RS schemes.
